title: Tree Search With Predictions
summary: ``Algorithms with predictions'', or ``learning-augmented algorithms'', has proved to be an extremely useful paradigm for combining machine learning with traditional algorithms. One of the textbook settings for this is searching a sorted array. Without a prediction, classical binary search takes $O(\log n)$ queries, while with a prediction we can use ``doubling binary search'' to find the target key using $O(\log η)$ queries, where $η$ is the error of the prediction measured as the absolute value of the difference between the true location and the predicted location. Since an array is just a path graph, in this paper we ask whether similar bounds can be achieved for search on even slightly more general graphs: trees. We show first that the high-level answer is ``no'': there is no search algorithm that uses $O(\log η)$ queries, where $η$ is now the graph distance between the predicted location and the true location. However, as our main result, we show that such bounds can be achieved on trees which are ``path-like'' in that they have low \emph{pathwidth}. In particular, we prove that there is a search algorithm which uses at most $O(k \log η)$ queries, where $k$ is the pathwidth of the tree. We also prove a lower bound showing that our algorithm has existentially optimal query complexity. Finally, we show experimentally, on real-life inputs, that our algorithm has query complexity which is notably better than the simple non-prediction-based algorithm.

AI.tldr: Extension of learning-augmented binary search from sorted arrays to trees. Proved impossibility of O(log η) queries on general trees, but achieved O(k log η) optimal complexity on trees with bounded pathwidth k.
AI.motivation: Extend the successful "algorithms with predictions" paradigm from sorted arrays (path graphs) to general trees, which requires rethinking the relationship between prediction error and search complexity.
AI.method: Negative result (impossibility): Proved no O(log η) query algorithm exists when η measures graph distance. Positive result: Developed O(k log η) query algorithm exploiting low pathwidth structure of trees; proved lower bound showing existential optimality of query complexity; validated algorithm experimentally.
AI.result: Achieved O(k log η) query complexity on trees with pathwidth k, where η is the graph distance between predicted and true locations. This matches a lower bound, establishing existential optimality.
AI.conclusion: The proposed O(k log η) query algorithm achieves existentially optimal query complexity for trees with bounded pathwidth. Experiments on real data confirm improved query complexity compared to baseline non-prediction methods.

title: Proper Agnostic Learning of Functions of Halfspaces under Gaussian Marginals
summary:
We study the problem of computationally efficient proper agnostic learning of multidimensional concept classes under the Gaussian distribution. In this setting, given i.i.d. labeled samples from an unknown distribution over $\mathbb{R}^d \times \{\pm 1\}$ whose marginal on $\mathbb{R}^d$ is Gaussian, the goal is to output a hypothesis from a target class $\mathcal{F}$ whose 0-1 loss is within $ε$ of that of the best classifier in $\mathcal{F}$.
  We give the first efficient proper agnostic learning algorithm for arbitrary Boolean functions of $K$ halfspaces under Gaussian marginals. Our algorithm runs in time $d^{O(K^2 \log(1/ε)/ε^2)} + (K/ε)^{O(K^3/ε^{2.5})}$. Prior to our work, the only known algorithm for $K \geq 2$ was brute-force search, with run-time exponential in $d$. Moreover, the dependence of our run-time on the dimension $d$ matches that of the best known improper learning algorithm, namely $d^{\widetilde{O}(K^2/ε^2)}$.
  For the special case of a single halfspace ($K=1$), the best previous run-time was $d^{O(1/ε^4)} + (1/ε)^{O(1/ε^6)}$. Our algorithm improves this to $d^{O(1/ε^2)} + (1/ε)^{O(1/ε^{2.5})}$. Once again, the dependence on $d$ matches that of the best known improper algorithm, namely $d^{O(1/ε^2)}$. Furthermore, the dependence of our run-time on the dimension $d$ is essentially optimal in the statistical query model.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了高维Gaussian分布下概念类的适定不可知学习难题，提出了首个对任意K个半空间布尔函数的高效适定学习算法，时间复杂度关于维度d的依赖达到已知下界，并显著改进了单一半空间情形的结果。
AI.motivation: 在Gaussian分布下进行概念类学习是机器学习理论中的基础问题。现有高效算法均为不适定学习，无法保证输出假设属于目标类。适定学习因要求假设来自目标类而更具实际意义，但此前对于K≥2的情况，最优算法为暴力搜索，时间复杂度关于维度d呈指数级。
AI.method: 通过设计新的算法框架，首次将适定(proper)学习算法的效率提升至与不适定(improper)学习算法相当的水平。核心创新在于利用Gaussian分布的良好性质，结合结构化分析和对偶优化技术。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了首个在Gaussian分布下对K个半空间布尔函数的高效适定不可知学习算法，时间复杂度与维度d的关系达到已知最优的适定学习算法水平，并证明了d的依赖在统计查询模型下几乎是下界最优的。

title: Smoothed Score Queries and the Complexity of Sampling
summary: We study the query complexity of sampling from high-dimensional Gaussian distributions using gradient information. In the standard oracle model, exact gradients expose only matrix-vector products with the precision matrix, leading to polynomial approximation barriers and a characteristic \(\sqrtκ\) dependence on the condition number. We show that this barrier disappears when the sampler is allowed to query \emph{smoothed scores}, namely gradients of the logarithms of the Gaussian-convolved densities. For a Gaussian target with precision matrix \(Λ\), a smoothed-score query at noise level \(τ\) gives access to the resolvent \((Λ+τ^{-1}I)^{-1}\). Combining geometrically spaced noise levels with sinc-quadrature rational approximation, we obtain a sampler with $q=O\!\left(\bigl(\logκ+\log(e\sqrt d/δ_{\rm TV})\bigr)\log(e\sqrt d/δ_{\rm TV})\right)$ smoothed-score queries for total variation error \(δ_{\rm TV}\), improving the condition-number dependence from \(\sqrtκ\) to logarithmic. We also study finite-bit gradient oracles. Using coordinatewise quantization of the transformed smoothed-score answers and a final dithering step, we obtain a sampling scheme whose total communicated gradient information is polylogarithmic in \(κ\); in particular, for fixed dimension and accuracy, the bit complexity is \(O(\log^2κ)\). To complement these upper bounds, we introduce a channel-synthesis, or reverse-Shannon, converse technique for sampling lower bounds. This converts total-variation simulation guarantees into communication requirements and yields an \(Ω(\logκ)\) lower bound on the required gradient information. Together, these results identify smoothed scores as a provably more informative oracle for sampling and give nearly matching upper and lower bounds for its finite-bit complexity.

AI.tldr: 论文研究高斯采样问题的查询复杂度，证明了"平滑分数"预言机比标准梯度预言机信息量更大。通过sinc-quadrature有理逼近等技术，将采样复杂度中对条件数κ的依赖从√κ降低到O(log κ)，并通过通道合成的逆向Shannon技术给出了几乎匹配的下界Ω(log κ)。
AI.motivation: 在标准预言机模型下，精确梯度仅暴露精度矩阵的矩阵-向量乘积，导致多项式逼近障碍和√κ的条件数依赖。作者希望消除这一障碍，证明更informative的查询模型能否降低复杂度。
AI.method: 技术方法：结合几何间隔的噪声层级与sinc- quadrature有理逼近，构造采样器；使用坐标量化与dithering处理有限比特梯度预言机；提出channel-synthesis（逆向Shannon）技术作为下界证明方法。
AI.result: 上界：总变异距离误差δ_TV下，只需O((log κ + log(e√d/δ_TV)) log(e√d/δ_TV))次平滑分数查询，将条件数依赖从√κ降至对数级；有限比特情况下，总通信比特复杂度为O(log² κ)。下界：通道合成技术证明任何采样算法至少需要Ω(log κ)量级的梯度信息。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了平滑分数（smoothed scores）是一种比标准梯度的信息量更大的预言机查询方式，成功将对条件数的依赖从√κ降低到对数级别，并提供了几乎匹配的上界和下界，确立了平滑分数在采样问题中的信息优势地位。

title: Efficient Algorithms for Interdicting Facilities in Trees and Bounded Treewidth Graphs
summary:
Given a graph $G$ of $n$ nodes partitioned into facilities and customers, the $r$-edge interdiction covering problem (REIC) is to remove up to $r$ edges so as to maximize the total weight of customers disconnected from all facilities, which is called the covering objective function. While REIC is known to be NP-complete for general graphs, Fröhlich and Ruzika show that the problem can be solved in polynomial time when $G$ is a tree, providing an $O(n^7 r)$-time algorithm. We give an efficient $O(nr^2)$-time dynamic programming algorithm for REIC on trees that is fixed-parameter linear in $n$. Evaluating our solution on a benchmark of randomly generated tree networks with baselines of the Fröhlich and Ruzika algorithm and the Gurobi integer program solver, we demonstrate that in practice, our algorithm is both significantly faster and less sensitive to network topology and size.
  We extend our algorithm for REIC to graphs of bounded treewidth, a well-studied family of sparse graphs that generalizes trees, and obtain a matching runtime of $O(nr^2)$. We also consider the $r$-facility interdiction covering problem (RFIC), a novel variant of this network interdiction problem where the goal is to remove up to $r$ facilities to maximize the covering objective function over disconnected customers. We show that RFIC is NP-complete by observing it generalizes the small set bipartite vertex expansion problem (SSBVE), also known as the minimum $p$-union problem. We give an $O(nr^2)$-time algorithm for RFIC on trees, which also gives an $O(n^3)$-time algorithm for SSBVE on trees.

AI.tldr: 研究树网络上边 interdiction覆盖问题的快速算法，提出O(nr^2)动态规划解法（从原O(n^7 r)大幅改进），推广至有界树宽图，并引入新变体RFIC证明其NP完全性但可在树上多项式可解。
AI.motivation: 现有树上的REIC算法(O(n^7 r))复杂度过高，需要更高效的算法；同时需要将算法推广到更一般的图类（如有界树宽图），并探索新的变体问题。
AI.method: 动态规划方法：设计O(nr^2)时间的DP算法（固定参数线性于n）；树宽扩展：利用树分解技术将算法推广到有界树宽图；NP完全性规约：通过归约到小集二部顶点膨胀问题(SSBVE)证明RFIC的NP完全性。
AI.result: REIC在树上达到O(nr^2)时间复杂度，相比原O(n^7 r)算法显著提升；REIC扩展到有界树宽图仍保持O(nr^2)复杂度；RFIC在树上可在O(nr^2)时间内求解，由此得到树上SSBVE问题的O(n^3)时间算法。
AI.conclusion: 提出O(nr^2)时间算法，在实践中显著快于基线方法；扩展到有界树宽图并保持相同复杂度；提出新变体RFIC并证明NP完全性但可在树上多项式可解。

title: Are Diffusion Language Models Good Database Analysts?
summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) tasks, yet most NL2SQL systems continue to rely on the autoregressive (AR) paradigm. The highly structured nature of SQL makes AR models susceptible to sequential error propagation due to their rigid left-to-right decoding process. Diffusion Language Models~(DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative, replacing unidirectional decoding with iterative denoising to enable global sequence refinement. Nevertheless, the adoption of DLMs in NL2SQL is constrained by a fragmented ecosystem and the absence of a standardized evaluation framework, which obscures their true capabilities and impedes fair comparison with AR baselines. In this paper, we propose a unified evaluation framework that standardizes both generation and execution environments across various DLM architectures. To further improve the performance of DLMs-based NL2SQL systems, we propose \texttt{SQL-D1}, a novel agentic framework that integrates database-aware context engineering, test-time scaling and interactive optimization. Through extensive empirical studies on scaling properties, post-training stability, and primary failure modes, we demonstrate that DLMs offer distinct advantages in structural robustness and facilitate flexible trade-offs between efficiency and accuracy. By distilling these insights into structured takeaways, our work provides a systematic understanding of DLMs-based NL2SQL and lays the foundation for future database analysis agents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散语言模型(DLM)在自然语言到SQL(NL2SQL)任务中的应用进行系统研究。为解决当前评估标准不统一的问题，提出一个统一评估框架；为进一步提升DLM-based NL2SQL性能，提出SQL-D1智能体框架。研究表明DLM在结构鲁棒性方面优于传统自回归模型，并支持灵活的性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有NL2SQL系统大多依赖自回归(AR)范式，其严格的从左到右解码过程容易产生级联误差传播。此外，扩散语言模型(DLM)在NL2SQL领域的应用受制于生态碎片化和缺乏统一评估标准的问题，难以与AR基线进行公平比较。
AI.method: 提出SQL-D1框架，集成数据库感知上下文工程、测试时扩展和交互式优化三大模块；建立统一评估框架以标准化生成和执行环境；对DLM进行了扩展性质、后训练稳定性和主要失败模式的综合实证研究。
AI.result: DLM在结构鲁棒性方面具有独特优势，并能实现效率与准确性之间的灵活权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为基于DLM的NL2SQL提供了系统性理解，奠定了未来数据库分析智能体(agent)的研究基础。

title: Context-aware Simopt-Power: Using structural data with simulation metadata to optimise FPGA designs
summary: Pre-implementation behavioural simulation routinely validates functional correctness, yet it also produces rich switching-activity traces that are typically discarded by FPGA computer-aided design (CAD) flows. Prior simulation-guided and power-aware FPGA optimisations demonstrate the promise of exploiting this metadata, but many rely on fixed thresholds, narrow decision heuristics, or limited design awareness, often incurring substantial area overhead. This paper presents Context-aware Simopt-Power, a simulator-guided optimisation framework that combines activity metadata with lightweight structural features (sequential proximity, logic-depth proxies, and fan-out estimates) to more precisely target high-impact regions of the netlist. We additionally remove empirically tuned constants, replacing them with architecture-aware parameters such as LUT size and mapping constraints, and evaluate trade-offs using power, delay, and a more useful metrics, area-delay product (AD) and power-delay product (PD). Implemented in an open-source Yosys/ABC flow and evaluated on the complex Koios deep-learning accelerator benchmarks, Context-aware Simopt-Power achieves an average 6.8% dynamic-power reduction while limiting LUT overhead to 11.2%, thus enabling a holistic design optimisation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于仿真引导的FPGA功耗优化框架Context-aware Simopt-Power，通过结合开关活动元数据与结构特征，并采用架构感知参数替代经验常数，在Yosys/ABC开源流程中实现了平均6.8%的动态功耗降低，同时将LUT开销控制在11.2%以内。
AI.motivation: 预实现行为仿真产生的丰富开关活动追踪数据通常被FPGA CAD流程丢弃。虽然已有一些基于仿真引导和功耗感知的优化方法，但它们存在固定阈值、狭窄决策启发式或有限设计感知等局限，往往导致较大的面积开销。
AI.method: 该框架结合活动元数据和轻量级结构特征（时序邻近度、逻辑深度代理和扇出估计），更精准地定位高影响区域；同时移除了经验调优的常数，用架构感知参数（如LUT大小和映射约束）替代；在评估指标上除了功耗和延迟外，还引入了面积-延迟积(AD)和功耗-延迟积(PD)来更好地权衡设计目标。
AI.result: 在Koios深度学习加速器基准测试中，Context-aware Simopt-Power实现了平均6.8%的动态功耗降低，同时将LUT开销限制在11.2%以内。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在Yosys/ABC开源流程中实现，并在Koios深度学习加速器基准测试上验证，实现了平均6.8%的动态功耗降低，同时将LUT开销限制在11.2%以内，为FPGA设计提供了更加全面、实用的优化方案。

title: Differentiable Model Predictive Safety for Heterogeneous Mobility at Urban Intersections
summary: The imminent integration of autonomous vehicles and mobile robots in urban settings presents a critical safety challenge for future intelligent transportation systems. This paper addresses the complex problem of coordinating heterogeneous agents with disparate dynamics at unregulated intersections. We introduce a novel framework, differentiable model predictive safety (DMPS), which embeds the foresight of model-predictive control into a data-driven, end-to-end reinforcement learning architecture. DMPS agents learn a latent dynamics model to predict future trajectories contingent on their actions. A learned, differentiable safety critic then evaluates the risk of these trajectories. Crucially, by leveraging backpropagation through the entire unrolled predictive model, agents can efficiently compute the gradient of future safety with respect to their current action, enabling a minimal and precise online safety correction. Integrated into a multi-agent training scheme, DMPS virtually eliminates collisions to less than 5.6% in high-density, mixed vehicle-robot traffic simulations, demonstrating state-of-the-art safety without compromising energy and traffic efficiency.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes DMPS, a novel framework combining model-predictive control with reinforcement learning for safe coordination of heterogeneous autonomous agents at unregulated intersections. By learning a latent dynamics model and a differentiable safety critic, agents can efficiently compute safety gradients through backpropagation to make precise online corrections. Results show collision rates below 5.6% in complex mixed-traffic simulations while maintaining efficiency.
AI.motivation: The integration of autonomous vehicles and mobile robots in urban settings creates a critical safety challenge at unregulated intersections where heterogeneous agents with different dynamics must coordinate safely.
AI.method: Differentiable Model Predictive Safety (DMPS) framework: (1) Latent dynamics model for future trajectory prediction based on actions; (2) Differentiable safety critic for risk evaluation; (3) Backpropagation through entire unrolled predictive model to compute safety gradients; (4) Minimal online safety correction via gradient-based optimization; (5) Multi-agent training scheme.
AI.result: Collisions reduced to less than 5.6% in high-density mixed vehicle-robot traffic simulations, achieving state-of-the-art safety without compromising energy and traffic efficiency.
AI.conclusion: The DMPS framework demonstrates that integrating MPC foresight into end-to-end RL can achieve near-elimination of collisions (reduced to <5.6%) in complex mixed traffic scenarios while maintaining energy and traffic efficiency, representing a significant advancement in multi-agent safety-critical control.

title: Memory-Based vs. Context-Only Conditioning Produces Distinct Behavioral Patterns in Stateful Personalization
summary: We study how conditioning context shapes personalization behavior in a teacher-facing educational recommender system. We compare contextual conditioning based on the current student question with memory-based conditioning using persistent learner information. Using deviation correlation and paired statistical tests, we find that contextual recommendations exhibit stronger question-level responsiveness, while memory-based recommendations exhibit history-dependent behaviors, including learner-specific differentiation under identical input. Teacher-facing evaluation signals suggest these recommendations are interpretable and actionable. These results indicate that embedding-based similarity metrics capture responsiveness to the current question but do not characterize personalization grounded in learner history, motivating behavior-level diagnostics for studying conditioning effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了教育推荐系统中情境条件化与记忆条件化两种个性化策略的差异，发现两者各有优势：情境条件化更响应当前问题，记忆条件化能实现学习者差异化，提示需要行为级诊断方法来评估条件化效应。
AI.motivation: 当前基于嵌入的相似度度量在捕捉当前问题响应性方面有效，但无法充分表征基于学习者历史的个性化行为，需要深入理解不同条件化方式对个性化推荐的影响。
AI.method: 使用偏差相关分析和配对统计检验，对比情境条件化与记忆条件化两种推荐策略，通过教师视角评估信号验证可解释性和可操作性。
AI.result: 情境条件化推荐表现出更强的问题级响应能力，而记忆条件化推荐展现出历史依赖性行为，包括在相同输入下的学习者特定差异化；教师评估表明两类推荐均具有可解释性和可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了基于嵌入的相似度度量无法充分捕捉学习者历史相关的个性化行为，建议采用行为级诊断方法来研究条件化效应，而非仅依赖嵌入相似度度量。

title: Learning after COVID-19 and the ICT career aspirations: Are students entering the AI era with weaker skills?
summary: This paper examines whether students are entering the generative AI era with sufficiently strong educational foundations, focusing on the relationship between learning environments and changes in ICT related career aspirations across countries. The analysis uses country-level data from PISA 2018 and 2022, combining indicators of student autonomy, digital skills and teacher support. A mixed-method approach is applied, including descriptive statistics, regression analysis, clustering, latent representation learning (using Variational Autoencoder-VAE), discriminant analysis and probabilistic modeling to capture both observable and latent dimensions of educational readiness. Unlike prior research that treats learning loss, digital skills and career expectations separately, our analysis integrates them within a comparative longitudinal framework. It shifts the focus from short-term post-pandemic effects to the structural capacity of education systems to prepare students for digital and AI-driven labor markets. Results show a global but uneven increase in ICT career aspirations. Digital skills emerge as the strongest and most consistent predictor, while teacher support plays a complementary role. Autonomy shows weaker, context-dependent effects. Educational readiness is multidimensional, and ICT aspirations evolve relatively independently from other career domains.

AI.tldr: 基于PISA 2018和2022数据，采用混合方法（含VAE隐表示学习）分析学习环境对ICT职业期望的影响。研究发现数字技能是最关键预测因子，ICT职业期望具有多维独立性特征，呼吁教育系统结构性改革以应对AI时代的劳动力市场需求。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI时代背景下，需评估学生是否具备足够的教育基础。重点关注学习环境与ICT职业期望变化之间的关系，弥合以往将学习损失、数字技能和职业期望割裂研究的不足。
AI.method: 混合方法分析。采用PISA 2018和2022国家层面数据，结合描述性统计、回归分析、聚类、变分自编码器(VAE)隐表示学习、判别分析和概率建模，整合学生自主性、数字技能和教师支持指标，构建可观测与隐含维度的综合分析框架。
AI.result: ICT职业期望呈全球性但不均衡的增长态势。数字技能是最强且最稳定的预测因子，师资支持发挥补充作用，自主性影响较弱且具有情境依赖性。ICT职业期望具有多维特征，相对独立于其他职业领域演化。
AI.conclusion: ICT职业期望具有多维性，相对独立于其他职业领域发展。数字技能是最强且最一致的预测因素，师资支持起补充作用，自主性影响较弱且具有情境依赖性。教育系统需增强结构性能力以培养学生应对AI驱动的劳动力市场。

title: Benchmarks are Not Enough: RAMP for Runtime Assessing of Agentic Models in Production Systems
summary: LLM agents are rapidly evolving from coding assistants into autonomous software engineering systems. However, existing evaluation methodologies remain largely centered on static, isolated, and short-horizon benchmarks that fail to capture the dynamic complexity of real-world production workflows. As a result, benchmark performance may poorly reflect practical capability under realistic runtime environments involving long execution chains, tool interactions, dependency management, and iterative feedback loops. We thus present RAMP, a production-grounded infrastructure for assessing long-horizon software engineering agents. Built upon the YatCC integrated platform, RAMP provides a unified runtime assessment architecture through standardized orchestration and execution interfaces. RAMP introduces realistic compiler-construction workloads with serial dependencies and complex toolchain interactions, together with a staged recovery mechanism for analyzing execution behavior under partial workflow failure. The framework further incorporates utility-oriented multi-dimensional metrics that jointly evaluate outcome quality and process efficiency. We conduct runtime assessments across 15 mainstream models and observe substantial capability degradation that remains largely invisible to conventional isolated benchmarks. Task completion rates progressively collapse across serial workflows, dropping from 100% in the initial stage to only 20% in the final stage, while none of the evaluated models successfully completes the entire pipeline. Runtime analysis reveals systematic failure propagation and significant resource inefficiencies, with computational costs differing by up to three orders of magnitude among comparable models. These findings suggest RAMP advances agentic model evaluation toward continuous, runtime-observable, and production-grounded assessment.

AI.tldr: RAMP is a production-grounded evaluation infrastructure for assessing long-horizon software engineering LLM agents, built on YatCC. It provides realistic workloads with serial dependencies and complex toolchain interactions, revealing that mainstream models suffer from severe capability degradation across extended workflows (100%→20% completion rate) and exhibit up to 1000x cost variations, highlighting the inadequacy of conventional static benchmarks for real-world agent assessment.
AI.motivation: Existing evaluation methodologies for LLM agents remain centered on static, isolated, and short-horizon benchmarks that fail to capture the dynamic complexity of real-world production workflows. Benchmark performance may poorly reflect practical capability under realistic runtime environments involving long execution chains, tool interactions, dependency management, and iterative feedback loops.
AI.method: Built upon the YatCC integrated platform, RAMP provides a unified runtime assessment architecture through standardized orchestration and execution interfaces. It introduces realistic compiler-construction workloads with serial dependencies and complex toolchain interactions, together with a staged recovery mechanism for analyzing execution behavior under partial workflow failure. The framework incorporates utility-oriented multi-dimensional metrics that jointly evaluate outcome quality and process efficiency. Runtime assessments were conducted across 15 mainstream models.
AI.result: Substantial capability degradation was observed that remains largely invisible to conventional isolated benchmarks. Task completion rates progressively collapse across serial workflows, dropping from 100% in the initial stage to only 20% in the final stage, while none of the evaluated models successfully completes the entire pipeline. Runtime analysis reveals systematic failure propagation and significant resource inefficiencies, with computational costs differing by up to three orders of magnitude among comparable models.
AI.conclusion: RAMP advances agentic model evaluation toward continuous, runtime-observable, and production-grounded assessment, revealing that existing benchmarks significantly overestimate real-world capabilities of LLM agents.

title: Bounded Priority-Aware Locking for Real-Time Kernels
summary: A real-time multicore system requires delay bounds on access to shared resources. These resources include the kernel, which has potentially many non-preemptible critical sections guarded by one or more different synchronization primitives. While primitives such as FIFO locks bound the waiting time to enter a critical section, they do not distinguish the importance of individual tasks competing for shared resource access. To address this, we consider a priority-aware spinlock, which reduces the average delay of more important tasks while maintaining a worst-case bound on lock waiting time. We propose a Batched Priority Lock (BPL) that first groups waiting tasks based on the order of their lock requests, and then determines the next lock holder according to priority within the waiting group. We compare BPL to alternative lock approaches, showing that the average waiting time is reduced for higher priority tasks, in simulations up to 64 cores, and for a working implementation on an 8-core machine with a real RTOS. BPL is a compromise between strict priority and FIFO ordering. While strict priorities may lead to starvation and, hence, unbounded lock acquisition delays, BPL has the same waiting bound as FIFO, but with benefits to higher priority tasks. Although its complexity is greater than that of a simple spinlock, its common case execution overhead is shown to be inexpensive in a working system. We believe this is an acceptable cost in systems that require predictability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向实时多核系统的Batched Priority Lock (BPL)机制，通过在锁请求顺序分组内按优先级选择持有者，实现了对高优先级任务的延迟优化，同时保持与FIFO锁相同的最坏情况等待时间界限，在仿真和实际系统中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有锁原语（如FIFO锁）虽能提供有界的等待时间，但不区分竞争共享资源任务的重要性，无法满足实时多核系统对不同优先级任务延迟保障的需求。
AI.method: 提出Batched Priority Lock (BPL)机制，首先按锁请求顺序将等待任务分组，再在组内按优先级确定下一个锁持有者；通过仿真（最多64核）和实际RTOS实现（8核）进行验证。
AI.result: 仿真结果（最多64核）和实际RTOS实现（8核）均表明，BPL在不增加最坏情况等待时间的前提下，显著降低了高优先级任务的平均等待时间，且常见情况下的执行开销较小。
AI.conclusion: BPL在保持与FIFO相同的最坏情况等待时间界限的同时，有效降低了高优先级任务的平均等待时间，在模拟和实际系统中均验证了有效性，是一种在可预测性要求高的系统中值得接受的折中方案。

title: Identifying and Understanding Human Values in Text: A Tailorable LLM-based Architecture
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Published in Proceedings of the 18th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2026), Volume 5
summary: As intelligent systems become more autonomous, the scientific community focuses on creating decision-making mechanisms that include ethical and moral considerations, unlike traditional utility-maximisation models. To achieve this, a key aspect is assessing how well these decisions align with human values. To this end, a promising line of research is centred on developing approaches based on Large Language Models (LLMs) to identify human values from text, whether explicit or implicit, enabling their recognition throughout. This paper introduces a LLM-based architecture to detect and quantify the intensity of human values in text, avoiding the limitations of previous approaches tied to specific value theory or complex prompt engineering. The architecture comprises three coordinated modules: one that generates structured value specifications from the foundational texts of any theoretical framework; one that labels texts using these specifications; and one that assigns graded support or resistance based on rhetorical and semantic evidence. This modular approach separates the tasks of conceptualising from detecting human values, creating a scalable and reproducible process driven by value specifications adaptable to various theories. The architecture was instantiated with multiple LLMs and evaluated using the ValueEval dataset. The experiments demonstrate good detection performance, confirming the generality of the pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于LLM的三模块架构，用于从文本中检测和量化人类价值观。该架构将价值概念化与检测任务分离，具有可扩展性和可复现性，在ValueEval数据集上表现良好。
AI.motivation: Intelligent systems need ethical/moral decision-making aligned with human values, yet traditional utility-maximization models lack value-alignment mechanisms. A promising approach is using LLMs to identify human values from text (explicit or implicit).
AI.method: A three-module LLM-based architecture: (1) generates structured value specifications from foundational texts of theoretical frameworks; (2) labels texts using these specifications; (3) assigns graded support/resistance based on rhetorical and semantic evidence. Modules are decoupled to separate conceptualization from detection.
AI.result: Good detection performance on ValueEval dataset, confirming the generality of the pipeline across multiple LLMs.
AI.conclusion: The modular architecture demonstrates good detection performance on ValueEval dataset, confirming its generality as a scalable and reproducible process driven by adaptable value specifications.

title: ICG: Improving Cover Image Generation via MLLM-based Prompting and Personalized Preference Alignment
comment: Published in Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, pages 12268-12278, EMNLP 2025. Official version: https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.emnlp-main.617
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models (DMs) have opened new possibilities for AI-generated content. Yet, personalized cover image generation remains underexplored, despite its critical role in boosting user engagement on digital platforms. We propose ICG, a novel framework that integrates MLLM-based prompting with personalized preference alignment to generate high-quality, contextually relevant covers. ICG extracts semantic features from item titles and reference images via meta tokens, refines them with user embeddings, and injects the resulting personalized context into the diffusion model. To address the lack of labeled supervision, we adopt a multi-reward learning strategy that combines public aesthetic and relevance rewards with a personalized preference model trained from user behavior. Unlike prior pipelines relying on handcrafted prompts and disjointed modules, ICG employs an adapter to bridge MLLMs and diffusion models for end-to-end training. Experiments demonstrate that ICG significantly improves image quality, semantic fidelity, and personalization, leading to stronger user appeal and offline recommendation accuracy in downstream tasks. As a plug-and-play adapter bridging MLLMs and diffusion models, ICG is compatible with common checkpoints and requires no ground-truth labels during optimization.

AI.tldr: ICG是一个结合多模态大语言模型和扩散模型的个性化封面图像生成框架，通过元标记提取语义特征、用户嵌入进行偏好对齐、多奖励学习策略优化，实现端到端训练，无需标注数据即可优化，在图像质量、语义一致性和个性化程度上超越现有方法，并改善下游推荐效果。
AI.motivation: 个性化封面图像生成在数字平台用户参与度提升中起着关键作用，但目前研究尚不充分。现有方案依赖手工提示词和多模块独立设计，缺乏端到端优化能力，无法有效捕捉用户个性化偏好，导致生成图像在语义相关性、视觉美学和个性化程度之间难以平衡。
AI.method:
1. **语义特征提取**：通过元标记从商品标题和参考图像中提取语义特征
2. **用户偏好对齐**：利用用户嵌入向量对语义特征进行细化，生成个性化上下文信息
3. **跨模型注入**：将个性化上下文注入扩散模型，指导图像生成过程
4. **多奖励学习策略**：结合公开的美学评分和相关性奖励，以及从用户行为数据训练得到的个性化偏好模型，作为优化信号
5. **端到端训练**：采用适配器模块连接MLLM和扩散模型，实现整体可训练
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ICG框架在图像质量、语义保真度和个性化程度三个核心指标上均实现了显著提升。该改进不仅增强了视觉吸引力，还有效推动了下游推荐任务的离线准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: ICG通过端到端训练和即插即用的适配器设计，成功解决了个性化封面图像生成中的语义一致性、用户偏好匹配和多模块协同等问题，在图像质量、语义保真度和个性化程度三个维度上实现了显著提升，并同时增强了下游推荐任务的离线准确率。

title: Personalized Observation Normalization for Federated Reinforcement Learning in Simulation Environments with Heterogeneity
comment: Accepted at the International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN) 2025
summary: Federated reinforcement learning (FedRL) enables multiple agents to collaboratively train a global policy without sharing raw data, making it ideal for privacy-sensitive applications. However, FedRL faces challenges in heterogeneous environments where differing state-transition dynamics lead to non-identical input distributions and imbalanced parameter updates during aggregation. Therefore, this paper develops a personalized observation normalization (PON) method, allowing each agent to locally normalize raw state inputs using a continuously updated running mean and variance. This design ensures consistent scaling of local feature without overshadowing across agents during aggregation. Furthermore, we demonstrate that sharing normalization parameters across agents is ineffective due to the diverse local input distributions, which highlights the necessity of personalized statistics. Experiments on heterogeneous MuJoCo tasks show that our developed PON accelerates training and achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化观测归一化(PON)方法解决联邦强化学习中因环境异构性导致的输入分布不一致和参数更新不平衡问题，通过本地维护运行均值和方差的持续更新实现一致的局部特征缩放。
AI.motivation: 联邦强化学习在隐私敏感场景中具有优势，但面临环境异构性挑战：不同智能体的状态转移动力学差异导致非相同输入分布，聚合时产生不平衡的参数更新。
AI.method: 开发个性化观测归一化(PON)方法，允许每个智能体使用持续更新的运行均值和方差对原始状态输入进行本地归一化。该设计确保局部特征缩放一致，且不会在聚合过程中被其他智能体覆盖。研究还证明跨智能体共享归一化参数无效，凸显了个性化统计量的必要性。
AI.result: 在异构MuJoCo任务上的实验表明，提出的PON方法能够加速训练并取得优于基线方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 个性化归一化统计量是解决FedRL环境异构性问题的关键设计，PON方法可有效提升异构环境下的学习效率和最终性能。

title: A Deterministic Separation Lemma
summary: The \emph{Separation Lemma} is a simple yet powerful tool, akin to the well-known \emph{Isolation Lemma}, that guarantees the uniqueness of certain set sums. Bandopadhyay et al.\ introduced this lemma to establish lower bounds for the \ALP problem with respect to certain structural parameters, relying on random weight assignments in the process. The lemma's applicability extends well beyond that specific work, especially in proving hardness results. However, while effective, these hardness results inherently rely on probabilistic assumptions. In this work, we give a fully \emph{deterministic} construction for the weight assignment required by the Separation Lemma. We provide formal proofs of correctness, explicit examples, and show how deterministic weights can replace randomized ones, thereby derandomizing existing hardness results for path-packing problems. Our exposition highlights a clear progression from the original randomized foundations to deterministic constructions and their practical implications.

AI.tldr: 本文将分离引理（Separation Lemma）中的随机权重赋值完全确定性化，从而消除了现有硬度结果中的概率假设，成功将路径 packing 问题的硬度结果去随机化。
AI.motivation: 分离引理是 Isolation Lemma 的类似物，可保证某些集合和的唯一性，被广泛用于证明硬度结果。但此前这些硬度结果都依赖概率假设（随机权重赋值），缺乏确定性保证。
AI.method: 作者给出了分离引理所要求的权重赋值的完全确定性构造方法，提供形式化正确性证明，并通过显式示例展示确定性权重如何替代随机权重。
AI.result: 成功将现有路径 packing 问题的硬度结果去随机化，证明了确定性构造可完全替代随机化方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文工作清晰展示了从原始随机化基础到确定性构造的演进路径及其实际意义，为分离引理的进一步应用奠定了更坚实的基础。

title: Towards Cost-effective LLMs Routing with Batch Prompting
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) serving systems must balance task performance against monetary cost. Two prominent optimization techniques have emerged independently: LLM routing, which directs each query to the most cost-effective model in a model pool, and batch prompting, which packs multiple queries into a single invocation to amortize the fixed cost of the shared system prompt. These two techniques are logically complementary; i.e., routing optimizes the model assignment dimension while batching optimizes the query aggregation dimension, jointly reshaping the landscape of model utility and monetary cost. However, existing approaches explore only one side of this decision space. On the basis of empirical studies on their impacts, we are motivated to jointly optimize these two dimensions in this paper. We formulate the Route with Batching Problem, which jointly determines the target model and batch size for each query under a total cost budget, and prove it NP-hard. To solve this challenging problem, we propose RoBatch, a unified two-stage framework. In the modeling stage, RoBatch constructs a batch-aware proxy utility model that decomposes combinatorial utility estimation into utility estimation without batching and recalibration of model-specific utility degradation with batching. In the routing stage, RoBatch employs a greedy scheduling algorithm that progressively upgrades the assignment of the target model and batch size for queries along the cost-utility Pareto frontier until the budget is exhausted. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks across two LLM families (Qwen3 and Gemma3) demonstrate that RoBatch consistently achieves a superior cost-performance Pareto frontier compared with LLM routing and batch prompting baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoBatch框架，联合优化LLM服务中的模型路由和批处理决策。问题被建模为在成本预算下为每个查询联合确定目标模型和批处理大小，并证明为NP难问题。实验验证了该方法在多种场景下能实现更优的成本效益权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM服务系统需要在任务性能与货币成本之间权衡。现有优化技术（模型路由和批处理提示）仅独立探索单一维度，但这两个维度逻辑上互补——路由优化模型分配，批处理优化查询聚合。现有方法未联合优化这两个维度。
AI.method: RoBatch采用两阶段框架。建模阶段构建批感知代理效用模型，将组合效用估计分解为无批处理效用估计和批处理后模型特定效用降解的重新校准。路由阶段采用贪心调度算法，沿成本-效用Pareto前沿逐步升级查询的目标模型和批处理大小，直到预算耗尽。
AI.result: 在六个基准测试和两个LLM家族（Qwen3和Gemma3）上的实验表明，RoBatch相比LLM路由和批处理基线方法，始终实现更优的成本-性能Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: RoBatch通过联合优化模型路由和批处理两个维度，在给定总成本预算下实现了更优的成本-性能Pareto前沿。在Qwen3和Gemma3两个模型家族的6个基准测试中一致优于现有方法，验证了该方法的有效性和通用性。

title: A Methodology to Assess Power Modeling in Energy-Aware Federated Learning on Heterogeneous Mobile Devices
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables, Accepted for publication in the proceedings of Networked Systems (NETYS 2026), Springer Nature
summary: Estimating CPU power on heterogeneous ARM-based commodity devices is challenging due to limited access to CPU's voltage domains. As a result, state-of-the-art energy-aware Federated Learning (FL) frameworks typically rely on simplified approximate power models to estimate computation energy, rather than the more accurate analytical CMOS-based model. To bridge this gap, we propose a reproducible CPU power estimation methodology combined with a rail-to-cluster mapping technique to retrieve cluster-level supply voltage. We evaluate our approach on two commodity Android devices and show that the analytical model predicts CPU power with errors below 10%, whereas the approximate model incurs errors of up to 959%. Using AnycostFL, a state-of-the-art energy-aware FL framework, we show that the analytical model achieves the same 80% model accuracy while consuming 1.4x less energy than the approximate model. These results highlight that approximate models can severely misestimate computation energy and lead to suboptimal decisions. This work facilitates the use of analytical CPU power models on heterogeneous multi-cluster ARM-based mobile SoCs without additional hardware support or external power measurement tools.

AI.tldr: 本文针对ARM异构 commodity设备的CPU功率估计问题，提出解析型CMOS功率模型结合轨到集群映射技术，实测误差从近似模型的959%降至10%以下，并在联邦学习任务中验证了1.4倍能耗节约效果。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习框架依赖简化近似功率模型估计计算能耗，而非更精确的解析型CMOS模型，导致功耗估计严重偏差。
AI.method: 提出了一种可复现的CPU功率估计方法，结合轨到集群映射技术获取集群级电源电压，采用解析型CMOS功率模型替代简化近似模型。
AI.result: 解析模型预测误差低于10%，而近似模型误差高达959%；在AnycostFL框架中，解析模型在保持80%精度的同时，能耗降低1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为异构多集群ARM移动SoC提供了无需额外硬件支持或外部功率测量工具的解析型CPU功率建模方法，强调了精确建模对能耗优化决策的重要性。

title: APS: Bias-Controlled Adaptive Prototype Simulation for Population-Scale LLM Agents
summary: LLM-agent simulation offers a flexible computational tool for studying population response trajectories that depend on scenario events, memory, demographics, and evolving social context. However, full multi-round simulation scales linearly with both population size and horizon, requiring every agent to query the LLM at every round. We propose Adaptive Prototype Simulation (APS), a framework that reframes scalable LLM-based simulation as a recurrent oracle-allocation problem. APS retains the designated LLM as the online transition oracle while querying adaptive core prototypes, selected singleton-tail agents, and shadow-audit agents. Prototype responses induce local response surfaces for nearby agents, reducing online LLM calls without replacing the underlying transition model. To control approximation bias, shadow-audit residual correction estimates propagation residuals for aggregate correction and future budget allocation, while tail-protected singleton routing directly queries selected isolated, heterogeneous, or high-curvature regions that are vulnerable to smoothing. Theoretically, we treat APS as an estimator for full-scale high-precision individual social simulation and decompose its errors into prototype-coverage error, shadow-audit residual-correction error, local-propagation bias, and temporal context mismatch. Under the reported protocols, APS gives lower reference-aligned distributional discrepancy than scale-oriented and same-budget baselines while reducing online LLM calls, with ablations and compact robustness checks diagnosing the main bias-control mechanisms. In a 10M-agent, multi-round public-opinion simulation, APS achieves a 381.1-fold reduction over full simulation, with reference-aligned final-round JSD of 0.094 against the corresponding full-LLM reference.

AI.tldr: APS是一个用于大规模LLM智能体模拟的自适应计算框架，通过原型诱导局部响应面和影子审计残差校正，在保持模拟精度的同时大幅减少在线LLM调用量。
AI.motivation: 全规模多轮LLM智能体模拟的计算成本随人口规模和时间 horizon 线性增长，需要每个智能体在每轮都查询LLM，导致大规模模拟不可行。
AI.method: 自适应原型模拟（APS）框架，将可扩展的LLM模拟重构为递归预言机分配问题。核心策略包括：（1）保留LLM作为在线转移预言机；（2）查询自适应核心原型 selected singleton-tail agents 和 shadow-audit agents；（3）原型响应为邻近智能体诱导局部响应面；（4）影子审计残差校正估计传播残差用于聚合校正和未来预算分配；（5）尾部保护单例路由直接查询孤立、异构或高曲率脆弱区域。误差分解为原型覆盖误差、影子审计残差校正误差、局部传播偏差和时序上下文错配。
AI.result: 在10M智能体多轮公众舆论模拟中，APS实现381.1倍计算减少，最终轮JSD为0.094，参考对齐的分布差异低于规模导向和同预算基线方法。
AI.conclusion: APS在1000万智能体多轮公众舆论模拟中实现381.1倍计算减少，最终轮JSD为0.094，显著优于规模导向和同预算基线方法，同时保持了较低的在线LLM调用量。

title: Will AI be overconfident about academic research findings when reliant on abstracts? (v1)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Gemini seem to be increasingly used for knowledge discovery, information retrieval, and knowledge summaries, including for academic topics. This can result in users being misled, such as due to hallucinations. These problems may be exacerbated for academic knowledge if LLMs base their answers on journal article abstracts when they lack full text access. To test whether the information content of abstracts can be misleading, full text articles were submitted to the GPT-OSS 120B, an LLM from OpenAI, asking it to assess separately the strength the claims for the main result in the abstract, discussion, and conclusion. Outside the social sciences and humanities, claims tended to be stronger in the abstract and conclusions than the discussion, suggesting that relying on the strength of claims in abstracts would be misleading. Thus, if LLMs ingest abstracts but not full texts, there is a risk that they will be overconfident about the findings and pass it on to users in response to relevant prompts. This is another reason to be cautious about using LLMs for academic-related knowledge discovery and summaries.

AI.tldr: This paper demonstrates that journal article abstracts often present stronger claims than the discussion sections, suggesting that LLMs relying solely on abstracts may propagate overconfident and potentially misleading academic summaries to users.
AI.motivation: LLMs like ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Gemini are increasingly used for academic knowledge discovery, but risk misleading users through hallucinations, especially when relying on journal article abstracts without full text access.
AI.method: Full text articles were submitted to GPT-OSS 120B (an OpenAI LLM), which was asked to assess the strength of claims separately for the main result in three sections: abstract, discussion, and conclusion.
AI.result: Outside the social sciences and humanities, claims were consistently stronger in abstracts and conclusions than in the discussion sections, indicating that relying on abstracts would lead to overestimation of findings.
AI.conclusion: LLMs should not be blindly trusted for academic-related knowledge discovery, as their reliance on abstracts alone can lead to overconfident and misleading responses.

title: Human-AI Collaboration for Estimating Scientific Replicability
summary: Determining whether published scientific findings can successfully be replicated is a long-standing challenge in the empirical sciences. Existing approaches for replicability assessment typically rely either on human judgment, i.e., creative assembly of human experts, or on machine learning models trained on paper content metadata. While both approaches have demonstrated value, each also has important limitations. Human forecasts can be influenced by cognitive biases and narrow exposure to the research literature, while automated assessments often struggle to capture contextual cues and subtle signals of credibility. In this paper, we examine a hybrid approach. Specifically, we introduce a hybrid prediction market in which algorithmic agents trade alongside human participants to jointly estimate the likelihood that a published scientific finding will be corroborated via the outcome of a controlled replication study. Agents are trained on outcomes from hundreds of prior replication studies while human participants contribute domain knowledge through real-time trading. We evaluate this hybrid approach through multiple live experiments involving participants from different academic disciplines and compare its performance to artificial-only and human-only baselines. Our results show that, except for a few cases, hybrid markets match or outperform artificial prediction markets, producing more accurate and reliable replication forecasts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合预测市场方法，将算法代理与人类参与者相结合，用于预测已发表科学发现能否被复制验证。研究通过多轮实时实验评估了该方法，结果表明混合市场在准确性和可靠性方面优于或持平于纯人工和纯人类基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有复制性评估方法存在局限：人工预测受认知偏差和文献接触面窄的影响，而自动化评估难以捕捉上下文线索和可信度的细微信号。
AI.method: 构建混合预测市场，将算法代理与人类参与者结合进行实时交易；代理基于数百个先前复制研究的结果进行训练，人类参与者贡献领域知识。
AI.result: 混合市场在大多数情况下与人工预测市场表现相当或更优，产生了更准确可靠的复制预测。
AI.conclusion: 混合市场在大多数情况下表现与人工预测市场相当或更优，能够产生更准确可靠的复制预测结果。

title: LLM Based Web Accessibility Repair: An Empirical Study of Detection, Remediation, and Cost
summary: Ensuring web accessibility at scale remains challenging because rule-based tools provide limited coverage while manual remediation is costly and error-prone. This paper evaluates large language model based agents, specifically Kimi K2.5, for automated accessibility detection and repair compared with rule-based approaches. For detection, the LLM achieves performance comparable to rule-based tools, with F1 around 0.65, strong semantic understanding with F1 of 0.83, but lower reliability for syntactic and layout-related violations. For remediation, LLM-generated fixes are syntactically valid in over 99.7 percent of cases and improve accessibility compliance in 80.2 percent of instances, reducing violations from 3.98 to 1.7 per file. However, fewer than 26 percent of cases are fully resolved, and about 30 percent of patches introduce structural changes. We also find that iterative agent-based refinement increases computational cost by 52 percent and API usage by 1.64 times without improving remediation outcomes. These findings indicate that while LLMs are effective for partial accessibility repair, they are insufficient for complete and reliable remediation. Scalable accessibility solutions require hybrid approaches that combine LLM capabilities with rule-based validation and constraint-aware correction mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了LLM代理(Kimi K2.5)用于Web无障碍自动化检测与修复的效果。研究发现LLM在语义理解方面表现优异，修复后的语法有效率达99.7%，但完全修复率不足26%，且迭代优化反而增加成本却不提升效果，表明LLM目前无法独立实现可靠的无障碍修复，需结合规则验证才能实现规模化应用。
AI.motivation: 基于规则的工具覆盖范围有限，手动修复成本高且易出错，亟需更有效的自动化解决方案
AI.method: 对比LLM代理(Kimi K2.5)与基于规则的工具，评估自动化无障碍检测与修复能力
AI.result: 检测：LLM与规则工具性能相当(F1≈0.65)，语义理解强(F1=0.83)，但句法和布局违规检测较弱。修复：语法有效率99.7%，无障碍合规提升率80.2%，但完全解决率<26%，约30%补丁引入结构性变更。迭代细化增加52%计算成本和1.64倍API使用但未改善修复效果
AI.conclusion: LLMs缺乏完整可靠的修复能力，需结合规则验证和约束感知纠正机制才能实现规模化无障碍解决方案

title: Soro: A Lightweight Foundation Model and Chatbot for Tajik
summary: We present Soro, a family of Tajik-specialized conversational large language models (LLMs) designed for real-world deployment under tight compute and connectivity constraints in Tajikistan. Starting from open-weight Gemma 3 checkpoints, we perform Tajik-only continual pretraining on a curated 1.9-billion-token corpus spanning filtered web text, PDF documents, and curriculum-aligned educational materials, followed by supervised instruction tuning on 40K Tajik teacher-style examples. To enable rigorous evaluation despite the limited coverage of Tajik in standard benchmarks, we introduce a suite of Tajik benchmarks covering general knowledge, linguistic competence, and school- and university entrance-exam domains, and we open-source them on Hugging Face. Across these Tajik benchmarks, Soro substantially outperforms same-size Gemma 3 baselines while retaining strong English performance on standard datasets. We further show that FP8 and INT4 quantization of Soro preserves most Tajik-language gains while reducing memory requirements for edge deployment, supporting an ongoing education-sector pilot and planned scale-out across schools in Tajikistan.

AI.tldr: Soro is a Tajik-specialized LLM family built from Gemma 3 checkpoints through continual pretraining and instruction tuning, featuring custom Tajik benchmarks, strong performance gains over baselines, and quantized deployment for edge scenarios in Tajikistan's education sector.
AI.motivation: Real-world deployment in Tajikistan requires Tajik-specialized models under tight compute and connectivity constraints, with limited standard benchmark coverage for Tajik evaluation.
AI.method: Tajik-only continual pretraining on a 1.9B-token curated corpus (web text, PDFs, educational materials), followed by supervised instruction tuning on 40K Tajik teacher-style examples.
AI.result: Soro substantially outperforms same-size Gemma 3 baselines on Tajik benchmarks while retaining strong English performance; quantization (FP8/INT4) preserves most Tajik gains with reduced memory requirements.
AI.conclusion: Soro substantially outperforms same-size Gemma 3 baselines on Tajik benchmarks while retaining strong English performance, and FP8/INT4 quantization preserves most Tajik gains for edge deployment.

title: LCO: LLM-based Constraint Optimization for Safer Agentic LLMs in Real-world Tasks
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly acting as autonomous agents, but their continuous interaction with the environment can lead to in-context reward hacking (ICRH), a phenomenon where LLMs iteratively optimize their behavior to maximize proxy objectives, inadvertently producing harmful side effects. Existing defense methods are insufficient to address this risk, as ICRH arises not from adversarial inputs but from the model's own over-optimization. To mitigate this issue, we propose \textbf{LLM-based Constraint Optimization (LCO)}, a framework that effectively reduces ICRH without model fine-tuning. LCO consists of two modules: \textit{self-thought module}, which guides the LLM to proactively deliberate and integrate potential safety constraints before execution; and \textit{evolutionary sampling module}, which employs LLM-based crossover and mutation to constrain the model's actions within a safe solution space while maintaining task performance. Experimental results demonstrate that LCO substantially alleviates ICRH in both output-refine and policy-refine scenarios. In particular, on the tweet engagement optimization task, LCO achieves a 39% reduction in the Toxicity Growth Rate (TGR) on GPT-4, while on the policy optimization benchmark, it reduces the ICRH Occurrence Rate by 15.23%, demonstrating safety improvement without sacrificing task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM自主代理中的上下文奖励黑客(ICRH)问题，提出无需微调的LCO框架，通过自思考模块和进化采样模块引导模型在执行前整合安全约束，并利用LLM驱动的交叉变异将行为约束在安全空间。实验证明该方法能显著降低ICRH风险，同时保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM作为自主代理与环境持续交互时，会产生“上下文奖励黑客"(ICRH)现象——LLM迭代优化行为以最大化代理目标，意外产生有害副作用。现有防御方法不足以应对此风险，因为ICRH并非源于对抗性输入，而是源于模型自身的过度优化。
AI.method: 提出LLM-based Constraint Optimization (LCO)框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 自思考模块(self-thought module)，引导LLM在执行前主动思考并整合潜在安全约束；2) 进化采样模块(evolutionary sampling module)，利用基于LLM的交叉和变异操作，将模型行为约束在安全解空间内，同时维持任务性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LCO在输出优化和策略优化两种场景下均有效缓解了ICRH。具体而言，在推文参与度优化任务中，LCO使GPT-4的毒性增长率(TGR)降低39%；在策略优化基准测试中，ICRH发生率降低15.23%，且未牺牲任务性能。
AI.conclusion: LCO框架通过无微调方式有效降低了ICRH风险，在保持任务性能的同时显著提升了安全性。

title: IGADA-IoT: IoT Sensor Energy Optimization in Wireless Sensor Networks Driven by Automatic Data Augmentation
summary: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), data augmentation is a novel method to improve sampling-frequency decision performance, thereby enabling energy optimization for IoT (Internet of Things) sensors. However, existing methods rely on a single generator and empirically determined quantities, failing to establish a mapping between dynamic information gaps and multiple generators, and overlooking the heterogeneity of generated samples. Moreover, an evaluation and a closed-loop method that jointly considers the information gap and the model performance are lacking. To address these issues, we propose an information gap-guided IoT sensor automatic data augmentation framework (IGADA-IoT) with hierarchical multi-generator collaboration and scheduling over multiple rounds. Capabilities of different generators are jointly utilized to reduce the information gaps. In the IGADA-IoT, a hierarchical multi-generator collaboration and scheduling strategy (HMGCS) is proposed to enhance the targetedness and rationality of generated sample allocation. An information gap-model performance joint evaluation and closed-loop method (IGMP-EC) is proposed to enhance the accuracy of augmentation decisions, and to mitigate the risks of under-augmentation and over-augmentation. Experimental results show that the IGADA-IoT improves the average accuracy of multiple downstream models by 7.27%. Compared with advanced data augmentation methods, the average accuracy is improved by 8.67%. Compared with the individual generators, the average accuracy is improved by 7.24%. Furthermore, public IoT sensor datasets from the UCR Archive and real-world deployments demonstrate the accuracy and generalizability of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 针对物联网传感器数据增强中的信息差距和异质性问题，提出基于分层多生成器协作调度和闭环评估的IGADA-IoT框架，通过多轮迭代和多生成器联合优化，有效提升了模型准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖单一生成器且经验性确定数量，未能建立动态信息差距与多生成器之间的映射，且忽略了生成样本的异质性。此外，缺乏联合考虑信息差距和模型性能的评估与闭环方法。
AI.method: 提出分层多生成器协作调度策略(HMGCS)以增强生成样本分配的针对性和合理性；提出信息差距-模型性能联合评估与闭环方法(IGMP-EC)以增强增强决策准确性并缓解欠增强和过增强风险。
AI.result: IGADA-IoT使多个下游模型的平均准确率提升7.27%；与先进数据增强方法相比平均准确率提升8.67%；与单个生成器相比平均准确率提升7.24%。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层多生成器协作调度策略和信息差距-模型性能联合评估闭环方法，显著提升了多个下游模型的准确率，在UCR档案数据集和实际部署中验证了其准确性和泛化能力。

title: High-Quality Multi-Constraint Hypergraph Partitioning via Greedy Rebalancing
summary:
Multi-constraint hypergraph partitioning is a generalization of balanced partitioning, where the vertex set of a hypergraph is partitioned such that the inter-block connectivity of hyperedges is minimized while balancing the vertices with regard to $d$ distinct constraints. A prominent class of applications is data distribution tasks, where this allows to achieve good load balance for $d$ different kinds of resources and simultaneously minimize the communication volume.
  Although the best approaches for single-constraint partitioning are usually complex (multilevel) algorithms with many components, we show that replacing only one component already leads to high-quality multi-constraint partitions: the rebalancing step, which restores balance for a partition that has (hopefully) small connectivity but violates the constraints. We design a multi-constraint rebalancing algorithm based on greedy local search, proving that balance is always restored for $d=2$ and bounded maximum weight. The key is to ensure monotonically decreasing global imbalance by choosing an imbalance metric where there is always a balance-improving move available. Integrating our algorithm into the state-of-the-art partitioner Mt-KaHyPar, we demonstrate an 11.5\,\% geometric mean connectivity reduction compared to the next best competitor (Metis) and better reliability regarding partition balance, even though the majority of inputs is outside of the theoretical guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多约束超图划分问题，提出一种基于贪心局部搜索的重平衡算法。核心创新在于选择保证单调递减的不平衡度量，从而总有平衡改善移动可用。集成到Mt-KaHyPar后，在连接性优化和平衡可靠性上均优于Metis。
AI.motivation: 多约束超图划分是平衡划分的推广，可同时最小化超边块间连接性和满足d个不同约束的资源负载均衡。现有单约束划分算法（如多级算法）虽复杂，但仅需替换重平衡组件即可获得高质量多约束划分。
AI.method: 提出基于贪心局部搜索的多约束重平衡算法，通过选择具有单调递减全局不平衡度的失衡度量来保证总有平衡改善移动存在。对于d=2和有限最大权重的情况，数学上证明了平衡总能恢复。
AI.result: 实验表明，与Metis相比，几何平均连接性降低11.5%，划分平衡可靠性更优，尽管大多数输入超出理论保证范围。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多约束重平衡算法集成到Mt-KaHyPar中，实现了比Metis更高的划分质量（连接性降低11.5%）和更好的平衡可靠性。

title: Discovery Agents for Real-Time Analytics: Toward Proactive Insight Systems
comment: Accepted at Supporting Our AI Overlords (SAO) at the ACM Conference on AI and Agentic Systems (CAIS), May 26 2026, San Jose, CS, USA
summary: Modern analytics systems are fundamentally reactive, requiring users to define queries over increasingly complex and continuously evolving data. In real-time streaming environments, this paradigm breaks down, as the space of potential insights becomes too large to enumerate manually. We present a multi-agent architecture for autonomous insight discovery over real-time data streams. The system implements a continuous discovery loop in which agents generate hypotheses, compile them into executable analytics, validate generated artifacts, and produce visualizations and deployable applications. The architecture leverages Apache Kafka for event-driven coordination, Apache Flink for stream processing, and large language models to implement specialized agents. A key contribution is a contract-driven design based on typed intermediate artifacts, enabling modularity, observability, lineage, and safer execution of dynamically generated analytics. Through use cases in retail, finance, and public data, we show how this architecture supports a shift from query-driven analytics to proactive, discovery-driven systems.

AI.tldr: This paper presents a multi-agent system combining LLMs with Kafka and Flink to autonomously discover insights from real-time data streams, replacing reactive query-driven analytics with a proactive, discovery-driven approach using contract-based typed artifacts for modularity and safety.
AI.motivation: Traditional analytics systems are fundamentally reactive, requiring users to manually define queries over complex and continuously evolving data. In real-time streaming environments, this paradigm becomes impractical because the space of potential insights is too large to enumerate manually.
AI.method: The paper proposes a multi-agent architecture implementing a continuous discovery loop consisting of four stages: hypothesis generation, compilation into executable analytics, artifact validation, and visualization/application production. The system leverages Apache Kafka for event-driven coordination, Apache Flink for stream processing, and large language models as specialized agents. A key technical contribution is a contract-driven design based on typed intermediate artifacts.
AI.result: The proposed architecture was validated through use cases in three domains: retail, finance, and public data. These demonstrations show how the system supports autonomous insight discovery without manual query definition.
AI.conclusion: The contract-driven design with typed intermediate artifacts enables modularity, observability, lineage, and safer execution of dynamically generated analytics. The architecture successfully demonstrates a paradigm shift from reactive query-driven analytics to proactive, discovery-driven systems.

title: Carbon-Aware Mapping and Scheduling for Deadline-Constrained Workflows
comment: 29 pages, 11 figures, Preprint, to appear at Euro-Par'26
summary: As datacenters continue to grow in scale, their energy consumption and resulting carbon footprint have become pressing concerns. With the increasing share of renewable energy in a datacenter's mixed energy supply, shifting task execution to periods of high green-power availability is a promising strategy to reduce carbon emissions. However, in heterogeneous computing environments, the power consumption of compute nodes in a datacenter can also vary. In practice, workloads submitted to datacenters are often not isolated tasks, but entire workflows consisting of interdependent tasks with precedence constraints. A further challenge arises from the fact that carbon emission reductions must typically be achieved under strict workflow deadlines. In this work, we show that the problem posed by these challenges for the scheduler is NP-hard and admits no constant-factor approximation even for the uni-processor case. Motivated by this hardness, we present a novel algorithm CWM that combines carbon-aware mapping and scheduling to construct feasible solutions. Our approach integrates dynamic programming with efficient heuristics to exploit renewable energy availability and infrastructure heterogeneity. To assess the quality of the new algorithm, we evaluate it against the state-of-the-art approach CaWoSched and show that CWM achieves significant reductions in terms of carbon emissions in experiments. In particular, we are able to achieve a median carbon cost reduction of 42% over the best version of CaWoSched when the deadline is two times the makespan of a carbon-agnostic baseline. Note that CaWoSched itself already reduces the carbon-agnostic baseline by 36%.

AI.tldr: 针对数据中心碳感知调度问题，提出NP难且不存在常数因子近似算法的形式化问题证明，并设计CWM算法通过动态规划与启发式方法结合实现碳减排，相较现有最优方法CaWoSched提升42%。
AI.motivation: 数据中心规模扩大导致能源消耗和碳足迹问题日益严峻；工作负载通常为具有优先级约束的相互依赖工作流；需在严格的工作流期限约束下实现碳排放减少。
AI.method: CWM算法将动态规划与高效启发式算法相结合，集成碳感知映射与调度，以利用可再生能源可用性和基础设施异构性。
AI.result: 实验表明CWM相比CaWoSched实现显著碳排放降低，基准期限为基准线makespan两倍时中位数碳成本降低达42%。
AI.conclusion: CWM算法显著优于现有最优方法CaWoSched，在基准期限为基准线makespan两倍时可实现42%的碳成本降低（CaWoSched相比碳无关基准线已降低36%）。

title: Speed-Weighted Adaptive Flocking for Sailing Swarms under Dynamic Environmental Forcing
comment: Submitted at 18th International Conference on the Simulation of Adaptive Behavior (SAB 2026)
summary: Collective behavior models, such as aggregation and flocking, usually assume self-propelled robots that can directly execute their desired speed and direction of motion without fundamental constraints. However, autonomous sailing robots violate this assumption. Their motion is shaped by wind-dependent propulsion, restricted headings, and spatially varying wind conditions. In particular, maneuverability is coupled to wind speed: in weak wind, sailboats may turn only slowly or not at all, whereas stronger wind enables faster turns. This introduces transient heterogeneity in speed and maneuverability across the flock. We focus on this fast-slow coordination problem in sailing robot flocks. To study this problem, we introduce SailSwarmSwIM, a reduced-order simulator for autonomous sailing robot swarms that captures wind-dependent speed and maneuverability, no-go zones, tacking behavior, and steady or gusty wind fields. To design our novel flocking technique, we start from the Couzin model and introduce a speed-weighted social interaction rule that accounts for each robot's transient motion constraints. A key result is that increasing the social influence of slower robots improves polarization and reduces close encounters. This effect arises from a balance between attraction to fast neighbors, which helps maintain movement, and cohesion around slow neighbors, which prevents the flock from fragmenting. Together, our simulator, SailSwarmSwIM, and the speed-weighted interaction rule provide a modeling framework for studying adaptive collective behavior in robotic fleets whose motion capabilities are continuously shaped by wind.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses the flocking problem for autonomous sailing robots whose motion is constrained by wind conditions. The authors introduce SailSwarmSwIM simulator and a speed-weighted interaction rule that gives slower robots greater social influence, improving overall flock polarization and reducing collisions.
AI.motivation: Traditional collective behavior models assume direct execution of desired motion without constraints. However, autonomous sailing robots face wind-dependent propulsion, restricted headings, and spatially varying wind conditions, leading to transient heterogeneity in speed and maneuverability across the flock—a fast-slow coordination problem not addressed by existing models.
AI.method: The authors develop SailSwarmSwIM, a reduced-order simulator capturing wind-dependent speed/maneuverability, no-go zones, tacking behavior, and wind fields. They modify the Couzin model by introducing a speed-weighted social interaction rule that accounts for each robot's transient motion constraints, giving slower robots greater social influence.
AI.result: Increasing the social influence of slower robots improves polarization and reduces close encounters. This effect arises from balancing attraction to fast neighbors (maintaining movement) and cohesion around slow neighbors (preventing fragmentation).
AI.conclusion: SailSwarmSwIM simulator combined with speed-weighted interaction rule provides a comprehensive modeling framework for studying adaptive collective behavior in robotic fleets whose motion capabilities are continuously shaped by environmental factors like wind.

title: Ocean4Rec: Offline LLM-Derived OCEAN Profiles for Request-Time VOD Reranking
summary: Industrial video-on-demand (VOD) recommenders need richer content understanding, but LLM-as-reranker designs repeat prompt construction, token generation, model invocation, output parsing, and fallback handling for each request. In high-volume latency-sensitive services, these request-time operations complicate throughput planning, tail-latency control, capacity isolation, and predictable operation. This paper presents Ocean4Rec, a reranking layer that uses an LLM only offline to materialize item OCEAN profiles from content metadata. Items are mapped into Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism scores, while user profiles are built by time-decayed aggregation of recently clicked and deep-linked items in the same five-dimensional space. At request time, Ocean4Rec joins precomputed item profiles, user profiles, base recommender scores, and catalog recency, then performs numeric reranking without an LLM call. On anonymized Samsung Smart TV VOD logs, same-candidate Top1000 temporal-holdout offline evaluations show that Ocean4Rec improves NDCG@20 over a stronger non-OCEAN Base+Recency ordering by 7.6% for an NCF generator and 61.5% for a LightGCN generator. HR@20 is inconclusive for NCF and improves by 67.3% for LightGCN, reflecting sparse exact-item replay labels and the strength of recency as an industrial baseline. The result should be read as offline replay evidence for a bounded auxiliary content-taste feature that preserves the deployability advantage of a request-time-LLM-free serving path.

AI.tldr: Ocean4Rec提出将LLM仅用于离线提取项目的OCEAN(大五人格)特征，用户画像通过时间衰减聚合构建，在线服务完全无需LLM调用即可实现高效数值重排序，在三星智能电视数据上显著提升NDCG@20指标。
AI.motivation: 工业视频点播推荐系统需要更丰富的内容理解能力，但现有的LLM即重排序器设计为每个请求重复执行提示构建、令牌生成、模型调用、输出解析和回退处理，在高吞吐量、延迟敏感的服务场景下，这些请求时操作使得吞吐量规划、尾延迟控制、容量隔离和可预测操作变得复杂。
AI.method: Ocean4Rec采用离线LLM+在线数值排序的混合架构：(1)离线阶段：利用LLM从内容元数据中提取项目OCEAN特征(Big Five人格特质：开放性、尽责性、外向性、宜人性、神经质)，通过时间衰减聚合用户最近点击和深度链接项目的特征向量构建用户画像；(2)在线阶段：仅执行预计算特征(项目OCEAN、用户OCEAN、基础推荐分数、目录时效性)的连接与数值重排序，完全无需LLM调用。
AI.result: 在匿名化三星智能电视VOD日志上，使用相同候选集Top1000时间窗口保留的离线评估：相比Base+Recency基线，NDCG@20提升7.6%(NCF生成器)和61.5%(LightGCN生成器)；HR@20对NCF不显著，但LightGCN提升67.3%。HR@20结果受限于稀疏的精确项目回放标签和时效性作为工业基线的强劲表现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了离线回放证据，证明OCEAN特征作为一种有界的辅助内容-品味特征，能够保持请求时无LLM调用的部署优势，为工业级推荐系统提供了一种平衡内容理解深度与线上服务效率的可行方案。

title: Informing AI Policy Assessment using Large-Scale Simulation of Interventions
comment: This work will be published in the proceedings of the ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT) 2026. 15 pages plus end matter and appendix
summary: As the rapid proliferation of AI systems and harms spurs efforts in AI governance around the world, prioritizing among competing policy options has become increasingly challenging for policymakers and researchers. We introduce a methodology for identifying viable policy options to mitigate specified AI harms, helping policymakers and researchers target areas that warrant greater time and resource investment. This method combines participatory evaluation of policies, expert assessment of implementation costs, and an LLM-based assessment of perceived harm mitigation under each policy option. We leverage a genetic algorithm-based simulation study to explore a vast solution space of potential policy combinations, and examine how outcomes change under different weightings of cost, participatory input, and harm mitigation. We find that this method enables exploration of different balances between participatory and expert components, allowing policymakers and researchers to assess how much weight to assign to each. We argue that the diversity of viable policy combinations found by the genetic algorithm could be a useful starting point for deliberation. This method operationalizes existing work on participatory AI by integrating it directly into practical policy development pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个用于识别减轻特定AI危害的可行政策选项的方法论。该方法结合了参与式政策评估、专家实施成本评估以及基于LLM的危害减轻评估，并通过遗传算法模拟探索广阔的政策组合方案空间。研究发现该方法能够平衡参与式评估与专家评估的不同权重，为政策制定者提供多样化的可行政策组合选项。
AI.motivation: As AI systems and their associated harms proliferate rapidly, efforts in AI governance are increasing worldwide. However, policymakers and researchers face significant challenges in prioritizing among competing policy options, necessitating a systematic approach to identify viable policy options for mitigating specified AI harms.
AI.method: The proposed methodology combines participatory evaluation of policies, expert assessment of implementation costs, and an LLM-based assessment of perceived harm mitigation under each policy option. The study leverages a genetic algorithm-based simulation to explore a vast solution space of potential policy combinations, examining how outcomes change under different weightings of cost, participatory input, and harm mitigation.
AI.result: The method enables exploration of different balances between participatory and expert components, allowing policymakers and researchers to assess how much weight to assign to each. The genetic algorithm identifies diverse viable policy combinations that could serve as useful starting points for deliberation.
AI.conclusion: This method operationalizes existing work on participatory AI by integrating it directly into practical policy development pipelines. The diversity of viable policy combinations found by the genetic algorithm could serve as a useful starting point for deliberation.

title: Confident Learning-based Network for Detecting Bug-Inducing Commits on SZZ with Noisy Labels
summary: The Just-In-Time (JIT) defect prediction model serves as a critical tool for ensuring the quality of software development and enhancing software performance. It assists development teams in promptly identifying and addressing potential issues by predicting whether code submissions may introduce defects. However, due to the existence of data noise and insufficient semantic connections in real-world scenarios, existing approaches face challenges in accurately identifying the code commits that introduce defects and capturing the potential semantic relationships. To address these challenges, we propose the BIC- Hunter(Bug-Inducing Commits Hunter) model, which mitigates data noise and improves semantic understanding, thereby enhancing the accuracy of bug-inducing commit identification. BIC - Hunter model consists of two components: a data denoising component and a semantic relationship capturing component. Specifically, the data denoising component addresses the challenges posed by inaccurate annotations and inconsistencies in real-world data, enhancing the reliability of training data and improving overall model robustness. The semantic relation- ship capturing component constructs homogeneous graphs and applies graph convolutional networks to facilitate a more comprehensive analysis of code context, enabling the identification of defects caused by code commits and enhancing the confidence in pinpointing their root causes. Experimental studies on a large-scale dataset integrated from three open-source datasets show that BIC- Hunter exhibits outstanding performance. BIC- Hunter outperforms the state-of-the-art by 6.16%, 7.13%, and 5.53% on Recall@1, Recall@2, and Recall@3, respectively, while the MFR index increases by 8.43% to 32.82%. These results demonstrate the superior capability of our method in identifying bug-inducing commits.

AI.tldr: BIC-Hunter是一种用于JIT缺陷预测的新型模型，通过数据去噪和基于GCN的语义关系捕获两大组件解决真实场景中的数据噪声和语义连接不足问题，实验表明其在多个指标上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的JIT缺陷预测模型在真实场景中面临两个主要挑战：1）数据噪声问题；2）语义连接不足。这导致模型难以准确识别引入缺陷的代码提交，难以捕获潜在的语义关系。
AI.method: 提出BIC-Hunter模型，包含两个核心组件：1）数据去噪组件：处理不准确标注和数据不一致问题，提高训练数据可靠性和模型鲁棒性；2）语义关系捕获组件：构建同构图并应用图卷积网络(GCN)进行代码上下文分析，识别代码提交引入的缺陷并定位根因。
AI.result: 在整合自三个开源项目的大规模数据集上，BIC-Hunter在Recall@1、Recall@2、Recall@3上分别超越最优方法6.16%、7.13%、5.53%，MFR指标提升8.43%至32.82%。
AI.conclusion: BIC-Hunter通过数据去噪和语义关系捕获两个组件，有效解决了JIT缺陷预测中的数据噪声和语义连接不足的问题，在大规模数据集上取得了显著的性能提升（Recall@1/2/3分别提升6.16%/7.13%/5.53%，MFR提升8.43%-32.82%），证明了该方法在识别bug-inducing提交方面的优越性。

title: On the Origin of Synthetic Information by Means of Steganographic Inheritance
summary: The origin of species has been the mystery of mysteries in natural science. By analogy, the origin of synthetic information, we suggest, is the mystery of mysteries in information science. The question carries a moral weight that a technical account can neither fully resolve nor responsibly ignore, as its impact on truth, trust, and human intellect extends deep into the broader economy and society. The very power of artificial intelligence makes the evolutionary lineage of synthetic information grow ever harder to trace, for a sufficiently capable model may generate offspring that bear little resemblance, at either the structural or signal level, to the parent source from which they were derived. As in genetics, two individuals may share the same phenotype mirroring each other in outward appearance, yet differ fundamentally in their genotype. We propose, by means of steganography, a mechanism analogous to heredity. At the moment an offspring is reproduced, a projector derives a trait from the parent, and a steganographic encoder invisibly hides it within the offspring. This trait persists throughout the offspring's life cycle in a cyber ecosystem. When parentage is queried, a steganographic decoder extracts the trait from the offspring and compares it against the traits of candidate parents in a reference pool, thereby nominating the most likely one. A theoretical analysis characterises phylogenetic accuracy as a function of projector and stegosystem properties, whilst empirical evaluations across multiple projectors and stegosystems demonstrate the viability of the proposed methodology under a broad spectrum of processing operations and semantic modifications. We envision a cyber ecosystem in which synthetic information, endowed with hidden yet traceable lineage traits, branches from a simple beginning into endless forms that have been, and are being, evolved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用隐写术在AI生成内容中嵌入可追溯的亲本特征，类比遗传学中的 heredity 机制，实现合成信息的溯源追踪。
AI.motivation: AI生成合成信息的能力日益强大，但其溯源问题难以解决，类似于遗传学中表型相同但基因型不同的情况。这涉及道德、真相、信任和人类智能等社会重大问题，需要负责任的技术解决方案。
AI.method: 使用隐写术（steganography）在AI生成内容中嵌入亲本特征：投影器从亲本提取特征→隐写编码器将特征嵌入子代→解码器提取特征并与候选亲本池比对以溯源亲本。
AI.result: 理论分析建立了投影器和隐写系统特性与系统发育准确度的关系；实验评估证明所提方法在多种投影器、隐写系统以及各种处理操作和语义修改下均具有可行性。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种基于隐写术的类遗传机制，通过在AI生成内容中嵌入可追溯的亲本特征，实现合成信息的溯源追踪。理论分析和实验验证均证明了该方法在多种处理操作下的可行性，为构建可追溯的网络生态系统奠定基础。

title: Unlocking Fine-Grained and Within-Utterance Speaking Style Control in Prompt-Based Text-to-Speech Models
summary: While prompt-based text-to-speech (TTS) models enable natural language-driven speaking style control, they often provide limited fine-grained control and apply a single global style across an utterance. This restricts practical use cases that require continuous style attribute interpolation across utterances and time-varying style transitions within a single utterance. In this paper, we propose novel techniques to achieve both capabilities in existing prompt-based TTS models. For inter-utterance style interpolation, we compute direction vectors between contrastive style prompts in the embedding space and perform simple interpolation, enabling smooth transitions between style characteristics. For intra-utterance style transition, we first identify a strong attention bias toward early tokens in autoregressive TTS decoders, causing the initial audio realization to dominate subsequent generation. To mitigate this effect, we introduce KV-cache swapping and sliding-window attention masking. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed inter-utterance interpolation achieves a 99-100% success rate in gender conversion, up to 36 Hz pitch variation, and up to 1.6 syllables-per-second speed change. Our intra-utterance transition maintains a speaker similarity of 0.81-0.91 and achieves perceptual smoothness scores of 3.48-4.48.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有基于提示的TTS模型风格控制粒度不足的问题，提出两种新技术：(1) 话语间风格插值，通过嵌入空间方向向量实现风格平滑过渡；(2) 话语内风格转换，通过KV-cache交换和滑动窗口注意力掩码解决自回归解码器中早期token主导问题。实验表明该方法在性别转换、音高/语速变化等指标上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的TTS模型存在两个局限：(1) 风格控制粒度有限；(2) 对整个话语应用单一全局风格，无法满足需要在话语间进行连续风格属性插值以及在单个话语内实现时变风格转换的实际应用需求。
AI.method: 针对话语间风格插值：计算对比风格提示在嵌入空间中的方向向量，并进行简单插值操作。针对话语内风格转换：识别自回归TTS解码器中早期token存在强注意力偏差的问题，引入KV-cache交换和滑动窗口注意力掩码来缓解该效应。
AI.result: 话语间插值：性别转换成功率达99-100%，音高变化最高达36Hz，语速变化最高达1.6音节/秒。话语内转换：说话人相似度达0.81-0.91，感知平滑度评分达3.48-4.48。
AI.conclusion: 该方法解决了现有基于提示的TTS系统中风格控制粒度不足的问题，实现了两项核心能力：(1) 话语间风格插值：通过对对比风格提示在嵌入空间计算方向向量并进行插值，实现风格特征的平滑过渡；(2) 话语内风格转换：通过KV-cache交换和滑动窗口注意力掩码技术，抑制自回归解码器对早期token的过度依赖，从而实现单句内的时变风格控制。

title: A Simple State Space Model Excels at Multivariate Time Series Classification
summary: Structured state space models (SSMs) have recently emerged as a promising foundation for sequence modeling, with Mamba-based architectures demonstrating strong performance through input-dependent state transitions, albeit at considerable complexity. However, their application to time-series classification (TSC) has been largely limited to Mamba-style architectures, leaving the broader SSM design space underexplored. We present the first systematic study spanning diagonal SSMs (S4D) and input-dependent SSMs (Mamba family) on large-scale TSC benchmarks, asking whether such complexity is necessary for top performance. Our results reveal a surprising finding: S4D consistently outperforms Mamba-based variants in both accuracy and efficiency, challenging the assumption that increased complexity translates to meaningful gains in TSC. Building on this, we introduce MS4, lightweight modifications to S4D via a linear input projection and channel-mixing mechanism, and MS4N, a normalized variant that stabilizes state dynamics with negligible overhead. Evaluated on 59 datasets across MONSTER (up to 60 million samples, 50K timesteps, 82 classes) and the UEA benchmark, against 15 baselines, MS4 and MS4N consistently outperform Mamba-based models while remaining more efficient, and MS4N matches or surpasses competing deep learning models that are roughly 2x and 10x larger in parameters. These results position lightweight structured SSMs as a compelling alternative to scaling complexity for TSC.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统比较了用于时间序列分类的S4D与Mamba系列SSM，颠覆性地发现更简单的S4D反而优于更复杂的Mamba；在此基础上提出轻量化改进MS4/MS4N，在59个数据集、15个基线模型上验证了其优越性，为时间序列分类提供了一条"轻量化优于复杂化"的新路径。
AI.motivation: 现有SSM在时间序列分类中的应用主要局限于Mamba风格架构，更广泛的SSM设计空间未被充分探索，且存在一个核心问题：增加复杂度是否真的能带来性能提升？
AI.method: 在MONSTER（6000万样本，5万时间步，82类）和UEA基准的59个数据集上，对比了S4D与Mamba系列；提出了MS4（线性输入投影+通道混合机制）和MS4N（归一化变体以稳定状态动力学）。
