AI.result: S4D在准确率和效率上均一致性地超越Mamba变体；MS4和MS4N持续优于Mamba模型且效率更高；MS4N以更小参数规模达到与参数量大2-10倍模型相当的效果。
AI.conclusion: MS4N可与参数规模大2-10倍的深度学习模型相媲美，轻量化结构化SSM是时间序列分类中复杂度扩展的有力替代方案。

title: A Query Engine for the Agents
summary: The fastest-growing data in production today is unstructured text: agent traces, chat logs, reasoning chains, model outputs. People want to analyze it, and the questions worth asking ("show me where the agent got confused") cannot be answered by SQL alone, since text is not queryable without a model in the query path. The natural place this analysis is happening is the new class of AI applications (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, in-browser agents) that run client-side and host both a human user and an LLM agent in the same process. These applications increasingly want to work with data, but the lakehouse read path has been hard to use from a JS runtime: Spark, Trino, and managed warehouses do not fit there. To build this new kind of AI data application, three properties of the engine become first-order: a JS-native distribution that drops into the runtime the application already runs in, a bundle small enough to ship inside a cold tab or per-turn agent sandbox, and a way to interleave analytic operators with model-based interpretation of text. We present Hyperparam, three open-source JavaScript libraries (Hyparquet, Squirreling, Icebird) totaling under 70 KB, that read Parquet and Apache Iceberg directly from object storage and meet the third property with per-cell, async-native SQL execution, so expensive cells fire only when downstream operators demand them. Squirreling runs LLM-shaped async UDFs over 300x faster than DuckDB-WASM on filter-bounded queries (and 192x on sort-bounded queries) and completes a ten-task agent analyst suite at two-thirds lower cost. We argue that data engineering as a discipline needs to update for the AI-native client applications now in production and the agents that work alongside their users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Hyperparam——三个总计不足70KB的JavaScript开源库，能够直接从对象存储读取Parquet和Iceberg数据，通过单元格级异步SQL执行实现高效处理，在查询速度和成本上显著优于现有方案，旨在为AI原生客户端应用提供轻量级数据引擎。
AI.motivation: 当前增长最快的生产数据是非结构化文本（智能体追踪、聊天日志、推理链、模型输出），现有SQL无法独立回答此类文本分析问题；新型AI应用（Claude Code、Cursor等）在客户端运行，传统的Spark、Trino等数据仓库方案无法适配JavaScript运行时环境。
AI.method: 提出了Hyperparam系统，包含三个开源JavaScript库（Hyparquet、Squirreling、Icebird，总计不足70KB），能够直接从对象存储读取Parquet和Apache Iceberg格式数据，并采用单元格级异步原生SQL执行，使得昂贵操作仅当下游操作符需要时才触发。
AI.result: 在过滤有界查询上比DuckDB-WASM快300倍，排序有界查询快192倍；十任务智能体分析师套件的成本降低三分之二。
AI.conclusion: 数据工程领域需要为现在投入生产的AI原生客户端应用及协同工作的智能体进行更新和适配。

title: SOLANET: Distributed Neighbor Graph Construction on GPU-Accelerated Systems
summary:
Neighbor graphs capture relationships among data points and are widely used in data analytics and AI workloads. Many studies have explored approximate construction methods for single-node systems, including GPUs. However, extending this to distributed systems for larger data and further acceleration remains challenging due to irregular computation patterns.
  We present SOLANET, a GPU-accelerated distributed neighbor graph construction toolkit. SOLANET first constructs local graphs on each GPU after data partitioning and then refines them via approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) searches over remote graphs pulled from other GPUs using MPI one-sided operations. SOLANET also provides a lock-free single-GPU neighbor graph construction algorithm for AMD GPUs.
  Our single-GPU implementation outperforms a state-of-the-art GPU-based approximate neighbor graph construction implementation across multiple datasets on a single MI300A APU. Furthermore, SOLANET demonstrates 11X speedup from 32 to 512 APUs for 1 billion data points and 6.9x speedup from 64 to 512 APUs for 2 billion points.

AI.tldr: SOLANET是一个GPU加速的分布式邻居图构建工具包，通过本地图构建+远程ANN搜索的两阶段方法解决了分布式系统中邻居图构建的效率和扩展性问题，在AMD MI300 APU上验证了性能和线性扩展能力。
AI.motivation: 邻居图在数据分析和AI工作负载中广泛使用，但现有方法主要针对单节点GPU系统，在扩展到分布式系统处理更大规模数据时面临挑战，主要障碍是计算模式的不规则性。
AI.method: SOLANET采用两阶段方法：1) 通过数据分区在每个GPU上构建本地图；2) 使用MPI单边操作从其他GPU拉取远程图并通过近似最近邻(ANN)搜索进行精炼。同时提供了面向AMD GPU的无锁单GPU邻居图构建算法。
AI.result: 单GPU实现方面，在单块MI300 APU上多个数据集上均优于现有最先进的GPU近似邻居图构建方法。分布式扩展方面：1B数据点从32到512 APUs实现11倍加速；2B数据点从64到512 APUs实现6.9倍加速。
AI.conclusion: SOLANET successfully enables efficient GPU-accelerated distributed neighbor graph construction for large-scale data workloads.

title: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Modeling for Measurement and Network Analysis of the Data Service Market
summary: With the increasing complexity of collaboration among various social entities and user demands, the factors affecting the stable development of the data service market are also growing. These factors include the widespread dissemination of information enhancing subjective consciousness, the continuous improvement in intelligence, and the complexification of structural relationships. To achieve effective governance and regulation of the data service market, it is crucial to conduct simulation experiments before making regulatory decisions. However, current research and analysis of the data service market primarily focus on data-level performance, proving inadequate when it comes to measurement and analysis of multiple heterogeneous entities and the integration of various social elements within the data service market. Based on this, this paper innovatively proposes a data service market measurement and network analysis method based on heterogeneous multi-agent modeling. By introducing the service ecosystem theory, we clarify the participants and external factors of the data service market and conduct utility measurements for three-level entities based on value creation. Furthermore, an analytical methodology is devised to precisely assess the influence of heterogeneous networks on utility. Finally, the paper verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method through the analysis of experimental results.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses the inadequacy of current data service market research, which focuses only on data-level performance. It proposes a novel heterogeneous multi-agent modeling approach combined with service ecosystem theory to measure and analyze heterogeneous entities and social elements in the data service market for effective governance and regulatory decision-making.
AI.motivation: Current research on data service market analysis focuses primarily on data-level performance, which proves inadequate for measuring and analyzing multiple heterogeneous entities and integrating various social elements within the data service market.
AI.method: The paper proposes a data service market measurement and network analysis method based on heterogeneous multi-agent modeling. It introduces service ecosystem theory to clarify participants and external factors, conducts utility measurements for three-level entities based on value creation, and develops an analytical methodology to assess the influence of heterogeneous networks on utility.
AI.result: The paper verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method through experimental results analysis.
AI.conclusion: This paper contributes a novel heterogeneous multi-agent modeling framework for data service market measurement, which addresses the limitations of traditional data-level performance analysis and provides a systematic approach for regulatory decision-making in complex data service ecosystems.

title: FD-RAG: Federated Dual-System Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a paradigm for grounding large language models in external knowledge, yet most existing RAG systems assume centralized knowledge access and ample computation. These assumptions break down in edge environments, where knowledge is fragmented across devices, raw data cannot be shared, and repeated LLM calls are prohibitively expensive. We propose FD-RAG, a federated dual-system RAG framework that decouples lightweight memory access from on-demand LLM reasoning for decentralized deployment. Specifically, FD-RAG learns semantic-aware adaptive hypergraphs over local corpora and distills them into compact QA memories. At inference time, it answers well-covered queries via direct memory matching and invokes LLM-based reasoning only when necessary, while tracing retrieved memories to hypergraph-grounded evidence. To mitigate cross-device knowledge fragmentation, FD-RAG aggregates anonymized memories across devices without exposing raw documents. Experiments on QA benchmarks show that FD-RAG improves accuracy by up to 7.8\% while reducing latency by 8.4$\times$ compared with strong local and federated baselines. We also provide theoretical analysis establishing an $\mathcal{O}(1/ε^{2})$ convergence rate for the proposed hypergraph learning, supporting its tractable deployment in edge settings.

AI.tldr: FD-RAG是一种联邦双系统RAG框架，通过语义感知自适应超图和知识蒸馏技术，在保护数据隐私的前提下实现边缘环境下的高效问答，在准确率和延迟上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统依赖中心化知识访问和充足算力，而边缘环境存在知识碎片化、原始数据无法共享、LLM调用成本高等挑战，限制了RAG在边缘场景的部署。
AI.method: FD-RAG采用双系统架构：学习语义感知的自适应超图覆盖本地语料库，并将其蒸馏为紧凑的问答记忆；在推理时，通过直接记忆匹配处理覆盖良好的查询，仅在必要时调用LLM，并通过超图溯源检索记忆对应的证据。跨设备聚合时使用匿名化记忆，避免暴露原始文档。
AI.result: 在QA基准测试中，FD-RAG相比强基线方法准确率提升最高达7.8%，延迟降低8.4倍，同时实现了理论O(1/ε²)的收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: FD-RAG成功实现了一个适用于边缘环境的联邦RAG框架，通过自适应超图学习和知识蒸馏，在保持数据隐私的同时显著提升了准确率并降低了延迟。理论分析证明了O(1/ε²)的收敛速率，为边缘部署提供了可扩展性保障。

title: Agentic Literacy Debt: A Structural Problem the AI Literacy Field Has Not Yet Named
summary: Autonomous AI agents now plan, decide, and act on behalf of users across healthcare, financial services, and workplace contexts, often without step-by-step human approval. Existing AI literacy frameworks were built for a world in which humans evaluate AI outputs and decide whether to act; they have no vocabulary for the user who has delegated decision-making authority to an agent whose actions may not be observable, reversible, or controllable. This paper names the resulting problem agentic literacy debt: the accumulating societal deficit that grows when agentic AI systems are deployed at scale without corresponding literacy infrastructure. The debt compounds through three reinforcing channels (normalization of opaque delegation, multi-agent ecosystem complexity, and institutional path dependence), and it is incurred by the organizations that deploy agents but paid by the users, patients, and citizens on whose behalf the agents act. Evidence from healthcare, financial fraud, and global equity contexts suggests the gap is already consequential. The problem is structural, not a temporary lag that curriculum reform will close. It demands a reframing of AI literacy as a governance capability, not an evaluative one.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"智能体素养债务"（agentic literacy debt）概念，指智能体AI系统大规模部署却缺乏相应素养基础设施所积累的社会性亏欠。该债务通过三条通道复合增长：模糊委托的正常化、多智能体生态系统复杂性、制度路径依赖。
AI.motivation: 当前AI素养框架诞生于人类评估AI输出的时代，缺乏对委托决策权给不可观察、不可逆、不可控智能体的语境描述能力
AI.method: 概念命名与框架构建，识别三条强化通道，跨领域案例验证（医疗、金融欺诈、全球公平）
AI.result: 该差距已产生实际后果；债务由部署机构承担，由用户/患者/公民承受
AI.conclusion: 问题具有结构性特征，非课程改革所能解决；需将AI素养从评估能力重新定位为治理能力

title: Tool Forge: A Validation-Carrying Toolchain for Governed Agentic Execution
summary:
Large language model agents are increasingly expected to perform operational work: calling APIs, manipulating files, assembling workflows, and acting inside enterprise systems. Yet the tool layer on which this execution depends is still commonly treated as either a hand-written integration artifact or a static list of schemas exposed to a model. This paper introduces Tool Forge, a validation-carrying toolchain for converting natural-language capability intent into governed, sandbox-verified, cataloged tool artifacts and exposing those artifacts to agents through a token-efficient routing layer.
  Tool Forge treats a tool as a capsule containing intent, capability contract, implementation, dependency policy, tests, documentation, runtime validation evidence, lifecycle state, credential bindings, and routing metadata. It also introduces a Router that exposes intent-scoped tool sessions instead of loading full catalog schemas into the model context. We describe the system architecture, validation pipeline, MCP-facing routing model, governance controls, and initial reproducible benchmarks from the open-source implementation.
  Across 83 Router benchmark cases, Tool Forge Router achieves aggregate micro-F1 of 0.901 while reducing estimated task-flow tool context by 99.2% relative to naive full-catalog schema exposure. In a 25-case end-to-end generation probe over local-tool tasks, Tool Forge generates 25 of 25 tool bundles, reaches micro-F1 of 0.940 against deterministic acceptance checks, and passes 23 of 25 live sandbox validations. These results are presented as an initial systems benchmark, not as a state-of-the-art claim. The paper identifies remaining challenges in adversarial routing, broader API grounding, sandbox isolation, and cross-system evaluation.

AI.tldr: Tool Forge是一个验证承载的工具链系统，将自然语言能力意图转化为治理的、沙箱验证的、编目的工具制品。通过引入包含多维元数据的"工具胶囊"模型和意图作用域路由机制，该系统显著减少模型上下文负担并提升工具生成准确性，为LLM代理的操作执行提供可验证、可治理的框架。
AI.motivation: LLM代理需执行操作工作（调用API、操作文件、组装工作流等），但其依赖的工具层仍被视作手工集成工件或静态schema列表，这限制了代理的可靠性和可扩展性。
AI.method: Tool Forge采用"工具胶囊"模型整合意图、能力契约、实现、依赖策略、测试、文档、运行时验证证据、生命周期状态、凭证绑定和路由元数据；引入Router组件暴露意图作用域的工具会话而非加载完整目录schema；构建了验证管道、MCP路由模型和治理控制机制。
AI.result: Router基准测试（83例）：聚合micro-F1达0.901，工具上下文减少99.2%。端到端生成探针（25例）：成功生成25个工具束，micro-F1达0.940，23/25沙箱验证通过。
AI.conclusion: 本文作为初始系统基准测试，识别了对抗路由、更广泛API对接、沙箱隔离和跨系统评估等方面的剩余挑战。研究强调Tool Forge不是SOTA声称，而是为LLM代理工具层提供可验证、可治理框架的初步探索。

title: DynaSchedBench: Calibrated Dynamic Scheduling Benchmarks and Observability Paradox in LLM-based Scheduling Agents
summary: Progress in neural combinatorial optimization for Dynamic Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (DFJSP) is currently hindered by a methodological tension: static benchmarks encourage benchmark overfitting, while uncalibrated generators obscure algorithmic capability with stochastic noise. To resolve this, we introduce \textbf{DynaSchedBench}, a diagnostic framework for DFJSP that rigorously controls the instance-generation process. Instead of relying on parameter sampling, our approach utilizes Sequential Event-Space Calibrator (SESC) that computes a novel Schedule Stress Index (SSI) to stratify instances by difficulty. We demonstrate that SESC is substantially more computationally efficient than evolutionary baselines while converging reliably to the target metrics. The framework integrates modular components for instance generation, snapshot-based simulation, agents, evaluation, and visualization, thereby enabling rigorous testing of reactive and lookahead-based policies. Leveraging this calibrated environment, we identify key limitations of LLM-based scheduling agents. Specifically, in step-wise online decision-making for dynamic scheduling, we identify an ``Observability Paradox'': providing agents with oracle access to full structural information can degrade policy performance, underperforming concise information. Furthermore, despite substantial token overhead, tool-augmented and refinement strategies fail to reliably improve performance, and most LLM agents fail to consistently surpass strong dispatching baselines-behaving more like robust heuristic approximators than superior optimizers.

AI.tldr: DynaSchedBench is a diagnostic framework for Dynamic Flexible Job Shop Scheduling that uses Sequential Event-Space Calibrator (SESC) with Schedule Stress Index (SSI) for controlled instance generation, revealing that LLM-based scheduling agents underperform strong dispatching baselines and suffer from an "Observability Paradox" where excessive information degrades decision-making quality.
AI.motivation: Current neural combinatorial optimization methods for DFJSP suffer from a tension between static benchmarks that encourage overfitting and uncalibrated generators that introduce stochastic noise, obscuring true algorithmic capabilities.
AI.method: Sequential Event-Space Calibrator (SESC) that computes a novel Schedule Stress Index (SSI) to stratify instances by difficulty; modular framework with components for instance generation, simulation, agents, evaluation, and visualization.
AI.result: SESC is computationally efficient compared to evolutionary baselines while reliably converging to target metrics; identified key limitations of LLM agents including the "Observability Paradox" where oracle access to full structural information degrades performance compared to concise information.
AI.conclusion: LLM agents function more like robust heuristic approximators than superior optimizers; tool-augmented and refinement strategies fail to reliably improve performance; the framework enables rigorous testing of scheduling policies.

title: RAG-Coding: Enhancing LLM Medical Coding with Structured External Knowledge
comment: Additional experiments and analyses are in progress
summary: We present RAG-Coding, an agentic method for automated ICD-10-CM coding. RAG-Coding orchestrates four large language model (LLM) agents and grounds their coding decisions in external knowledge sources (e.g. the official coding tabular list and guidelines). By retrieving and cross-referencing relevant knowledge in these sources, the agents enhance coding accuracy and ensure clinical compliance. On the MDACE dataset, RAG-Coding outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 8-13\% in micro-F1 and 2-8\% in macro-F1 across multiple LLM backbones. Compared to the state-of-the-art pretrained language model method, PLM-ICD, RAG-Coding exhibits higher micro recall (+11\%), while PLM-ICD exhibits higher micro precision (+6\%), yielding comparable micro- and macro-F1. Ablations show stepwise gains, highlighting the importance of incorporating external knowledge. We also release MDACE-2025, updating the original dataset with expert re-annotations with the latest 2025 ICD-10-CM guidelines. This update features more fine-grained code labels and enables evaluation against current clinical standards.

AI.tldr: 提出RAG-Coding方法，利用4个LLM智能体通过检索官方ICD-10-CM知识源实现自动医学编码，在多LLM后端上均优于现有基线，并发布更新至2025年指南的MDACE-2025数据集。
AI.motivation: ICD-10-CM编码需要高准确性和临床合规性，现有方法在整合外部医学知识方面存在不足。
AI.method: 采用多智能体架构，由4个LLM智能体协同工作，通过检索和交叉引用官方编码表及指南中的相关知识进行编码决策，实现检索增强生成。
AI.result: RAG-Coding在MDACE数据集上相比最佳LLM基线提升微F1值8-13%、宏F1值2-8%；相比PLM-ICD具有更高微召回率(+11%)但精确率较低(+6%)，总体F1相当。消融实验证实外部知识的逐步增益。
AI.conclusion: RAG-Coding通过整合外部知识显著提升编码准确性，MDACE-2025数据集更新为最新临床标准提供了评估基准。

title: $E^3$-Agent: An Executable and Evolving Agent for Resource Management of Edge Generative Inference
summary: Edge deployments of generative inference increasingly face two practical realities: per-device per-model performance is often unknown at deployment time, and it is non-stationary due to user-driven semantic events, background load, and device churn. Consequently, a resource manager that is tuned offline under a fixed regime can become brittle and expensive to maintain. This paper presents $E^3$-Agent, an executable and evolving agent for edge artificial intelligence generated content (AIGC) resource management. $E^3$-Agent separates a fast-path router that makes millisecond-level dispatch decisions from a slow-path, event-driven large language model (LLM) meta-controller that mitigates regime shifts through a small, explicit control surface exposed via a tool interface, including risk gating, router configuration, and rapid performance calibration. The agent learns online from execution feedback and continuously adapts to unknown and time-varying service-time mappings. We evaluate $E^3$-Agent in a discrete-event simulator driven by MLPerf-derived device-model measurement priors, covering cold-start warmup and three dynamic regimes: semantic dynamics, device churn, and hidden drift. Across the dynamic scenarios, $E^3$-Agent reduces average latency by 65%-73% compared to the best static baseline, stays within 7%-10% of an online full-information Oracle used for evaluation, and effectively suppresses stutter rate under semantic degradation.

AI.tldr: E³-Agent是一种用于边缘AIGC资源管理的可执行、可持续演化的智能体，通过快路径路由器（毫秒级调度决策）和慢路径LLM元控制器（通过工具接口暴露风险门控、路由器配置、性能校准等控制面）分离设计，结合在线学习实现对未知时变服务时间映射的持续适应。实验表明该方法相比最优静态基线降低平均延迟65%-73%，逼近在线全信息Oracle性能（7%-10%差距），并有效抑制语义降级下的卡顿率。
AI.motivation: 边缘生成推理部署面临两个现实挑战：(1) 部署时设备-模型性能通常未知；(2) 性能随用户语义事件、后台负载、设备变动等因素呈现非平稳性。这导致离线调优的资源管理器变得脆弱且维护成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出E³-Agent，采用快慢路径分离架构：(1) 快路径路由器负责毫秒级分发决策；(2) 慢路径事件驱动LLM元控制器通过工具接口（风险门控、路由器配置、性能快速校准）暴露小型显式控制面，缓解制度偏移。智能体从执行反馈中在线学习，持续适应未知和时变的服务时间映射。
AI.result: 在MLPerf衍生的设备-模型测量先验驱动的离散事件模拟器中评估，覆盖冷启动预热及三种动态场景（语义动态、设备变动、隐藏漂移）。结果显示：平均延迟相比最优静态基线降低65%-73%；与在线全信息Oracle相比差距在7%-10%以内；在语义降级下有效抑制卡顿率。
AI.conclusion: E³-Agent通过分层架构与在线自适应机制，成功解决了边缘AIGC资源管理中的性能未知性和非平稳性难题，在动态环境下实现接近最优Oracle的性能，同时具备可解释性和鲁棒性。

title: Building Community-Centred NLP Resources for Puno Quechua
comment: Sixth Workshop on NLP for Indigenous Languages of the Americas (AmericasNLP 2026), co-located with ACL 2026
summary: The preservation of under-resourced languages requires digital tools and resources shaped by and for their speakers. We present the first dedicated ASR resources for Puno Quechua (ISO 639-3: qxp): (1) the largest speech corpus for any single Quechua variety, consisting in 66 hours of recordings for scripted and spontaneous speech (including 36 hours of manually transcribed and validated data), collected via a participatory design campaign; (2) the first systematic ASR benchmark for Puno Quechua, evaluating state-of-the-art models and fine-tuning Whisper-base, wav2vec2-base, and XLS-R-300M, with and without continued pre-training (CPT); (3) an open release of all datasets and fine-tuned models.

AI.tldr: 本文为普诺克丘亚语（克丘亚语族中最大的语言变种）构建了首个专属ASR资源，包括最大的单一克丘亚语变种语音语料库（66小时）、首个系统性ASR基准测试（含Whisper、wav2vec2、XLS-R等模型评估），并开源所有数据集和微调模型，为该低资源语言的数字化保存提供完整解决方案。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的数字化保存面临语料和技术资源匮乏的挑战，亟需针对特定语言社区需求设计的数字工具和资源。
AI.method: 通过参与式设计活动（participatory design）收集语料，建立包含66小时录音的最大规模单一克丘亚语变种语音语料库（含36小时人工转录验证数据），并对Whisper-base、wav2vec2-base和XLS-R-300M三种先进模型进行微调实验，评估是否采用持续预训练（CPT）的效果差异。
AI.result: 建立了66小时语音语料库（含36小时转录数据），发布了首个普诺克丘亚语ASR基准测试，对比了有无CPT条件下多模型的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为普诺克丘亚语（QXP）提供了首个完整的ASR工具链，从数据资源到模型基准测试再到开源模型，为该濒危语言的数字化保存奠定了基础。

title: Addressing Variable Heterogeneity in Distributed Multimodal Training with Entrain
summary: Multimodal LLM datasets are inherently heterogeneous, with significant data variability. Although each modality exhibits independent variability, sample-level entanglement makes it difficult to balance workloads across both modalities and batches. We present Entrain, a distributed MLLM training framework that addresses both heterogeneity and variability in multimodal training workloads. Entrain challenges the intuition that dynamic data variability requires dynamic model parallelism by shifting the profiling paradigm from micro-level samples to macroscopic batches. We prove that a single, static model-parallel configuration suffices for optimal load balancing under this paradigm. At the microscopic scale, Entrain introduces a hierarchical microbatch assignment algorithm that defers excess workload within each iteration to stabilize variability across microbatches. Evaluations show that Entrain reduces workload variability across microbatches by up to 10.6$\times$, improving end-to-end training throughput by up to 1.40$\times$ over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: Entrain是一个分布式多模态LLM训练框架，通过将剖析范式从微观样本转移至宏观批次，证明了静态模型并行配置足以实现最优负载均衡；其层级微批次分配算法可降低负载变异性10.6倍，提升训练吞吐量1.40倍。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型训练数据存在固有异质性与显著变异性，各模态虽有独立变化，但样本级纠缠导致跨模态和批次间的负载均衡极为困难。
AI.method: (1) 将剖析范式从微观样本级转移至宏观批次级；(2) 证明单一静态模型并行配置即可实现最优负载均衡；(3) 引入层级微批次分配算法，在迭代内延迟处理超额负载以稳定微批次间变异性。
AI.result: 微批次间负载变异性降低最高10.6倍，训练吞吐量提升最高1.40倍（相较于基线方法）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将分析粒度从微观样本提升至宏观批次，证明静态模型并行配置足以实现最优负载均衡；层级微批次分配算法有效抑制了批内负载波动，从而提升端到端训练吞吐量。

title: AgensFlow: A Coordination-Policy Substrate for Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproducible evaluations available at: https://github.com/Nicolepcx/AgensFlow
summary:
Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) require many coordination choices that are difficult to fix a priori: which skill protocol to invoke, which agent role should perform a subtask, which model to bind to each role, how roles should interact, when to use retrieval or verification, and when to omit a step entirely. These choices interact with task regime and operational constraints, so static pipelines and one-off model comparisons provide only a limited view of the design space. This paper introduces AgensFlow, an open-source framework that treats multi-agent coordination as an online policy-learning problem under partial observability. The framework makes coordination decisions observable and learnable from repeated trajectories, rather than treating skill, role, model, topology, and evaluation choices as fixed pipeline design.
  AgensFlow is evaluated on two corpora: distributed-systems incident tasks and security-advisory tasks. The evaluation shows three main results: learned routing reaches a higher-quality operating point than a fixed pipeline baseline on coordination-heavy classes; skip:X isolates topology compression as a meaningful part of the substrate; and warm-started policy graphs can reduce exploration cost while preserving plateau quality. Overall, the results support that learned, auditable routing can improve coordination-heavy multi-agent workflows over static wiring.

AI.tldr: AgensFlow框架将多智能体协调建模为在线策略学习问题，使协调决策可学习。实验表明学习的路由策略在协调密集型任务上优于静态管道。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统面临诸多难以预先确定的协调选择问题，包括技能协议调用、智能体角色分配、模型绑定、角色交互、检索/验证策略选择以及步骤省略等。这些选择与任务域和操作约束相互影响，现有静态管道和一次性模型比较仅提供有限的设计空间视图。
AI.method: 提出AgensFlow开源框架，将多智能体协调建模为部分可观测条件下的在线策略学习问题，使协调决策可观察、可从重复轨迹中学习，而非将技能、角色、模型、拓扑和评估选择视为固定管道设计。在分布式系统事件任务和安全公告任务两个语料库上评估。
AI.result: 三大主要发现：1）在协调密集型任务类别上，学习路由达到比固定管道基线更高质量的运行点；2）skip:X隔离出拓扑压缩作为基质的有效组成部分；3）热启动策略图可降低探索成本同时保持 plateau 质量。
AI.conclusion: 学习的、可审计的路由策略可优于静态连接方式，提升协调密集型多智能体工作流的性能。

title: RE-TRIANGLE: Does TRIANGLE Enable Multimodal Alignment Beyond Cosine Similarity in Retrieval?
summary: Multimodal alignment is critical for bridging the semantic gap in information retrieval. However, traditional pairwise strategies introduce a geometric blind spot: while they align anchor modalities (e.g., text) with others, they lack constraints to enforce mutual consistency between peripheral modalities (e.g., video and audio). The TRIANGLE framework addresses this by minimizing the area of modality triplets on a hypersphere to enforce holistic alignment. In this reproducibility study, we verify the robustness of this geometric objective for retrieval tasks. We confirm that TRIANGLE outperforms pairwise baselines in zero-shot settings, achieving Recall@1 gains of up to +8.7 points, though benefits are domain-dependent. However, we fail to reproduce the reported learning-from-scratch results. Analysis using a synthetic toy dataset attributes this to instability when jointly optimizing geometric alignment with Data-Text Matching (DTM) loss. Furthermore, we find that cosine regularization primarily stabilizes text-to-video retrieval, and fine-tuning with domain supervision amplifies geometric benefits but reduces cross-dataset generalization. Our findings support the efficacy of geometric alignment while highlighting critical optimization sensitivities. Code available at https://github.com/ARIJIT00171/RE-TRIANGLE.

AI.tldr: 本文是可复现性研究，验证了TRIANGLE框架中基于超球面三角面积最小化的几何对齐方法。实验确认了其在零样本检索中的优势（+8.7 Recall@1），但未能复现从头训练的结果，并揭示了联合优化几何目标与DTM损失时的不稳定性，以及领域监督与跨数据集泛化之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 传统成对对齐策略存在"几何盲点"：虽然能对齐锚模态（如文本）与其他模态，但缺乏对周边模态（如视频和音频）之间相互一致性的约束机制。这限制了多模态信息检索系统的语义完整性。
AI.method: 采用TRIANGLE框架，通过最小化超球面上模态三元组的面积来实现整体对齐。同时使用合成玩具数据集进行可控实验，隔离DTM损失与几何对齐联合优化的不稳定根源。
AI.result: 【成功复现】零样本设定下TRIANGLE优于成对基线，Recall@1提升高达+8.7个百分点，但收益具有领域依赖性。【复现失败】从头学习的结果未能复现。归因于几何对齐与DTM损失联合优化时的不稳定性。进一步发现：余弦正则化主要稳定文本到视频检索；领域监督微调虽放大了几何收益，但降低了跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TRIANGLE的几何对齐方法是有效的，但其效果受优化敏感性的显著影响。领域监督微调虽然能放大几何收益，但会损害跨数据集泛化能力。研究强调了将几何对齐目标与训练动态结合时需要谨慎优化策略。

title: Democratizing Generative AI for Sustainable Competitive Advantage
comment: Paper presented at BIG AI @ MIT, 2026. This conference has no publication
summary: As generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) diffuses across industries and becomes broadly accessible, the locus of sustainable competitive advantage shifts from technology ownership toward the quality of employee-level adoption and use. This paper develops a cross-level conceptual framework linking firm-level GenAI investment and governance to individual-level AI democratization, defined as the extent to which employees meaningfully, responsibly, and effectively use GenAI in their daily work. We argue that individual-level AI democratization, grounded in three micro foundations (AI usefulness, ease of use, and AI literacy), mediates the relationship between organizational GenAI investments and sustainable competitive advantage. Drawing on the technology acceptance model, resource-based theory, and emerging empirical evidence on AI productivity effects, we advance six propositions linking perceived usefulness, ease of use, AI literacy, responsible use, and innovation outcomes to organizational transformation and sustained relative performance. The framework provides a measurement scaffold for empirical research and offers managerial guidance on treating GenAI as augmentation infrastructure rather than solely as automation. We conclude by outlining future research directions, including longitudinal and cross-cultural investigations of literacy, governance, and transformation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个跨层次概念框架，将企业级GenAI投资与治理、员工级AI民主化（定义为员工在日常工作中有意义、负责任、有效使用GenAI的程度）与可持续竞争优势相联结。核心主张是：个体层面的AI民主化（基于有用性、易用性、AI素养三个微观基础）在组织GenAI投资与可持续竞争优势之间起中介作用。研究基于技术接受模型、资源基础理论，结合AI生产力效应的实证证据，提出六个命题。
AI.motivation: 随着GenAI在各行业广泛扩散，竞争优势的来源正从技术所有权转向员工层面的采用质量。如何将组织层面的GenAI投资转化为个体层面的有效使用，进而实现可持续竞争优势，亟待理论框架指导。
AI.method:
跨层次概念框架构建：
- 宏观层面：企业GenAI投资与治理
- 微观基础（中介）：AI有用性感知、易用性感知、AI素养
- 个体层面结果：负责任使用、创新成果
- 组织层面结果：组织转型、可持续相对绩效

理论基础：技术接受模型(TAM)、资源基础理论(RBT)
AI.result: 提出六个命题，建立“投资→民主化→竞争优势”的理论逻辑链，识别AI素养为关键调节/中介变量。
AI.conclusion: GenAI应被视为“增强基础设施”而非单纯的自动化工具；强调负责任使用的重要性；呼吁开展AI素养、治理与转型动态的纵向与跨文化研究。

title: DeltaMCP: Incremental Regeneration via Spec-Aware Transformation for MCP servers
summary: The rapid development of LLMs coupled with the introduction of Model Context Protocol (MCP) has revolutionized how intelligent agents interact with APIs through deterministic and structured methods \cite{ModelContextProtocolIntro2025}. While some existing systems like AutoMCP attempt to automate a previously completely manual process of generating MCP servers, they fail to address the recurring challenge of maintaining synchronization between evolving enterprise-level APIs and their corresponding MCP toolset implementation \cite{mastouri2025makingrestapisagentready}. This paper introduces DeltaMCP, a specification-aware, incremental regeneration tool for enterprise-grade MCP servers. DeltaMCP enables developers to only update the affected tooling of MCP servers, given a new release of it's corresponding service's OpenAPI specification. Using Azure REST API specifications as the evaluation dataset, DeltaMCP is benchmarked against baseline full generation methods on generation quality and system performance. The results demonstrate the reduction in developer overhead through DeltaMCP whilst improving maintainability and version consistency. This research offers a scalable approach for enterprises seeking to maintain high-fidelity, up-to-date MCP server infrastructures for LLM-based systems.

AI.tldr: DeltaMCP是一个规范感知的增量式MCP服务器再生工具，通过分析OpenAPI规范变更，仅更新受影响组件，从而降低企业MCP服务器维护负担。
AI.motivation: 当前企业级API与MCP工具集实现之间存在同步维护问题。现有系统（如AutoMCP）虽尝试自动化MCP服务器生成流程，但未能有效解决API演化过程中工具集的增量更新挑战，导致开发者维护负担持续加重。
AI.method: DeltaMCP采用增量生成策略，基于OpenAPI规范的变更集，仅更新受影响的MCP服务器组件，而非完全重新生成。实验使用Azure REST API规范作为评估数据集，从生成质量和系统性能两个维度与全量生成基线方法进行对比。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DeltaMCP显著降低了开发者维护开销，同时提升了MCP服务器的可维护性和版本一致性。
AI.conclusion: DeltaMCP为寻求维护高保真、持续更新的MCP服务器基础设施的企业提供了可扩展的解决方案，特别适用于LLM驱动的智能系统。

title: Why LLMs Fail at Causal Discovery and How Interventional Agents Escape
summary: Causal discovery is a cornerstone of scientific reasoning, yet whether large language models can perform it reliably remains an open question. Recent benchmarks show that even fine-tuned models plateau on simple causal graphs and degrade as complexity grows, but why they fail has not been established. We prove the failure is fundamental: supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and in-context learning all produce predictors that cannot distinguish between causal graphs generating similar observational data, and any attempt to do so requires the model's internal representations to grow unboundedly, violating the very conditions under which these methods work. We formalize this as a kernel obstruction theorem, establishing that the limitation is intrinsic to the learning paradigm, \emph{not any particular model or dataset}. We propose Agentic Causal Bayesian Optimization (A-CBO), wherein a frozen language model serves as an interventional oracle answering targeted queries about intervention effects, while an external Bayesian loop concentrates beliefs over candidate graphs in logarithmically many rounds. Because the decision operates outside the space where the obstruction applies, A-CBO provably converges while the underlying model remains unchanged. On Corr2Cause, A-CBO matches fine-tuned baselines without any training. On Extended Corr2Cause, a new benchmark scaling to 24 variables with 18K test samples, A-CBO significantly outperforms both fine-tuning and preference optimization, with the advantage growing

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了大语言模型在因果发现任务中失败的根本原因——监督微调、偏好优化和上下文学习产生的预测器无法区分产生相似观测数据的因果图，这是学习范式固有的限制（核阻塞定理）。作为解决方案，提出A-CBO框架：冻结LLM作为干预预言机，外部贝叶斯循环进行图结构搜索，在阻塞不适用的决策空间外运作从而可证明收敛。
AI.motivation: 因果发现是科学推理的基石，但大型语言模型能否可靠地进行因果发现仍是悬而未决的问题。现有的基准测试表明，即使微调后的模型在简单因果图上也达到瓶颈，且随着复杂度增加性能下降，但失败的根本原因尚不清楚。
AI.method: 理论层面证明了核阻塞定理，指出监督微调、直接偏好优化和上下文学习产生的预测器无法区分生成相似观测数据的因果图，尝试区分需要模型内部表示无限增长。实践层面提出Agentic Causal Bayesian Optimization (A-CBO)：冻结的语言模型作为干预预言机回答关于干预效果的定向查询，外部贝叶斯循环在对数轮次内集中于候选图上的信念。
AI.result: 在Corr2Cause上，A-CBO无需任何训练即可匹配微调基线性能。在Extended Corr2Cause（扩展至24个变量、18K测试样本）上，A-CBO显著优于微调和偏好优化方法，且优势随问题规模增加而增长。
AI.conclusion: A-CBO通过在阻塞不适用的决策空间外运作，突破了现有学习范式的根本限制。在Corr2Cause上无需训练即可匹配微调基线；在Extended Corr2Cause（24变量、18K样本）上显著优于微调和偏好优化方法，且优势随复杂度增加而扩大。

title: OralAgent: Integrating Reasoning, Tools, and Knowledge for Interactive Dental Image Analysis
summary: Dental image analysis plays a pivotal role in supporting accurate diagnosis and treatment planning in oral healthcare. Although recent advances have produced dental AI models for specific tasks and individual imaging modalities, their isolated designs limit practical use in real-world clinical workflows. In this paper, we present OralAgent, the first dental-specialized AI agent that unifies multimodal reasoning, tool-based decision-making, and knowledge-grounded retrieval within an end-to-end automated framework. It integrates 22 visual analysis tools and 368 widely-used classical dental textbooks, enabling autonomous reasoning, planning, tool use, knowledge retrieval, and multi-step workflow execution. Furthermore, we introduce OralCorpus, a large-scale, high-quality bilingual textual resource containing 134.8M tokens curated for dental retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). To evaluate models' multidisciplinary dental knowledge, we construct OralQA-ZH, a Chinese multiple-choice question benchmark consisting of 798 items across eleven oral subspecialties. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OralAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MMOral-Uni, MMOral-OPG, and OralQA-ZH benchmarks, highlighting its effectiveness, interpretability, and adaptability in real-world clinical settings. The code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/isjinghao/OralAgent.

AI.tldr: OralAgent是首个牙科专用AI智能体，统一多模态推理、工具决策和知识检索，能够整合22个视觉分析工具和368本牙科教科书，实现自主推理、规划、工具调用和知识检索。并引入OralCorpus（1.348亿token双语牙科文本语料库）和OralQA-ZH基准测试（798道中文选择题，覆盖11个牙科亚专业）。在多个基准测试上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有牙科AI模型多为针对特定任务和单一成像模态的孤立设计，限制了其在真实临床工作流程中的实际应用。
AI.method: 提出OralAgent，首个牙科专用AI智能体，整合多模态推理、工具决策和知识检索；引入OralCorpus（1.348亿token双语牙科语料库用于RAG）和OralQA-ZH（798道中文多选题，覆盖11个亚专业）基准测试。
AI.result: OralAgent在MMOral-Uni、MMOral-OPG和OralQA-ZH基准测试上达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: OralAgent展现了有效性、可解释性和在真实临床环境中的适应性，为牙科AI发展提供了统一框架。

title: Tackling Multimodal Learning Challenges with Mixture-of-Expert: A Survey
comment: This survey paper has just been accepted by IJCAI 2026. Results were released by 30 April 2026. As I could not find a particular place to drop the acceptance email. I have upload the acceptance email alongside the LaTeX files of the paper, named as Acceptance_email.pdf
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) presents a naturally compatible and scalable framework for multimodal learning, demonstrating strong adaptability across diverse modalities and tasks. Despite its growing success, a comprehensive and systematic review on the MoE metho addressing multimodal challenges remains lacking. Existing surveys tend to evaluate either multimodal learning or MoE independently from method taxonomy, overlooking the unique interplay between them. This survey fills that gap by answering a central question: \textit{How does MoE effectively resolve multimodal challenges?} We approach this from three key perspectives: (1) \textbf{MoE as an Efficient Multimodal Engine:} enabling scalable multimodal modeling by decoupling computational cost from parameter growth and mitigating modality redundancy through selective expert activation; (2) \textbf{MoE as a Multimodal Representation Learner:} integrating complementary multi-opinion expert knowledge to enrich alignment and interaction representations; and (3) \textbf{MoE as a Multimodal Adapter:} providing a modular and flexible mechanism to model imperfect data scenarios such as modality imbalance and missing modality. Through our extensive literature review, we identify critical research gaps, including interpretable routing, expert communication, modality integration, and lifelong multimodal learning. We position this survey as a foundation for future research toward interpretable and sustainable multimodal Mixture-of-Experts system.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于MoE（混合专家）方法在多模态学习中应用的系统性综述，旨在回答MoE如何有效解决多模态挑战这一核心问题，从高效引擎、表征学习和适配器三个视角全面审视了该领域的现有研究和未来方向。
AI.motivation: 现有综述倾向于独立评估多模态学习或MoE方法，忽视了二者之间的独特相互作用，缺乏对MoE方法解决多模态挑战的全面系统性综述。
AI.method: 综述方法，从三个关键视角对MoE解决多模态问题的方式进行系统性文献综述：(1) MoE作为高效多模态引擎；(2) MoE作为多模态表示学习器；(3) MoE作为多模态适配器。
AI.result: 该综述填补了MoE与多模态学习交叉领域的研究空白，回答了核心问题：MoE如何有效解决多模态挑战。
AI.conclusion: 确定了关键研究缺口，包括可解释路由、专家通信、模态整合和终身多模态学习，为未来可解释和可持续的多模态MoE系统研究奠定基础。

title: SiDP: Memory-Efficient Data Parallelism for Offline LLM Inference
summary: The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) has shifted a substantial portion of inference workloads into throughput-oriented offline regimes, where fully utilizing GPU compute requires large batch sizes. However, existing deployments face a structural tension. Data parallelism (DP) scales throughput well but replicates model weights, leaving limited GPU memory for key-value (KV) cache and constraining batch size. Model parallelism reduces per-device weights, but requires fine-grained synchronization that erodes DP's independence and scheduling flexibility. We present SiDP, a memory-efficient data-parallel paradigm for offline LLM inference that treats weights as a bandwidth-backed shared resource inside a DP group. Instead of storing the full model on every GPU, SiDP organizes weights as a distributed pool: each layer is owned by a single GPU, and other replicas access its weights on demand via two complementary execution modes: a Weight-as-a-Service (WaS) mode that streams remote weights over NVLink into a small cache in the large-batch regime, and a Compute-as-a-Service (CaS) mode that ships activations to owners in the small-batch tail. Evaluated on NVIDIA H20, H200, and B200 GPUs with Qwen3-32B, Qwen2.5-72B, and Llama-3.1-70B, SiDP increases usable KV capacity by up to 1.8x under the same configurations, and converts this into up to 1.5x higher end-to-end throughput over baselines (vLLM) for offline workloads.

AI.tldr: SiDP是一种用于离线LLM推理的内存高效数据并行范式，通过将模型权重作为分布式共享资源，配合WaS和CaS两种执行模式，有效解决了数据并行与模型并行之间的权衡问题，在保持调度灵活性的同时实现了更高的KV缓存容量和吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 离线LLM推理场景需要大批量处理以充分利用GPU算力，但现有部署面临数据并行（DP）与模型并行之间的结构性矛盾：DP能扩展吞吐量但复制模型权重，限制KV缓存空间；模型并行减少单设备权重但需要细粒度同步，降低调度灵活性。
AI.method: SiDP提出两种互补执行模式：WaS模式通过NVLink将远程权重流式传输到本地缓存，适合大批量场景；CaS模式将激活值发送到权重所有者，适合小批量场景。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA H20、H200、B200 GPU上使用Qwen3-32B、Qwen2.5-72B、Llama-3.1-70B模型评估，SiDP在相同配置下将可用KV容量提升1.8倍，离线工作负载端到端吞吐量相比vLLM基线提升1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: SiDP通过将权重作为带宽-backed共享资源，有效解决了离线LLM推理中数据并行与模型并行的结构性矛盾，在保持调度灵活性的同时显著提升了GPU内存利用率和吞吐量。

title: From Task Allocation to Risk Clearing: A Unifying Interface for Mixed Human-Agent Societies
summary: As humans, robots, and software agents increasingly share safety-critical environments, coordination must move from static task allocation to managing uncertain commitments. Existing frameworks fall short: they either assume rigid, static teams or learn opaque joint policies that are hard to adapt and difficult to integrate with human decision-makers. To overcome these limitations, we propose Risk-Aware Option Clearing (ROC), a unifying coordination mechanism in which agents expose options (temporally extended skills) paired with risk summaries that predict outcome distributions. A central clearinghouse then assigns tasks by optimizing risk-adjusted mission utility under deadlines and safety constraints. ROC is a family of mechanisms, ranging from deployments where the clearinghouse learns outcome models from data to ones that consume full distributional predictions from agents. By treating risk-aware options as the basic coordination unit, ROC sketches a scalable, transparent infrastructure for integrating heterogeneous agents into future mixed human--agent societies and outlines a research agenda for such risk-aware clearing layers.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes Risk-Aware Option Clearing (ROC), a coordination mechanism for mixed human-agent systems in safety-critical environments. ROC uses "risk-aware options" (temporally extended skills with risk summaries) as the basic coordination unit, with a central clearinghouse optimizing task assignment under deadlines and safety constraints. The framework offers transparency and adaptability for integrating heterogeneous agents into future mixed human-agent societies.
AI.motivation: Existing coordination frameworks are limited in two ways: (1) they assume rigid, static teams that cannot adapt to dynamic environments, or (2) they learn opaque joint policies that are difficult to adapt and integrate with human decision-makers. As safety-critical environments increasingly involve mixed human-robot-software agent teams, there is a need for coordination mechanisms that are both flexible and interpretable.
AI.method: ROC treats "risk-aware options" (temporally extended skills paired with risk summaries predicting outcome distributions) as the basic coordination unit. A central clearinghouse assigns tasks by optimizing risk-adjusted mission utility under deadlines and safety constraints. This framework ranges from data-driven outcome model learning to consuming full distributional predictions from agents.
AI.result: ROC establishes a unifying coordination framework that bridges the gap between rigid static allocation and opaque learned policies. It provides transparency through risk summaries while maintaining scalability through the central clearinghouse architecture.
AI.conclusion: ROC provides a scalable, transparent infrastructure for integrating heterogeneous agents (including humans) into future mixed human-agent societies. The paper outlines a research agenda for developing such risk-aware clearing layers, enabling flexible coordination in safety-critical environments.

title: MGRetrieval: Memory-Guided Reflective Retrieval for Long-Term Dialogue Agents
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant progress in dialogue, yet redundant memory contexts severely limit their effectiveness in long-term dialogue agents. External memory systems have been proposed to improve memory maintenance. However, these systems mainly rely on one-shot retrieval, which limits their ability to retrieve sufficient and relevant evidence. Although recent methods introduce reflection into retrieval, their retrieval paths are generated by the LLM from limited evidence, leading to unstable retrieval and additional latency overhead. %These limitations highlight the need for effective retrieval mechanisms. To address these limitations, we propose MGRetrieval, a retrieval strategy that grounds reflective retrieval in the semantic structure of historical memories. Specifically, MGRetrieval consists of two steps: (1) It references the structure of historical memories to construct a more precise retrieval path. (2) The LLM retains critical memories and determines whether accumulated memories are sufficient to stop further iterative retrieval. This allows the retrieval process to follow semantically meaningful paths. Through memory-guided retrieval and critical memory propagation, MGRetrieval gradually constructs concise and sufficient memory contexts. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo show that MGRetrieval outperforms the strongest baseline by 8.91\% in F1 and 11.11\% in BLEU-1 on average across Qwen2.5-14B and Qwen3-14B, while maintaining practical token and latency costs. The code can be found in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MGRetrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGRetrieval，一种基于历史记忆语义结构的反思性检索策略，通过记忆引导检索和关键记忆传播解决长期对话代理中的记忆冗余问题，在保持低延迟成本的同时显著提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: LLM在对话任务中取得显著进展，但在长期对话代理中，冗余的记忆上下文严重影响其效果。现有外部记忆系统主要依赖一次性检索，无法获取充分且相关的证据；虽然近期方法引入反思机制，但检索路径由LLM从有限证据生成，导致检索不稳定且产生额外延迟开销。
AI.method: MGRetrieval采用两步检索策略：(1) 利用历史记忆的语义结构构建更精确的检索路径；(2) 让LLM保留关键记忆并判断累积记忆是否足以停止迭代检索。通过记忆引导检索和关键记忆传播，实现检索过程沿语义有意义的路径进行。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo数据集上，MGRetrieval在Qwen2.5-14B和Qwen3-14B模型上平均超越最强基线8.91%的F1分数和11.11%的BLEU-1分数，同时保持了实用的令牌和延迟成本。
AI.conclusion: MGRetrieval通过记忆引导检索和关键记忆传播，逐步构建简洁且充分的记忆上下文，在Qwen2.5-14B和Qwen3-14B模型上平均超越最强基线8.91%的F1和11.11%的BLEU-1分数，同时保持了实用的令牌和延迟成本。

title: Short-Term Gain, Long-Term Fragility: AI Labor Substitution and the Erosion of Sustainable Capability
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, Also available on SSRN: https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6577818
summary: What looks like acceleration can be a quiet transfer of burden from the present to the future. Attempts to replace human labor with AI systems are often presented as rational responses to technological progress, but that view is often structurally short-sighted. Across software development and adjacent knowledge industries, AI is increasingly attractive because it appears to reduce labor costs, speed output, and improve short-term metrics. Yet those gains may be achieved by drawing down human capabilities that are slow to build and difficult to restore. This paper develops a mechanism of capability masking and capability erosion under AI labor substitution. AI-generated output can create the appearance that organizational capability has been replaced, even when dependence on skilled human labor remains. That appearance can support hiring restraint while slower costs accumulate in the background. Evidence from AI-assisted coding shows that generated output still requires substantial human verification and remains uneven in correctness, maintainability, and security. Repository-level studies also suggest limits in handling broader codebase context. More broadly, labor-market, political-economy, and industrial-strategy evidence suggests that substitution pressures are being driven by managerial cost incentives and national competition while increasing risks of concentration and platform control. The result is a system that may look more efficient in the short term while becoming more fragile over time.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了AI替代人类劳动力的一个核心悖论：表面上的效率提升实际上是通过"能力遮蔽"和"能力侵蚀"机制，将成本从现在转移到未来。作者通过AI辅助编码的实证研究和更广泛的劳动市场、政治经济证据，论证了这种替代模式可能造成短期看似高效、长期愈发脆弱的系统性问题。
AI.motivation: AI替代人类劳动力的叙事被普遍认为是技术进步的理性响应，但作者认为这种观点存在结构性短视。论文试图揭示：在短期指标改善的背后，可能隐藏着对组织长期能力的系统性消耗。
AI.method: 论文主要采用机制分析（capability masking and capability erosion）和跨领域证据综合（软件工程、劳动经济学、政治经济学、产业战略）的方法。实证层面引用了AI辅助编码的案例研究和仓库级别的代码研究。
AI.result: 发现AI生成的输出仍需大量人工验证，在正确性、可维护性和安全性方面表现不均；在处理更广泛的代码库上下文方面也存在局限。更重要的是，替代压力实际上由管理成本动机和国家竞争驱动，而非单纯的技术进步需求。
AI.conclusion: 系统短期内看似更高效，但长期看变得更加脆弱。AI替代人工的表面收益掩盖了对技能型人力资本的持续依赖，而组织能力在悄然退化。这种现象对劳动力市场、政治经济和国家产业战略都构成潜在风险，可能加剧市场集中度和平台控制。

title: GUI Agents for Continual Game Generation
summary: Generating a game is not the same as making one that can be played. Despite advances in code generation, existing approaches treat game generation as one-shot translation from prompt to artifact, leaving interaction-level failures undetected. We argue that evaluating and improving game generation requires a player, and study two roles for graphical user interface (GUI) agents in this process: (1) as an objective evaluator, for which we introduce PlaytestArena, a new evaluation environment that pairs 200 browser-based game generation tasks across eight genres with rubrics of expected in-play behaviors, adjudicated by a GUI agent that loads each build in a browser and plays it; and (2) as a subjective playtester, for which we propose Play2Code, where a game agent and a GUI agent operate in a sustained loop with shared memory, turning game generation into a dialogue between coding and playing. Our experiments show that even frontier models struggle to generate playable games directly, while Play2Code achieves a 66.8\% rubric pass-rate, improving over single-pass and agentic-coding baselines by 37.1 and 14.6 points respectively. Further analysis shows that GUI playtester feedback is more traceable than a human report, yet idiosyncratic in ways reminiscent of human testers, establishing game playtesting as a critical testbed for interactive code generation. Our project website is available at https://continual-game-generation.vercel.app/.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces GUI agents for game generation evaluation through two systems: PlaytestArena for objective evaluation and Play2Code for iterative human-in-the-loop playtesting. Play2Code achieves 66.8% rubric pass-rate, significantly outperforming existing baselines, establishing game playtesting as a valuable testbed for interactive code generation.
AI.motivation: Existing game generation approaches treat code generation as one-shot prompt-to-artifact translation, leaving interaction-level failures undetected due to lack of player-based evaluation.
AI.method: Two approaches: (1) PlaytestArena - evaluation environment pairing 200 browser-based game tasks with behavioral rubrics, adjudicated by GUI agents; (2) Play2Code - sustained loop with shared memory between game agent and GUI agent, enabling iterative dialogue between coding and playing.
AI.result: Frontier models struggle with direct playable game generation. Play2Code achieves 66.8% rubric pass-rate (37.1 points over single-pass, 14.6 points over agentic-coding baselines). GUI feedback is more traceable than human reports but exhibits human-like idiosyncrasies.
AI.conclusion: Game playtesting establishes a critical testbed for interactive code generation, with GUI agents offering traceable yet human-like feedback.

title: RULER: Representation-Level Verification of Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training records from a deployed model without retraining from scratch. Current protocols verify this at the output level through membership inference, retain accuracy, and forget-set accuracy, but a model can satisfy all three whilst still encoding forgotten records in its intermediate representations. We introduce RULER, a set of representation-level verification metrics. The oracle-comparative metric M2 measures whether forget-set records occupy the same representational position as in a model retrained without them. The oracle-free metric M4 detects residuals from the unlearned model's internal similarity structure alone, without retraining. Four approximate unlearning methods all pass output-level evaluation, yet under a linear mixed-effects model M2 detects significant residuals in 10 of 12 conditions (p<0.05), with effect sizes growing as the forget fraction increases. A fifth method, Bad Teacher, shows the same residuals despite a different forgetting mechanism. M4 acts as a pre-unlearning diagnostic across tabular, image, clinical text, and face-identity settings: it detects identity-level memorisation in face recognition models where no tested method fully erases the signal.

AI.tldr: RULER通过表示级验证指标M2和M4揭示了机器unlearning领域的关键问题：现有通过输出级验证的方法在中间表示层仍保留被遗忘数据残余。M2基于oracle比较检测残差，M4可无oracle预诊断，均证明表示层验证的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器unlearning验证协议仅在输出层（成员推断、精度、遗忘集精度）验证，但模型可能通过这些验证却仍在中间表示层编码被遗忘记录，存在隐私泄露风险。
AI.method: 提出两个表示级验证指标：M2通过线性混合效应模型比较unlearned模型与retrained oracle模型在遗忘集上的表示相似性；M4则无需retrained oracle，仅通过分析unlearned模型内部相似性结构残差进行检测。在12种条件下系统评估5种近似unlearning方法。
AI.result: M2在12种条件中检测到10种存在显著残差（p<0.05），效应量随遗忘比例增加而增大。Bad Teacher方法尽管使用不同遗忘机制，同样显示表示层残差。M4在表格、图像、临床文本和人脸识别四种场景中均检测到身份级记忆化，且无测试方法能完全擦除信号。
AI.conclusion: RULER成功揭示了现有输出级验证方法的盲点。实验表明，即使通过输出级验证的方法，仍可能在中间表示层保留被遗忘数据的残余。M4具有跨模态诊断能力，特别适用于人脸识别等高敏感场景。建议未来的unlearning方法应同时通过输出级和表示级验证。

title: BioELX: Cross-lingual Biomedical Entity Linking via Alias-based Retrieval and LLM Ranking
summary: Cross-lingual biomedical entity linking (BEL) maps mentions in any language to unique identifiers in a biomedical knowledge base (KB), supporting clinical and biomedical NLP applications. However, expert-annotated training data for BEL are costly, especially for low-resource languages. Moreover, many cross-lingual BEL systems rely on SapBERT-based retrievers trained on predominantly English aliases in the KB, leading to poor generalization to unseen non-English mentions and limited context-aware disambiguation. We propose BioELX, a two-stage cross-lingual BEL framework that requires no task-specific annotated training corpora. In Stage~1, we enrich SapBERT training with Wikidata-derived multilingual aliases and use the resulting retriever to improve cross-lingual candidate retrieval. In Stage~2, we perform context-aware disambiguation with a pre-trained LLM ranker that jointly considers the mention context and candidate, eliminating the need for supervised training. Experiments on five benchmarks (XL-BEL, EMEA, Patent, WikiMed-DE, and MedMentions) show that BioELX achieves new state-of-the-art performance. It improves average Recall@1 on XL-BEL by +19.2, with especially large gains for low-resource languages, e.g., +21.6 on Turkish, +22.1 on Korean, +30.8 on Thai, and delivers consistent improvements on EMEA (+6.2), Patent (+5.4), and WikiMed-DE (+12.8). Code and resources will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: BioELX是一个两阶段跨语言生物医学实体链接框架，通过多语言别名增强和LLM上下文消歧实现无需标注数据的最优性能，尤其大幅提升低资源语言表现。
AI.motivation: 当前跨语言生物医学实体链接系统依赖英语别名占主导的SapBERT检索器，对非英语提及泛化能力差且缺乏上下文感知消歧能力；且专家标注训练数据成本高昂，低资源语言尤甚。
AI.method: Stage 1利用Wikidata多语言别名扩充训练数据增强SapBERT跨语言检索能力；Stage 2使用预训练LLM排序器进行上下文感知消歧，两阶段均无需监督训练。
AI.result: 在5个基准数据集上取得SOTA，XL-BEL平均Recall@1提升19.2，低资源语言提升显著（泰语+30.8、韩语+22.1、土耳其语+21.6），EMEA+6.2、Patent+5.4、WikiMed-DE+12.8。
AI.conclusion: BioELX通过两阶段框架和Wikidata多语言别名增强，在低资源语言上取得大幅提升（泰语+30.8、韩语+22.1、土耳其语+21.6），平均Recall@1提升19.2，无需任务特定标注数据即可达到最优性能。

title: Metric-Aware PCA as a Linear Instance of Geometric Deep Learning
summary: Geometric deep learning organises neural architectures around the symmetries of their data domain, with the choice of symmetry group serving as a geometric prior that determines what representations can be learned. Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA) parameterises principal component analysis by a positive-definite metric matrix, with a canonical subfamily interpolating between standard PCA and output whitening and a diagonal-metric point recovering Invariant PCA (IPCA). This paper positions MAPCA within the geometric deep learning framework. The metric is read as the geometric prior; the orthogonal group preserving it is the symmetry group it induces; MAPCA solutions are equivariant under this group with the resulting spectrum invariant; and MAPCA's defining constraint is the linear analogue of the Schur-type weight constraints used in equivariant networks. Across six axes - domain, symmetry group, equivariance, invariance, architectural primitive, and geometric prior - we construct a precise dictionary between MAPCA and geometric deep learning. The technical anchor is a uniqueness theorem characterising IPCA as the unique linear data-derived metric in the MAPCA family that is equivariant under arbitrary diagonal rescaling and projects onto the fixed-point set of the action, equivalent under normalisation to the variance-maximisation criterion in its precise form. The paper closes with three bridges: kernel PCA as the nonlinear extension, spectral graph methods as MAPCA on graphs, and a deep MAPCA construction extending the positioning into deep equivariant networks

AI.tldr: 该论文将MAPCA定位于几何深度学习框架内，建立了从度量矩阵到几何先验、从正交群到对称群的精确对应，通过六个维度（域、对称群、等变性、不变性、架构原语、几何先验）构建完整理论字典，并通过核PCA、谱图方法和深度MAPCA三个桥梁实现理论延伸。
AI.motivation: 将MAPCA（度量感知主成分分析）纳入几何深度学习框架，建立两者之间的精确对应关系。几何深度学习通过数据域对称性组织神经网络架构，选择对称群作为几何先验决定可学习的表示。
AI.method: 核心方法是将度量矩阵解释为几何先验，保持度量的正交群为其诱导的对称群。关键定理证明IPCA是MAPCA族中唯一在任意对角重缩放下等变且投影到作用不动点集的线性数据驱动度量。该定理在归一化下等价于精确形式的方差最大化准则。
AI.result: 构建了跨越六个轴的精确字典：域、对称群、等变性、不变性、架构原语和几何先验。证明了MAPCA解在该对称群下等变，谱因此保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 通过三个桥梁完成理论延伸：(1)核PCA作为非线性扩展；(2)谱图方法作为图上的MAPCA；(3)深度MAPCA构建延伸至深度等变网络。建立了从线性方法到非线性方法的完整理论框架。

title: Resource Allocation in HyperX Networks
summary: As high-performance computing systems scale in size and complexity, efficient resource management is essential to minimize communication overhead. The HyperX is a richly connected, low-diameter network that offers a scalable and cost-effective alternative to traditional topologies. However, resource allocation in HyperX remains underexplored, and strategies designed for networks like Torus, Fat-tree, or Dragonfly do not directly transfer. In this work, we propose and formalize several resource allocation strategies for HyperX networks, categorized into linear, geometric, and stochastic functions. We characterize these strategies theoretically by analyzing their topological properties, including dilation, convexity, and partition bandwidth.Furthermore, we conduct an exhaustive experimental evaluation using synthetic traffic and application communication kernels to assess the impact of these strategies on performance under different routing algorithms. Our results indicate that partition bandwidth and switch locality are decisive factors in mitigating interferences. Notably, the Diagonal allocation strategy, which is not convex, consistently outperforms traditional approaches in most scenarios. Finally, we provide a set of lessons learned to guide the implementation of resource allocation policies in HPC systems based on HyperX networks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对HyperX网络的资源分配问题，提出并评估了多种分配策略，发现分区带宽和交换机关联性是关键影响因素，其中Diagonal策略表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 随着高性能计算系统规模扩大，需要高效的资源管理来最小化通信开销。HyperX网络虽具优势，但其资源分配策略尚缺乏充分研究
AI.method: 提出并形式化三类资源分配策略（线性、几何、随机）；从拓扑特性角度分析dilations、凸性和分区带宽；使用合成流量和应用通信内核进行穷举实验评估
AI.result: 分区带宽和交换机关联性是缓解干扰的决定性因素；Diagonal分配策略（非凸）在大多场景中始终优于传统方法
AI.conclusion: 提供了一套经验教训，用于指导基于HyperX网络的HPC系统中资源分配策略的实施

title: Detection Without Correction: A Two-Parameter Decomposition of Multi-Stage LLM Pipelines
summary: Multi-stage LLM pipelines that perform multi-agent debate, intrinsic self-correction, or retrieval-augmented verification exhibit puzzling aggregate behaviors: accuracy plateaus and reversals across rounds, non-replication of debate gains on contemporary frontier models, intrinsic self-correction degradation, and qualitative cross-provider divergence in debate dynamics. Downstream agent response can be operationalized as two coupled decisions: detection (whether to treat upstream content as authoritative) and conditional generation (what to produce if not). This decomposition yields four observable response regimes, of which detection-without-correction is the load-bearing failure mode. Across a nine-cell empirical grid spanning four model families, four benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH-500, GPQA-Diamond, AIME), and two methods (multi-agent debate, intrinsic self-correction), we find that the conditional miscorrection rate is consistently dominant (53-94% across cohorts) while detection rate varies contextually by more than an order of magnitude. The framework unifies the four phenomena above as signatures of a common mechanism and characterizes detection threshold as a stable model/protocol-level regularity that persists across methods at matched benchmark difficulty.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将多智能体系统中下游智能体的响应分解为"检测"和"条件生成"两个耦合决策，以此解释多阶段LLM管道中的四种反直觉现象（准确率平台/反转、辩论增益不可复现、自纠正退化、跨提供商分歧）。通过对4个模型家族、4个基准和2种方法的九宫格实验发现，条件错误纠正率持续主导（53-94%），检测-无纠正是主要故障模式，检测阈值是跨方法的稳定规律。
AI.motivation: 解释多阶段LLM管道中的反直觉现象：准确率平台和反转、辩论收益在当代前沿模型上无法复现、内在自我纠正退化、跨提供商辩论动态分歧。这些现象单独看起来不同，但可能存在统一的潜在机制。
AI.method: 九宫格实证设计：4个模型家族 × 4个基准（GSM8K, MATH-500, GPQA-Diamond, AIME）× 2种方法（多智能体辩论、内在自我纠正）。将下游智能体响应分解为两个耦合决策：检测（是否将上游内容视为权威）和条件生成（如果不，如何生成）。识别四个可观察的响应制度，分析条件错误纠正率和检测率的分布。
AI.result: 条件错误纠正率在所有队列中持续占主导地位（53-94%），而检测率在上下文上变化超过一个数量级。检测-无纠正是主要的故障模式。检测阈值在匹配基准难度下跨方法保持稳定，被表征为稳定的模型/协议级规律性。
AI.conclusion: 检测阈值是跨方法、跨基准难度匹配的稳定模型/协议级规律性；条件错误纠正率持续主导（53-94%）是主要故障模式；该框架统一了之前观察到的四个现象（准确率平台/反转、辩论收益不可复现、自纠正退化、跨提供商分歧）为一个共同机制。

title: Prominence-Stratified Failure Modes in Retrieval-Augmented Commercial Recommendation: A 37,000-Run Audit
summary: AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude are recommendation engines, not search engines: they answer commercial queries by directly nominating brands rather than returning a list of links. Marketing to AI is therefore a broader problem than "show up in search" -- positioning, content, and product fit matter as much as discoverability. We audit ~37,000 production runs across four model configurations and 215 commercially-framed prompts spanning 19 sectors, evaluated against a 533-brand reference catalog stratified into five prominence tiers (L1 category leaders to L5 regional players) sourced from external authority lists. The ladder proxies a brand's awareness footprint within its sector, not revenue or market share. The failure mode differs sharply by tier. L1 brands appear in nearly every relevant retrieval but win only 25-41% of the recommendation slots they reach -- the leverage is differentiation, not visibility. L2 challengers carry the highest conversion rates of any tier (37-52%) but lose to persona-mediated substitution on the Anthropic models. L3 mid-market brands are the inflection level: aggregate coverage drops to 88%, conversion to 34-40%, and persona effects peak. L4 specialists and L5 regional players face catastrophic invisibility -- 48-52% never surface in any of the 37,000 runs. No uniform optimization recipe wins; the right marketing investment depends on where the brand sits on the prominence ladder.

AI.tldr: AI助手本质是推荐引擎而非搜索引擎，不同显著度层级的品牌面临截然不同的失败模式：顶级品牌需差异化、中端品牌是优化拐点、区域性品牌面临严重不可见性，不存在统一的AI营销优化方案。
AI.motivation: AI助手（如ChatGPT、Claude）本质上是推荐引擎而非搜索引擎，它们直接提名品牌来回答商业查询，而非返回链接列表。这使得"面向AI的营销"比传统SEO问题更加复杂，涉及定位、内容和产品契合度，而非仅仅是可发现性。
AI.method: 对四个模型配置和215个商业提示进行约37,000次生产级运行审计，使用来自外部权威列表的533个品牌参考目录进行评估，品牌按五个显著度层级（L1行业领导者至L5区域参与者）分层。
AI.result: L1品牌在几乎所有相关检索中出现，但仅赢得25-41%的推荐位置——关键在于差异化而非可见性；L2挑战者转化率最高（37-52%），但在Anthropic模型上输给人格中介替换；L3中端品牌是关键拐点：覆盖率降至88%，转化率降至34-40%，人格效应达峰值；L4专家和L5区域品牌面临灾难性不可见性——48-52%在所有37,000次运行中从未出现。
AI.conclusion: 品牌在AI推荐系统中的成功取决于其在行业显著度阶梯上的位置：L1品牌需通过差异化竞争，L2品牌需对抗人格中介替换，L3品牌面临推荐覆盖和人格效应的双重拐点，L4/L5品牌则面临灾难性的不可见性问题。不存在统一的优化方案，营销投资策略必须根据品牌的阶梯位置定制。

title: Mathematical Modelling of Ethical AI Use in Higher Education: A Coordination Game Framework for Future-Facing Learning
summary:
The rapid uptake of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in higher education is reshaping assessment practices and intensifying concerns around academic integrity, fairness, and learning quality. While institutional responses increasingly emphasise policy guidance and ethical principles, there remains limited formal understanding of how collective norms of responsible or opportunistic AI use emerge and stabilise within student cohorts. This paper reframes student AI use in assessment as a coordination problem shaped by peer expectations and assessment design rather than individual compliance alone. We develop a coordination-based evolutionary game-theoretic framework that captures learning value, effort, perceived fairness, and transparency, with institutional AI governance modelled implicitly through reflective assessment incentives.
  We use analytical results and finite-population simulations to reveal threshold-driven behavioural transitions in student AI use: small, well-calibrated changes in reflective assessment incentives can trigger rapid shifts towards responsible, learning-oriented AI-use norms, whereas weak or misaligned incentives allow opportunistic practices to persist. These non-linear dynamics explain why policy statements alone often fail to change behaviour, while modest assessment redesigns can have disproportionate effects. By providing a mechanism-level account of how assessment structures shape collective AI-use practices, this work offers higher education institutions an analytically grounded tool for Future Facing Learning, supporting proportionate, pedagogy-led AI governance without reliance on surveillance or punitive enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本研究将学生 AI 使用重新框架为协调问题，运用进化博弈论揭示阈值驱动的行为转变机制，表明评估激励的微小调整可显著影响集体 AI 使用规范的形成，为高等教育 AI 治理提供无需监控的非惩罚性策略。
AI.motivation: 当前对生成式 AI 在高等教育中的响应主要依赖政策指导和伦理原则，但缺乏对学生群体中负责任或机会主义 AI 使用规范如何形成和稳定的正式理解。学生 AI 使用应被视为一个由同伴期望和评估设计塑造的协调问题，而非单纯的个人合规问题。
AI.method: 建立了基于协调的进化博弈论框架，包含学习价值、努力程度、感知公平性和透明度等变量，并通过解析结果和有限人口模拟验证。机构 AI 治理通过反思性评估激励机制隐式建模。
AI.result: 揭示了学生 AI 使用中的阈值驱动行为转变：评估激励的微小调整可触发向负责任、以学习为导向的 AI 使用规范快速转变；而弱激励或不对齐的激励则使机会主义行为持续存在。这些非线性 dynamics 解释了政策声明往往无法改变行为，而适度的评估 redesign 却能产生巨大影响的现象。
AI.conclusion: 本文为高等教育机构提供了一个分析工具，可支持比例适当、以 pedagogy 为导向的 AI 治理，无需依赖监控或惩罚性执法。通过将评估结构与集体 AI 使用行为联系起来，揭示了为何单纯的 policy statements 往往无效，而适度的评估 redesign 可能产生不成比例的积极影响。

title: Multi-Agent LLM-based Metamorphic Testing for REST APIs
comment: Author submitted version accepted for publication the IEEE Conference on Computers, Software, and Applications (COMPSAC2026), July 7-11, 2026, Madrid Spain
summary: As REST APIs become an increasingly significant part of software systems, their validation is becoming more critical. Hence, testing and uncovering underlying issues are of utmost importance for improving software quality. However, testing REST APIs is challenging mainly due to the difficulty of assessing whether the output of an API call is correct, i.e., the test oracle problem. Metamorphic testing is a specification-based testing approach for situations where correct outputs are unknown or not specified explicitly. To check the correctness of a system, relations between the different outputs are specified. We present ARMeta, a tool-supported approach that uses an LLM-based multi-agent workflow to support metamorphic testing of REST APIs documented with OpenAPI. The agentic workflow is used to identify metamorphic test scenarios and specify them in the Given-When-Then format. These scenarios are automatically implemented as executable tests and executed against the system under test. We evaluate ARMeta on two publicly available web applications that expose REST interfaces and compare its performance with a scenario-based testing baseline. The results show that ARMeta explores behaviors that serve as a complement to existing scenario-based testing approaches.

AI.tldr: ARMeta是一个利用LLM多智能体工作流支持OpenAPI文档化REST API变形测试的工具，通过自动识别、规范化表述和执行变形测试场景，在两个公开Web应用的评估中展现出对现有测试方法的补充价值。
AI.motivation: REST API在软件系统中日益重要，但其验证面临挑战——尤其是测试预言机问题，即难以判断API调用的输出是否正确。传统的基于场景的测试方法存在覆盖不足的问题。
AI.method: 采用基于LLM的多智能体工作流，从OpenAPI文档中识别变形测试场景，并以Given-When-Then格式进行规范表述；自动将场景实现为可执行测试并针对被测系统执行；与基于场景的测试基线方法进行对比评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ARMeta能够探索出作为现有基于场景测试方法补充的行为。
AI.conclusion: ARMeta为REST API测试提供了一种有价值的补充方案，能够探索现有基于场景的测试方法未覆盖的行为，提高了软件质量保障能力。

title: LaneRoPE: Positional Encoding for Collaborative Parallel Reasoning and Generation
summary: Parallel LLM test-time scaling techniques (e.g., best-of-$N$) require drawing $N>1$ sequences conditioned on the same input prompt. These methods boost accuracy while exploiting the computational efficiency of batching $N$ generations. However, each sequence in the batch is traditionally generated independently and hence does not reuse intermediate generations, computations, or observations from other sequences. In this paper, we propose LaneRoPE to enable coordination and collaboration among $N>1$ sequences at generation time. LaneRoPE involves two key ideas: (a) an inter-sequence attention mask to make sampling of sequences dependent on one another; and (b) a RoPE extension that injects positional information that captures relative positions between tokens, both within and outside a particular sequence. We evaluate our approach on mathematical reasoning tasks and find promising results: LaneRoPE enables collaboration among sequences, yielding additional accuracy gains under limited generated sequence length. Importantly, since LaneRoPE enables coordination with minimal changes to the underlying LLM architecture and introduces a negligible overhead at inference time, it is appealing to rapidly incorporate parallel reasoning into existing LLM inference pipelines.

AI.tldr: LaneRoPE通过引入序列间注意力掩码和扩展的RoPE位置编码，使并行生成的多个序列能够相互协作、共享信息，从而在数学推理任务上获得精度提升，且对底层LLM架构改动小、推理开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 现有的并行LLM测试时扩展方法（如best-of-N）虽然通过批处理提升效率，但各序列独立生成，无法复用中间结果、计算或观察。
AI.method: 提出两个核心设计：(1) 序列间注意力掩码，使序列采样相互依赖；(2) RoPE扩展，通过注入位置信息捕获令牌之间的相对位置（跨序列）。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上的评估表明，LaneRoPE能实现序列间协作，在有限生成长度下获得额外精度提升。
AI.conclusion: LaneRoPE通过最小的架构改动和可忽略的推理开销，为将并行推理快速集成到现有LLM推理管道提供了有吸引力的方案。

title: Bridging the Stability-Expressivity Gap: Synthetic Data Scaling and Preference Alignment for Low-Resource Spoken Language Models
summary: Spoken Language Models (SLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for speech synthesis by bypassing explicit grapheme-to-phoneme pipelines. However, their effectiveness in low-resource languages remains fundamentally limited by the scarcity of transcribed speech. In practice, synthetic data has become the primary strategy for scaling SLMs in such settings, providing reliable phonetic supervision when real data is insufficient. In this work, we show that this reliance introduces a fundamental trade-off, which we term the Stability-Expressivity Gap: while synthetic data improves phonetic accuracy, it progressively suppresses prosodic variability, ultimately leading to a collapse of expressivity (Synthetic Erosion). To bridge this gap, we propose two self-alignment frameworks. Disentanglement-Guided Self-Alignment (DGSA) recovers expressivity for complex languages by exploiting prosody-timbre separation. For regimes where authentic references are exceptionally limited, Temperature-Driven Self-Critique (TDSC) stabilizes generation through automated exploration and filtering. Our approach outperforms strong commercial systems, including ElevenLabs and Gemini Pro, and enables the first zero-shot voice cloning capability for Lao.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了低资源语言SLM中合成数据导致的"稳定性-表达性差距"问题，提出DGSA和TDSC两个自对齐框架加以解决，实现超越商业系统的性能。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的SLM因转录语音稀缺而受限，合成数据虽提供可靠的语音监督，但引入基本权衡——作者称之为"稳定性-表达性差距"：合成数据提高音素准确性，却逐步抑制韵律变异性，最终导致表达性崩溃（合成侵蚀）。
AI.method: 提出两个自对齐框架：1) 解耦引导自对齐(DGSA)，利用音高-音色分离恢复复杂语言的表达性；2) 温度驱动自批评(TDSC)，通过自动化探索和过滤稳定生成，用于真实参考语音稀缺的场景。
AI.result: 方法优于ElevenLabs和Gemini Pro等商业系统，首次实现老挝语的零样本语音克隆。
AI.conclusion: DGSA和TDSC框架有效弥合了稳定性-表达性差距，实现了低资源语言的零样本语音克隆，超越了商业系统（如ElevenLabs、Gemini Pro），并首次实现了老挝语的零样本语音克隆能力。

title: Comparative Analysis of Liquid Neural Networks and LSTM for Sequential Pattern Recognition: Robustness, Efficiency, and Clinical Utility
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables, The conference paper will appear in Proceedings of JCSSE 2026
summary: Traditional Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) units operate on discrete time steps, often failing to capture the fluid temporal dynamics of real-world physical processes. Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), specifically Closed-form Continuous-time (CfC) networks, address this by modeling the hidden state evolution as a continuous differential equation. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive benchmarking study across four distinct sequential modalities: neuromorphic event-based data (N-MNIST), stroke-based drawing (QuickDraw), visual handwriting (IAM), and physiological time-series (PhysioNet Sepsis-3). Furthermore, we perform a rigorous stress test using temporal dropout to evaluate model robustness against missing data. Our findings reveal that LNNs consistently provide superior parameter efficiency and significantly higher robustness in natively temporal domains and clinical environments where data sparsity is prevalent. This extended preprint provides additional background on related datasets and the LNN theoretical lineage, supplemented with a detailed appendix documenting our full implementation and experimental settings.

AI.tldr: 本文对液态神经网络(LNN)进行综合基准测试，涵盖神经形态事件数据、笔画绘制、视觉手写和生理时间序列四种模态，并使用时间dropout进行压力测试。结果表明LNN在参数效率和稀疏数据环境鲁棒性方面均优于传统循环神经网络。
AI.motivation: 传统RNN和LSTM在离散时间步上运行，难以捕捉现实世界物理过程的流畅时间动态。
AI.method: 采用液态神经网络(LNN)，特别是闭合形式连续时间(CfC)网络，将隐藏状态演化建模为连续微分方程；跨四种序列模态进行基准测试，并使用时间dropout进行压力测试评估模型鲁棒性。
AI.result: LNN在参数效率上显著优于传统方法，并在时间敏感领域和临床环境中表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LNNs demonstrate enhanced effectiveness in natively temporal domains and clinical environments characterized by data sparsity.

title: You Only Align Once: Propagating Cooperative Behaviors in Multi-Agent Systems through Seed Agents
summary: Ensuring agent behaviors in distributed open multi-agent systems remains challenging, especially as populations grow and unaligned agents may exist. We show that a single aligned agent can propagate cooperative behaviors to untrained agents purely through natural language interaction, a phenomenon we term Alignment Propagation. We study this in the Red-Black Game, a team-based iterated Prisoner's Dilemma in which teammates deliberate and vote to determine their team's collective action. By distilling the cooperative reasoning and persuasive dialogues of a teacher model into a Qwen-3-14B, we obtain a seed agent that, when placed among four untrained teammates, doubles the cooperation rate from 24.8% to 62.2%, outperforming the teacher model and a vanilla Gemini-3.1-Pro. Remarkably, a seed trained exclusively on the RedBlack Game transfers zero-shot to Sugarscape, a spatially grounded survival simulation with pairwise trading, achieving a 91.5% trade success rate versus a 21.6% baseline. Our results reframe multi-agent alignment from an exhaustive per-agent training problem to a scalable social capability that can be engineered through strategic seed placement.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"对齐传播"现象，证明单个对齐智能体可通过自然语言交互将合作行为传播给未经训练的智能体。核心贡献在于将多智能体对齐从个体训练问题转化为可扩展的社会化工程问题，且种子智能体展现出跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在分布式开放多智能体系统中，随着智能体数量增长，未对齐智能体的存在使得确保协作行为变得困难，传统的逐个训练对齐方式面临可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 在Red-Black博弈环境中蒸馏教师模型的协作推理与说服对话，得到Qwen-3-14B种子智能体；将种子部署于四个未经训练的队友中，观察合作行为的传播；零样本迁移至Sugarscape空间化生存模拟进行跨域泛化测试。
AI.result: Red-Black博弈中，种子智能体将合作率从24.8%提升至62.2%，超越教师模型和Gemini-3.1-Pro；零样本迁移至Sugarscape达成91.5%交易成功率（基线21.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体对齐从逐个训练的穷举式问题，重新定义为可通过战略性种子部署进行工程化扩展的社会化能力，为大规模开放多智能体系统的对齐提供了新范式。

title: From AR to Diffusion: Efficiently Adapting Large Language Models with Strictly Causal and Elastic Horizons
summary: Diffusion models promise efficient parallel text generation but rely on bidirectional attention, creating a structural mismatch with pre-trained Autoregressive (AR) models. This incompatibility precludes reusing robust AR priors, necessitating prohibitive pre-training from scratch. To bridge this gap, we propose FLUID, a framework that efficiently adapts AR backbones to the diffusion paradigm. By enforcing Strictly Causal Alignment, FLUID enables seamless initialization from standard GPT-style checkpoints, circumventing the need for massive pre-training. Furthermore, we introduce Elastic Horizons, an entropy-driven mechanism that dynamically modulates denoising strides based on local information density rather than fixed schedules. Experiments demonstrate that FLUID achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing training costs by orders of magnitude, effectively reconciling established AR foundations with efficient parallel generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Oli-lab-nun/FLUID/tree/main.

AI.tldr: FLUID是一个将自回归(AR)模型骨架适配到扩散范式的框架，通过严格因果对齐实现从GPT风格检查点的无缝初始化，并通过弹性视野机制动态调节去噪步幅，在大幅降低训练成本的同时实现最优性能。
AI.motivation: Diffusion models rely on bidirectional attention, creating structural incompatibility with pre-trained Autoregressive (AR) models. This mismatch precludes reusing robust AR priors, necessitating prohibitive pre-training from scratch.
AI.method: FLUID enforces Strictly Causal Alignment to enable seamless initialization from standard GPT-style checkpoints, and introduces Elastic Horizons—an entropy-driven mechanism that dynamically modulates denoising strides based on local information density.
AI.result: FLUID achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing training costs by orders of magnitude.
AI.conclusion: FLUID achieves state-of-the-art performance while dramatically reducing training costs, effectively reconciling established AR foundations with efficient parallel generation.

title: Architecture-driven Shift: towards a lightweight selector for capturing the trends of logit shift
summary: Continual Learning (CL) is a practical paradigm to utilize power of deep pre-trained neural networks, but which pre-trained model has a better ability to balance ``Plasticity-Stability", deserving to be chosen? The logit shift serves as a natural proxy because it represents the logit shift in CL scenarios. However, obtaining the logit shift requires huge computational cost, which hinders large-scale model selection. Existing theoretical analyses fail to offer an efficient alternative because of the assumption of uniform hidden layer widths, which ignores the structural heterogeneity (variable width and depth) of real-world architectures. This raises a critical question: what theoretically relationship can be identified between heterogeneous architecture and logit shift on prior tasks (that the model has been trained on)? To answer the question, we decouple logit shift into architecture dependency and data dependency to establish our framework, which reveals that the combination of two dependency, defined as Architecture-driven Shift (ADS), that can capture the logit shift tendency well computable with few data samples. Specifically, for a well-optimized model on prior tasks, higher ADS is associated with a larger logit shift after training on the current task, which derived based on three mechanistic components: (1) spectral norm scaling of weight matrix gradients with layer width, (2) the optimization path length of the new task, and (3) the asymptotic task conflict in wide networks. Extensive empirical results across more than 175 diverse architectures demonstrate a strong monotonic correlation (the weakest Spearman's $r_s=0.731$) between ADS and logit shift. Practically, we demonstrate that ADS can serve as a lightweight proxy of the expected calibration error, which is a widely used metric for reliable CL model selection, on three datasets across six scenarios.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes ADS (Architecture-driven Shift) as a theoretical framework connecting heterogeneous neural architecture properties to logit shift in continual learning. ADS captures logit shift tendency efficiently using three mechanistic components: spectral norm scaling, optimization path length, and asymptotic task conflict.
