AI.motivation: SpeechLLMs are increasingly deployed in professional settings with domain customization, involving sensitive context in prompts and proprietary fine-tuning data—creating an overlooked privacy risk that has not been systematically investigated.
AI.method: Controlled dataset construction; systematic measurement of leakage rates across two customization mechanisms (prompting and fine-tuning); evaluation of prompt-level mitigation strategies; accuracy-leakage trade-off analysis.
AI.result: Both prompting and fine-tuning cause measurable information leakage; leakage compounds when both mechanisms are combined; fine-tuning without context prompts achieves the best balance between utility and privacy.
AI.conclusion: Fine-tuning without context prompts offers the best accuracy-leakage trade-off; prompt-level mitigation provides partial defense; combined customization mechanisms compound the leakage risk.

title: Commit to the Bit: Reactive Reinforcement Learning Done Right
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms are commonly analyzed (and designed) under the Markov assumption. This is unrealistic, as most environments encountered in practice are either partially observable, or require function approximation that restricts the agent to access non-Markovian state features. We consider the problem of learning an optimal reactive policy in a finite environment with deterministic observations (or equivalently, hard state aggregation). We introduce a new algorithm, Committed Q-learning, and prove almost-sure convergence to the optimal reactive policy under an intuitive assumption we call rewire-robustness. This assumption is strictly weaker than the $q_\star$-realizability condition used in prior work. Our algorithm is a variant of classical Q-learning in which the behavior policy commits to a single action upon entering a feature, and only resamples actions when the observed feature changes. A crucial part of our analysis is the introduction of quasi-Markov environments.

AI.tldr: 研究非马尔可夫环境下的强化学习问题，提出Committed Q-learning算法，在较弱的rewire-robustness假设下证明收敛性，引入quasi-Markov环境作为关键分析工具。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习算法依赖马尔可夫假设，但实际环境中普遍存在部分可观测性或函数近似限制导致状态特征非马尔可夫性，需要突破这一限制。
AI.method: 通过引入quasi-Markov环境框架证明算法收敛性，算法核心是行为策略在进入特征时commit到单一动作，仅当观察到特征变化时才重新采样动作。
AI.result: 在rewire-robustness假设下证明几乎必然收敛到最优反应式策略，该假设比之前的q⋆-realizability条件更弱。
AI.conclusion: 提出committed Q-learning算法，在比q⋆-realizability更弱的rewire-robustness假设下几乎必然收敛到最优反应式策略，为非马尔可夫环境下的强化学习提供了新的理论基础。

title: Plant, Persist, Trigger: Sleeper Attack on Large Language Model Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents remain vulnerable to safety threats from the external environment, where attackers inject adversarial content into external observations such as tool-returned data, webpages, or MCP context, causing harmful agentic behaviors such as unsafe actions or incorrect outputs. Existing studies typically focus on single-interaction attacks, where the agent observes adversarial content and immediately exhibits harmful behavior within one user request. However, we show that adversarial content can also persist across interactions served by the same agent, making such threats harder to detect and mitigate. Specifically, adversarial content may persist in the agent state, remain dormant across interactions, and later be activated by a benign user query. We formalize this type of safety threat as Sleeper Attack. To evaluate it, we construct a benchmark with 1,896 instances covering six real-world harmful outcomes, three attack strategies, and three agent state targets: session context, memory, and reusable skills. Experiments on seven strong open-source and closed-source LLMs show that state-of-the-art LLM agents remain vulnerable to Sleeper Attack, even when they achieve low attack success rates under a single-interaction baseline. Our code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/skdvnfu23ihr9wdscnksf1asdffsaef.

AI.tldr: 论文首次提出Sleeper Attack（潜伏攻击）概念，揭示敌对内容可持久化于代理状态并跨交互激活的危害机制，通过大规模基准测试证实当前先进LLM代理均存在此漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅关注单次交互攻击，但敌对内容可通过代理状态持久化跨交互存在，在后续被良性用户查询激活，构成更难检测和缓解的安全威胁。
AI.method: 构建包含1,896个实例的基准测试，覆盖6种有害结果、3种攻击策略、3种代理状态目标（会话上下文、记忆、可复用技能）。在7个开源和闭源强LLM上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 即使在单次交互基线下攻击成功率低的LLM代理，面对Sleeper Attack仍存在显著漏洞。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理普遍易受Sleeper Attack攻击，现有安全评估方法存在显著盲区。需要在状态管理、持久化内容审查和跨交互安全检测方面加强防护。

title: IFMTBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multilingual Translation Instruction Following
summary: Modern translation workflows demand more than semantic equivalence. Users routinely require models to preserve JSON or HTML schemas, honor curated glossaries, disambiguate with provided context, and match prescribed registers, often several at once. Conventional metrics such as BLEU and xCOMET capture semantic fidelity but provide little signal on constraint adherence, while general instruction following benchmarks ignore the cross-lingual nature of translation. We introduce \bench, a benchmark for multilingual translation instruction following covering seven languages, with 4,506 single-constraint and 2,838 multi-constraint items spanning six constraint dimensions and five compositional patterns with instructions issued in all seven languages. Constraints are split into a gating subset verified by deterministic checkers and a continuous subset scored by a rubric-based LLM judge, combined under a multiplicative rule that resists reward hacking. Evaluating 15 models reveals systematic gaps that prior protocols miss: Instruction following scales with size more sharply than translation quality, glossary and structured-format constraints dominate the difficulty gradient, and general instruction following rankings correlate only weakly with translation behavior. Our benchmark are available at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-MT2/tree/main/IFMTBench.

AI.tldr: IFMTBench是一个多语言翻译指令跟随基准，通过门控子集+连续子集的乘法组合评分方式，系统评估模型在术语表、结构化格式、语境消歧等6维约束上的遵守能力，揭示了当前模型在翻译约束遵守方面的系统性不足。
AI.motivation: 现有评估指标（BLEU、xCOMET）仅关注语义忠实度，无法评估约束遵守能力；通用指令跟随基准忽视了翻译的跨语言特性，无法满足现代翻译工作流对JSON/HTML格式保留、术语表遵守、语境消歧和语域匹配等多维度约束遵守的需求。
AI.method: 构建了包含7种语言、4,506个单约束和2,838个多约束样本的评估基准，涵盖6个约束维度和5种组合模式。约束分为两部分：确定性检验器验证的门控子集和基于评分标准的LLM评判器评分子集，采用乘法规则组合以抵抗奖励黑客。
AI.result: 评估15个模型揭示了此前协议未能发现的系统性差距：指令跟随能力随模型规模的增长幅度比翻译质量更显著；术语表约束和结构化格式约束在难度梯度中占主导地位；通用指令跟随排名与翻译行为的相关性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 研究引入了一个多语言翻译指令跟随评估基准，填补了现有评估框架忽视翻译任务约束遵守能力的空白。实验发现通用指令跟随能力与翻译行为相关性较弱，表明需要专门的翻译评估协议。

title: AtomComposer: Discovering Chemical Space from First Principles with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Discovering novel stable molecules without training data remains a grand scientific challenge. Current molecular generative models are trained on large, pre-curated datasets, which introduce biases and limit exploration of novel chemistry. In contrast, we propose a new paradigm: autonomous, generalized agents capable of mapping vast, unknown chemical spaces without any pretraining. For the first time, we present AtomComposer, a self-guided agent that autonomously constructs valid 3D isomers under stoichiometric constraints and is trained exclusively online using reinforcement learning. Unlike existing approaches that generally overfit to a specific chemical formula, we establish a multi-composition training scheme that enables a broad generalization across diverse chemistry, guided by energy- and validity-based rewards. Our agent can discover up to an order of magnitude more valid isomers on unseen test formulas than existing single-composition reinforcement-learning baselines trained with per-step energy rewards. These results fulfill the promise of online reinforcement learning as a powerful paradigm for scalable, from-scratch exploration of chemical configuration space.

AI.tldr: 提出AtomComposer，一种无需预训练、通过在线强化学习训练的自引导智能体，可在化学计量约束下自主构建3D异构体。采用多组分训练实现跨化学组成的广泛泛化，在未见化学式上发现的有效异构体数量显著超越单组分基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有分子生成模型依赖大规模预筛选数据集，存在偏差且限制了新化学领域的探索。需要一种无需预训练即可发现新颖稳定分子的方法。
AI.method: AtomComposer是一个自引导智能体，在化学计量约束下自主构建有效3D异构体，完全通过在线强化学习训练。采用多组分训练方案，跨越多种化学组成进行泛化，由能量和有效性奖励引导。
AI.result: 在未见测试化学式上，发现的有效异构体数量比现有单组分强化学习基线方法提升了一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Online reinforcement learning is a powerful paradigm for scalable, from-scratch exploration of chemical configuration space.

title: Adaptive Bandit Algorithms for Contextual Matching Markets
summary: We study bandit learning in matching markets, where players and arms constitute the two market sides, and the players' utilities are linear in the arm contexts. In each round, new arms arrive with observable contexts. Then, the algorithm matches them to players, aiming to minimize each player's regret against a stable matching benchmark. This contextual structure creates significant complexity: subtle context shifts can slightly alter one player's utility while completely reconfiguring the underlying benchmark, causing large regret spikes for others. We address this in two settings: stochastic contexts, drawn from a latent distribution, and adversarial contexts, which may be arbitrary. For the stochastic case, we introduce a novel minimum preference gap to capture learning difficulty and provide a fully adaptive algorithm with an instance-dependent poly-logarithmic regret upper bound. We also establish matching instance-independent regret upper and lower bounds under a mild distributional assumption. For the adversarial setting, we propose a tractable regret notion that remains valid under arbitrary contexts and achieves an instance-independent sublinear regret bound via an adaptive algorithm.

AI.tldr: 研究双边匹配市场中上下文多臂老虎机问题，对抗微上下文变化导致基准大幅波动的挑战。随机情境引入最小偏好间隙实现poly-log遗憾；对抗情境提出新遗憾度量实现次线性遗憾。
AI.motivation: 本文研究双边匹配市场中的上下文多臂老虎机问题。核心挑战在于：上下文结构的复杂性——微小的上下文变化可能略微改变单个玩家的效用，却能完全重构底层稳定匹配基准，导致其他玩家产生巨大的遗憾冲击。这一特性使得传统的上下文老虎机方法难以直接应用。
AI.method: 1) 针对随机情境：引入"最小偏好间隙"(minimum preference gap)作为学习难度指标，设计自适应算法实现实例依赖的poly-log遗憾；2) 针对对抗性情境：提出新的适用于任意上下文环境的遗憾度量，设计自适应算法实现实例无关的次线性遗憾上界。
AI.result: 随机情境下：提出最小偏好间隙度量学习难度，提供实例依赖的poly-log对数遗憾上界算法；在温和分布假设下证明实例无关的遗憾上界和下界。对抗性情境下：提出新的可行遗憾定义，实现任意上下文下的实例无关次线性遗憾上界。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在上下文强盗与稳定匹配市场的交叉领域取得了重要进展。对于随机情境设置，提出了基于"最小偏好间隙"的实例依赖的poly-log对数遗憾上界；对于对抗性情境，提出了新的可行遗憾概念和次线性遗憾上界。这项工作为双边匹配市场中的在线学习提供了理论基础和实用算法。

title: Learning When to Optimize: Verified Optimization Skills from Expert GPU-Kernel Lineages
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to generate GPU kernels, but they often know what optimizations to try without knowing when those optimizations are sound. We introduce KLineage, which learns this missing "when" knowledge from expert kernels: instead of relying on forward rollouts, KLineage walks expert implementations backward through validation-gated simplifications and reverses each accepted step into a reusable optimization skill. Each skill records not only the optimization intent, but also where it applies in code, what conditions made it valid, what effect it had, and what failures its assumptions avoid. A downstream LLM materializes these skills on new code surfaces under the same compile/correctness/profile gate. On five expert workloads across two NVIDIA architectures, these lineage-derived skills serve as an effective optimization curriculum, exceeding recent memory-based LLM-kernel baselines in both final kernel quality and optimization efficiency under the same fixed budget. We additionally use a separate 22-instance held-out check as a sanity test against source-case memorization.

AI.tldr: KLineage通过逆向分析专家GPU内核生成可验证的优化技能知识库，使下游LLM能够在新代码上安全应用这些优化技能，在专家工作负载上实现了超越基线的高质量内核生成和优化效率。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理在生成GPU内核时缺乏关键的"何时"知识——知道要尝试哪些优化，却不知道何时应用这些优化是合理的，导致优化效果受限。
AI.method: KLineage通过验证门控的简化过程逆向遍历专家实现，将每个接受的步骤反转并记录为可重用的优化技能（包括优化意图、代码位置、有效性条件、执行效果及假设失败规避信息）。下游LLM在相同编译/正确性/性能门控下将这些技能物化到新代码中。
AI.result: 在两个NVIDIA架构的五个专家工作负载上，基于谱系衍生技能的优化课程在最终内核质量和固定预算下的优化效率方面均优于近期的基于记忆的LLM内核基线。此外，在独立22个实例的保留测试上验证了方法具有抗源码案例记忆化的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: KLineage通过从专家内核逆向推导可验证的优化技能，有效解决了LLM代理在GPU内核优化中"何时应用"的难题，在五个专家工作负载上超越了基于记忆的基线方法，且在独立测试集上验证了泛化能力。

title: Supervised Semantic Differential for Cross-Cultural Concept Analysis: A Case Study of Human Affect
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, excluding the appendices. Code to reproduce our results is available at https://github.com/przebor/Cross-Cultural-SSD
summary: Cross-cultural comparison of psychological meaning requires methods that go beyond word-level translation and examine how semantic dimensions are organized across languages. We introduce a cross-lingual extension of the Supervised Semantic Differential (SSD), which estimates supervised semantic gradients in embedding space and compares them across aligned multilingual word embeddings. The method tests gradient alignment and difference using permutation procedures and bootstrap intervals, and interprets residual differences through clustering around the difference gradient. We demonstrate the approach on Polish, English, and French affective norm lexicons, modeling Valence, Arousal, and Dominance where available. Affective dimensions were significantly recoverable across languages and model settings. Cross-lingual comparisons showed broad alignment together with structured residual differences: Valence appeared mostly shared, whereas Arousal and Dominance produced more interpretable contrasts involving bodily threat, aesthetic stimulation, internal emotionality, macro-level authority, and everyday control. Several clusters also reflected corpus-specific artifacts, underscoring the need for cautious interpretation. Cross-lingual SSD offers an explainable framework for testing semantic alignment, identifying divergence, and generating hypotheses about cross-cultural differences in psychological meaning.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出跨语言监督语义差异法（SSD），用于比较不同语言中情感维度的语义组织。在波兰语、英语和法语上的实验表明，情感维度（效价、唤醒度、支配度）可跨语言恢复，其中效价高度共享，而唤醒度和支配度揭示了更多文化特异性差异，包括身体威胁、美学刺激等概念维度。
AI.motivation: 跨文化心理意义比较需要超越词级翻译的方法，考察语义维度在不同语言中如何组织，因此需要开发能够比较跨语言语义组织的技术手段。
AI.method: 使用跨语言扩展的监督语义差异法（SSD），在嵌入空间中估计监督语义梯度，并通过排列检验和Bootstrap区间测试梯度对齐与差异，通过对差异梯度进行聚类来解释残余差异。
AI.result: 情感维度在语言间显著可恢复。跨语言比较显示广泛对齐与结构化残余差异：效价基本共享，而唤醒度和支配度产生更多可解释的对比，涉及身体威胁、美学刺激、内部情绪性、宏观权威和日常控制等方面。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言SSD为检验语义对齐、识别分歧及生成跨文化心理意义差异假设提供了一个可解释的框架。该方法成功恢复了三种语言中的情感维度，证明了跨语言语义比较的可行性。

title: ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation
summary: Proactive Recommender Systems (PRSs) aim to guide user preference shift toward target items by generating paths of intermediate recommendations. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for optimizing such sequential decision tasks, as path rewards can naturally capture both short-term acceptance and long-term guidance effectiveness. However, naively applying policy gradients to PRS results in deficient gradient estimation. We identify two deficiencies: (1) path-level rewards decompose into step-level rewards with positive mean, creating a length-dependent bias that causes gradients to favor path extension over meaningful exploration; (2) weighting each step by the entire path-level reward ignores the decomposition structure, leading to high gradient variance. To rectify these two deficiencies, we propose an effective RL framework ProRL with two novel mechanisms for proactive recommendation. First, Stepwise Reward Centering subtracts expected rewards to neutralize length-dependent bias, ensuring that path extension yields zero expected gradient signal. Second, Position-Specific Advantage Estimation leverages the reward decomposition structure to compute step-dependent baselines, reducing gradient variance. Together, these mechanisms yield policy gradients that precisely target path quality. Our experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that ProRL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art PRSs. Our code is available at https://github.com/hongruhou89/ProRL.

AI.tldr: ProRL addresses deficiencies in applying policy gradients to proactive recommender systems by using stepwise reward centering to eliminate length-dependent bias and position-specific advantage estimation to reduce gradient variance, achieving superior performance in guiding user preferences through recommendation paths.
AI.motivation: Proactive Recommender Systems aim to guide user preference shifts toward target items via paths of intermediate recommendations. While reinforcement learning provides a principled framework for optimizing such sequential decision tasks, naive policy gradient applications result in two critical deficiencies: (1) path-level rewards decompose into step-level rewards with positive mean, creating a length-dependent bias that favors path extension over meaningful exploration; (2) weighting each step by entire path-level reward ignores decomposition structure, leading to high gradient variance.
AI.method: The paper proposes ProRL, a reinforcement learning framework with two novel mechanisms: (1) Stepwise Reward Centering, which subtracts expected rewards to neutralize length-dependent bias by ensuring path extension yields zero expected gradient signal; (2) Position-Specific Advantage Estimation, which leverages reward decomposition structure to compute step-dependent baselines, reducing gradient variance.
AI.result: Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that ProRL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art proactive recommender systems.
AI.conclusion: The ProRL framework effectively addresses policy gradient deficiencies in proactive recommender systems by introducing stepwise reward centering and position-specific advantage estimation, achieving significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art methods on three real-world datasets.

title: Why We Need Speech to Evaluate Speech Translation
summary: Speech translation models are increasingly capable of preserving speech-specific information (e.g., speaker gender, prosody, and emphasis), yet evaluation metrics remain blind to such phenomena. We meta-evaluate both text- and speech-based quality estimation metrics on two contrastive datasets targeting gender agreement and prosody, and find that both fall short, even when given direct access to the speech signal. We then train SpeechCOMET, a family of quality estimation models with speech encoders, and evaluate a state-of-the-art SpeechLLM as a judge. Both match or exceed text-based COMET on standard quality estimation, but neither consistently assesses speech-specific phenomena. We identify three causes: (1) speech-specific features are not reliably preserved in current encoders, (2) models tend to ignore the speech source signal, and (3) quality estimation training data contains too few relevant examples. We release all models and code, and argue that progress requires dedicated speech-specific training data and models that genuinely condition on speech.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了当前语音翻译质量估计方法的根本缺陷：即使结合语音信号的模型也无法可靠评估语音特定属性（如性别、韵律），原因是编码器特征保留不足、模型忽视语音信号、训练数据稀缺。研究呼吁开发专门的语音质量评估训练集和真正条件于语音输入的模型。
AI.motivation: 语音翻译模型日益能够保留说话人性别、韵律、强调等语音特定信息，但现有评估指标无法捕捉这些现象，导致无法有效评估模型对语音特征的保留能力。
AI.method: 研究对比评估了针对性别一致性和韵律的对照数据集，采用两类方法：(1) 对文本和语音质量估计指标进行元评估；(2) 训练SpeechCOMET系列模型（基于语音编码器）并评估前沿SpeechLLM作为评判者。
AI.result: SpeechCOMET和SpeechLLM在标准质量估计任务上达到或超越文本基准COMET，但在语音特定现象评估上均未表现稳定可靠。
AI.conclusion: 研究指出三个根本原因：(1) 当前编码器未能可靠保留语音特定特征；(2) 模型倾向于忽略语音源信号；(3) 质量估计训练数据中相关示例过少。推进该领域需要专门的语音特定训练数据和真正基于语音条件建模的模型。

title: Machine Learning methods for event classification and vertex reconstruction of the 12C + 12C reaction with the MATE-TPC
summary: In modern nuclear physics experiments, identifying events of interest is challenging for nuclear reaction studies with the active target Time Projection Chamber (TPC). In this work, machine learning techniques are employed to analyze the complex data of the 12C + 12C fusion reaction from a TPC named MATE (multi-purpose active-target time projection chamber for nuclear experiments). Specifically, we successfully applied Residual Neural Network (ResNet-50, ResNet-34 and ResNet-18) and Visual Geometry Group (VGG-19) to classify elastic scattering and fusion reaction events from the 12C + 12C reaction. The classification results of the four models are nearly identical, with accuracies of approximately 97% for the simulated data and 90% for the experimental data. Moreover, these approaches successfully identify some events that are misclassified by traditional methods. These models are also applied to classify events from different fusion reaction channels, with classification accuracies of approximately 95% on simulated data. In addition, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model is developed to reconstruct the reaction vertex, providing an alternative strategy for vertex reconstruction. These results indicate that machine learning techniques can effectively classify reaction events from different channels and reconstruct the reaction vertex, thereby paving the way for future analyses of complex nuclear reaction data.

AI.tldr: 本研究将ResNet和VGG-19等深度学习模型应用于MATE-TPC的12C+12C融合反应数据分析，实现了约97%的模拟数据分类准确率和约90%的实验数据分类准确率，并成功识别了传统方法的误分类事件，同时开发了CNN顶点重建方法，为复杂核反应数据分析提供了新的技术途径。
AI.motivation: 现代核物理实验中，利用主动靶时间投影室（TPC）识别感兴趣事件面临挑战，传统方法存在分类误差，需要更先进的技术来提高事件识别精度和效率。
AI.method: 采用残差神经网络（ResNet-50/34/18）和VGG-19对12C+12C融合反应的弹性散射和融合反应事件进行分类；同时开发CNN模型用于重建反应顶点位置。
AI.result: 四种深度学习模型的分类结果几乎一致，模拟数据准确率约97%，实验数据约90%；成功识别了传统方法误分类的事件；不同融合反应通道分类准确率约95%；CNN模型可有效重建反应顶点。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习方法能够有效区分不同核反应通道事件并重建反应顶点，为未来复杂核反应数据的分析提供了新途径。ResNet和VGG-19模型在模拟数据和实验数据上都取得了优异的分类性能，且CNN模型可作为顶点重建的替代策略。

title: When Does Memory Help Multi-Trajectory Inference for Tool-Use LLM Agents?
comment: More evaluation and analysis are on the way
summary: Multi-trajectory inference for tool-use LLM agents - generating multiple reasoning attempts and selecting among them - benefits from transferring knowledge across attempts so that later ones avoid the pitfalls of earlier ones. Existing cross-trajectory memory methods (trajectory-level reflection, atomic fact extraction, raw observation injection) are each evaluated under a single inference strategy on a single task, making it unclear whether reported gains reflect properties of the memory abstraction or of the inference method. We propose a unified framework that decomposes memory along two axes -- the scope of transfer (within an expansion vs. across trajectories) and the abstraction of the transferred content -- and evaluate four methods under three inference strategies (best-of-N, beam search, MCTS) on four tool-use benchmarks spanning SQL, knowledge-graph, and CLI environments, in a verifier-free setting that matches the deployment regime of practical agents. The experiment matrix identifies the inference method as a confound: the same memory method produces statistically distinct results under different inference strategies on the same examples. Reflection reaches significance only under MCTS (not under best-of-N); within-expansion injection (conditioning each candidate on prior siblings' outcomes) helps only diversity-starved beam search; and atomic fact extraction is accuracy-neutral but shortens trajectories by 19-26% on tasks with reusable environmental structure.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多轨迹LLM代理中跨轨迹记忆方法的评估陷阱：推理策略是重要混杂因素，同一记忆方法在不同推理策略下效果迥异，需在多种推理策略下系统评估记忆方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨轨迹记忆方法（轨迹级反思、原子事实提取、原始观察注入）仅在单一推理策略和单一任务上进行评估，导致无法判断所报告的性能提升是源于记忆抽象本身的特性还是推理方法的特性。
AI.method: 提出一个统一框架，沿两个维度分解记忆：(1)转移范围（扩展内vs跨轨迹）；(2)转移内容的抽象级别。在四个工具使用基准测试（SQL、知识图谱、CLI环境）上，使用三种推理策略（最佳-of-N、束搜索、MCTS）评估四种方法，采用与实际代理部署相符的无验证器设置。
AI.result: 推理方法被识别为关键混杂因素：(1)反思仅在MCTS下达到显著性；(2)扩展内注射（基于先验兄弟结果调节候选）仅对缺乏多样性的束搜索有帮助；(3)原子事实提取对准确率无影响，但在具有可复用环境结构的任务中将轨迹缩短19-26%。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现推理方法是一个重要混杂因素：相同的记忆方法在不同推理策略下产生统计学上显著不同的结果。反思机制仅在MCTS下显著有效；扩展内注射仅有助于多样性不足的束搜索；原子事实提取虽然准确率无差异，但可将轨迹缩短19-26%。本研究强调需要在多种推理策略下评估记忆方法，其有效性高度依赖于具体推理方法的选择。

title: When Seekers Are Hard to Help: Evaluating Emotional Support Dialogue Systems in Worst-Case Interactions
summary: Emotional Support Dialogue Systems (ESDSes) are increasingly evaluated and trained with LLM-simulated seekers. However, such simulated seekers often behave as cooperative, average-case users who disclose clearly, respond constructively, and accept support within a few turns. This can lead to overly optimistic evaluation and obscure whether ESDSes can handle difficult help-seeking interactions. In this work, we study ESDS evaluation under worst-case interactions, where seekers are hard to help due to low engagement, resistance, limited self-disclosure, emotional volatility, or rigid negative interpretations. We first conduct an expert simulation study with eight experienced counselling professionals, who simulate difficult seekers, interact with existing Chinese ESDSes, provide scale ratings, and participate in semi-structured interviews. Based on this study, we derive worst-case seeker behaviours and identify key limitations of current systems. We then propose a worst-case evaluation framework consisting of an LLM-based worst-case seeker simulator and four worst-case-oriented metrics: Deep Emotional Understanding, Guided Exploration, Balanced Emotional Support, and Authentic and Grounded Support. Evaluating 17 systems, we find that nearly all models suffer substantial performance drops under worst-case interactions. Large general-purpose LLMs are generally more robust than specialised ESDSes, but even the strongest models struggle to sustain engagement and improve seekers' emotional states. Finally, we show that worst-case simulation can also generate useful training data, improving the robustness of smaller models.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses overly optimistic evaluation of Emotional Support Dialogue Systems caused by cooperative simulated seekers. The authors propose a worst-case evaluation framework with an LLM-based simulator and four metrics, finding that most models perform poorly under difficult help-seeking interactions, though large LLMs outperform specialized ESDSes.
AI.motivation: Current ESDSes are evaluated with LLM-simulated seekers that behave cooperatively (clear disclosure, constructive responses, quick acceptance of support). This leads to overly optimistic evaluation and obscures whether systems can handle difficult real-world interactions involving low engagement, resistance, limited self-disclosure, emotional volatility, or rigid negative interpretations.
AI.method: Expert simulation study with 8 counselling professionals simulating difficult seekers interacting with Chinese ESDSes, followed by development of an LLM-based worst-case seeker simulator with four evaluation metrics (Deep Emotional Understanding, Guided Exploration, Balanced Emotional Support, Authentic and Grounded Support). The framework was validated by evaluating 17 systems.
AI.result: Nearly all 17 evaluated models suffer substantial performance drops under worst-case interactions. Large general-purpose LLMs are generally more robust than specialized ESDSes, but even the strongest models struggle to sustain engagement and improve seekers' emotional states. Worst-case simulation can generate useful training data to improve the robustness of smaller models.
AI.conclusion: Large general-purpose LLMs are more robust than specialized ESDSes under worst-case conditions, but even the strongest models struggle to sustain engagement and improve seekers' emotional states. Worst-case simulation can also generate useful training data to improve smaller models' robustness.

title: T-GINEE: A Tensor-Based Multilayer Graph Representation Learning
summary: Traditional network analysis focuses on single-layer networks, real-world systems often form multilayer networks with multiple relationship types. However, existing methods typically fail to capture complex inter-layer dependencies by treating layers independently or aggregating them. To address this, we propose T-GINEE (Tensor-Based Generalized Multilayer-graph Estimating Equation), a statistical regularization framework combining tensor-based generalized estimating equations with task-specific loss to model cross-network correlations explicitly. Key innovations include: (1) CP tensor decomposition capturing structural dependencies via shared latent factors; (2) a generalized estimating equation framework modeling inter-layer correlations through working covariance matrices; and (3) a flexible link function accommodating characteristics like sparsity. Our theoretical analysis establishes consistency and asymptotic normality under mild conditions. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate T-GINEE's effectiveness for multilayer network analysis.

AI.tldr: T-GINEE proposes a novel tensor-based statistical regularization framework combining generalized estimating equations with task-specific loss to explicitly model cross-network correlations in multilayer networks. It leverages CP tensor decomposition for capturing structural dependencies and working covariance matrices for inter-layer correlation modeling. The framework achieves theoretical guarantees (consistency, asymptotic normality) while demonstrating empirical effectiveness across synthetic and real-world datasets.
AI.motivation: Traditional network analysis methods inadequately handle multilayer networks where real-world systems exhibit multiple relationship types. Existing approaches either treat layers independently (ignoring dependencies) or aggregate them (losing structural information), resulting in failure to capture complex inter-layer dependencies inherent in real-world systems.
AI.method: T-GINEE employs three key technical components: (1) CP tensor decomposition to capture structural dependencies through shared latent factors; (2) generalized estimating equation framework with working covariance matrices to model inter-layer correlations; (3) flexible link function to accommodate network characteristics such as sparsity. The approach integrates statistical regularization with task-specific loss for modeling cross-network correlations.
AI.result: Theoretical analysis establishes consistency and asymptotic normality under mild conditions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets validate the framework's effectiveness for multilayer network analysis.
AI.conclusion: T-GINEE provides an effective and statistically principled solution for multilayer network analysis, balancing model flexibility with theoretical guarantees. The framework demonstrates practical utility through empirical validation while maintaining theoretical rigor under mild conditions.

title: PIRS: Physics-Informed Reward Shaping for SAC-Based Building Energy Management
comment: N pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on AI-Driven Energy Efficiency in Dynamic Systems (AI-DEEDS '26), co-located with ACM e-Energy / ACM Sustainability Week, Banff, AB, Canada, June 22-25, 2026
summary: Occupant comfort and grid-aware energy efficiency are competing objectives whose joint optimization depends critically on how reward functions are specified in deep reinforcement learning (DRL) controllers for buildings. Yet reward design remains largely ad hoc: comfort terms are either hand-tuned heuristics or simple temperature-deviation proxies without explicit grounding in thermal-comfort physics. We present PIRS (Physics-Informed Reward Shaping), which replaces these ad-hoc comfort proxies with the ISO 7730 Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) formulation inside a weighted multi-objective reward for Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). By anchoring the comfort signal in the ISO 7730 PMV formulation, PIRS improves reward interpretability and provides a standards-grounded comfort proxy without changing any other component of the learning pipeline. We evaluate PIRS in CityLearn v2.1.2 (challenge 2022 phase 1) with a central SAC agent trained for 50k steps over five random seeds, and compare against a rule-based controller (RBC), a manually engineered reward (E2), an energy-only reward (E3), and a naive temperature-deviation comfort reward (E4). District-level key performance indicators (KPIs), reported as ratios versus RBC, show that PIRS attains cost, carbon, and electricity metrics on par with the manual baseline while substantially outperforming non-physics-grounded designs -- particularly on load ramping (1.78x vs. ~2.4x RBC) and daily peak demand. All DRL policies remain above RBC at this training budget; we interpret this gap honestly and position PIRS as an interpretable, standards-aligned foundation for reward design rather than a claim of dominance over classical control at limited compute.

AI.tldr: PIRS将ISO 7730 PMV热舒适公式替代传统的经验性舒适代理，集成到SAC的奖励函数中，显著提升了奖励的可解释性和标准对齐性，在建筑能源管理任务中优于非物理基础的奖励设计。
AI.motivation: 当前DRL建筑控制器的奖励设计主要依赖经验性方法，舒适项通常是手工调整的启发式方法或简单的温度偏差代理，缺乏与热舒适物理学的明确关联。
AI.method: 将ISO 7730 PMV热舒适模型集成到SAC的加权多目标奖励函数中，使用CityLearn v2.1.2环境进行评估，中央SAC智能体训练50k步，5个随机种子，对比RBC、手动设计奖励(E2)、仅能量奖励(E3)和简单温度偏差舒适奖励(E4)。
AI.result: PIRS在成本、碳排放和电力指标上与手动基线相当，显著优于非物理基础的设计，特别是在负载爬坡(1.78x vs ~2.4x RBC)和每日峰值需求方面。所有DRL策略在此训练预算下均优于RBC。
AI.conclusion: PIRS作为可解释的、符合标准的基础方法，为建筑DRL控制中的奖励设计提供了新思路，但并非声称在有限计算资源下优于经典控制。

title: AI, Take the Wheel: What Drives Delegation and Trust in Human-Computer Cooperative Question Answering?
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 2026
summary: AI systems are fallible, and humans can make mistakes in deciding whether to trust AI over their own judgment. Thus, improving human-AI collaboration requires understanding when, why, and how humans decide to rely on AI. We study two distinct reliance decisions: the delegation choice -- deciding when to let AI act autonomously without knowing its output, and the adoption choice -- evaluating AI suggestions and deciding how to use them. Both of these decoupled reliance patterns shape collaboration, but prior work rarely studies them together in realistic settings with the same users. We address this gap by studying collaborative human--AI teams competing in a question-answering game in which humans can choose when and how to work with AI agents to win. Our 24 matches pair 23 expert humans with 16 AI agents, capturing 387 delegation and 1440 adoption decisions. While human--AI collaboration performs better than either AI or humans alone, humans make suboptimal collaboration decisions, both under-relying on correct AI suggestions (3.9% of opportunities missed) and over-relying when AI misleads them (1.7%). Both parties contribute wrong answers: reported model confidence is near chance when humans and AI disagree, while confirmation bias drives higher under-reliance (64.5%) when an AI suggestion agrees with humans' initial incorrect answer. To close this gap, we recommend calibrated confidence, evidence-grounded explanations, and mechanisms that help users refine trust.

AI.tldr: 研究人在问答游戏中的人机依赖决策模式，发现尽管人机协作效果最佳，人类仍存在次优信任行为：3.9%错失正确AI建议，1.7%过度依赖错误AI意见。模型置信度在校准和确认偏差方面存在问题，建议通过校正置信度、提供证据解释等机制改善人机协作。
AI.motivation: AI系统存在局限性，而人类在决定是否信任AI时也会犯错。因此需要理解人类何时、为何及如何依赖AI，以改善人机协作。但现有研究很少在真实场景中同时研究这两种依赖决策。
AI.method: 通过人机协作问答游戏研究两种依赖决策：委托选择（ delegation choice）和采纳选择（adoption choice）。24场比赛，23名专家与16个AI智能体，产生387个委托决策和1440个采纳决策。
AI.result: 人机协作表现优于单独使用AI或单独使用人类，但人类做出次优协作决策：误信AI错误建议（3.9%机会错失）和过度依赖AI误导（1.7%）。当人机意见不一致时，模型置信度接近随机；确认偏差导致当AI同意人类初始错误答案时，过度依赖率更高（64.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 推荐使用校正置信度、基于证据的解释，以及帮助用户修正信任的机制来改善人机协作中的信任决策。

title: PrunePath: Towards Highly Structured Sparse Language Models
summary: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) dominate the parameter count and computation of modern language models, yet existing pruning methods often struggle to convert sparsity into hardware-friendly inference efficiency gains. We introduce \textbf{PrunePath}, a budget-adaptive structured sparsification framework for FFN layers. Built on MoEfication, PrunePath replaces independent expert-wise thresholding with a softmax-normalized routing distribution and activates important experts under a cumulative-mass threshold. This formulation imposes a token-level probability budget, enabling adaptive expert counts and a direct inference-time sparsity knob from a single checkpoint. Across NLU, NLG, and instruction-tuning evaluations, PrunePath achieves a favorable sparsity--performance trade-off compared with existing static pruning and MoEfication-based methods. We further implement Triton kernels for KV-cache decoding to translate the resulting structured sparsity into practical memory savings and measurable decoding-speed improvements. These results demonstrate the superior performance of PrunePath for building highly sparse, deployment-friendly large language models.

AI.tldr: PrunePath提出一种基于累积质量阈值的预算自适应结构化稀疏方法，通过softmax归一化路由分布实现FFN层的专家级稀疏化，在保持性能的同时实现可调节的推理效率提升。
AI.motivation: 前馈网络(FFN)占据现代语言模型参数和计算的主体，但现有剪枝方法难以将稀疏性转化为硬件友好的推理效率。
AI.method: 基于MoEfication构建预算自适应结构化稀疏框架，用softmax归一化路由分布替代独立专家阈值化，在累积质量阈值下激活重要专家，实现令牌级概率预算控制和单一检查点的推理时稀疏度调节。
AI.result: 在NLU、NLG和指令微调评估中相比静态剪枝和MoEfication方法实现更优的稀疏度-性能权衡，通过Triton内核实现KV-cache解码的实际内存节省和可测量的解码速度提升。
AI.conclusion: PrunePath成功实现了高度稀疏且适合部署的大型语言模型构建，通过软路由机制和累积质量阈值实现了可解释的稀疏化控制和实际推理加速。

title: Compositional Generalization in Autoregressive Models via Logit Composition
summary: Composing autoregressive models remains a core challenge in understanding how large language models can combine behaviors or skills learned across tasks. We introduce a new and principled composition strategy for autoregressive systems, inspired by composition methods developed for diffusion models. Under a factorized-conditionals assumption, we show that the resulting composition is projective: each component model preserves control over its own designated subspace of the output distribution avoiding interference between models. This property is further preserved under smooth reparameterizations of the output space, yielding a feature-space theorem. Finally, we show that composition preserves length-generalizing behavior when the factorization assumptions and component guarantees hold uniformly at the target length. These results provide a principled understanding of when model composition and merging succeed in autoregressive systems and identify conditions under which their interactions remain stable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受扩散模型组合方法启发的自回归模型组合策略，在因子化条件假设下实现投影组合，各组件模型可独立控制输出分布的指定子空间，避免相互干扰。该方法在光滑重参数化下保持鲁棒性，并可保留长度泛化能力，为理解和预测模型合并的成功与失败提供了理论框架。
AI.motivation: 组合自回归模型是理解大型语言模型如何整合跨任务习得行为或技能的核心挑战，需要一种有原则的组合策略。
AI.method: 在因子化条件假设下，利用投影方法实现组合，使各组件模型保留对自身子空间的控制权，避免模型间干扰。该性质在输出空间的光滑重参数化下保持不变。
AI.result: 证明了特征空间定理（feature-space theorem），即投影性质在光滑重参数化下保持；验证了组合可保留长度泛化能力（前提是因子化假设和组件保证在目标长度下均匀成立）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为自回归模型组合提供了理论保障：明确了组合成功的条件，揭示了模型交互何时保持稳定，对模型合并技术的实践应用具有指导意义。

title: Entropy Distribution as a Fingerprint for Hallucinations in Generative Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate factually incorrect outputs, commonly termed hallucinations, that undermine trust and limit deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing hallucination detection methods typically require multiple forward passes, or access to model internals. In this work, we provide theoretical background and empirical evidence that the distribution of token-level entropies, beyond the mean captured by perplexity or length-normalised entropy, serves as a fingerprint of hallucination, with distributional shape and tail behaviour carrying independent signal. We formalize hallucination detection as a statistical hypothesis test and propose the Calibrated Entropy Score (CES), a lightweight algorithm requiring only a single forward pass and black-box access to token logits. CES combines the mean signal with the maximum signal of the generated entropy through a calibrated reference CDF, producing scores that are directly comparable across models and tasks. We establish finite-sample calibration guarantees via a novel random-length Dvoretzky--Kiefer--Wolfowitz inequality, and also prove that CES detects hallucinations with probability converging to one exponentially fast in the generation length. Across eight QA benchmarks and ten generator models spanning open-source and API access models, CES achieves the highest detection performance among all single-pass black-box methods while providing formal error guarantees that existing heuristics lack. Remarkably, CES is statistically indistinguishable from multi-sample methods that require far greater computational cost, closing the gap between lightweight and expensive detection and making it suitable for real-time, large-scale deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出CES（校准熵评分）方法，通过结合token级熵的均值和最大值信号，在单次前向传播内实现LLM幻觉检测，性能与多采样方法相当，同时具备形式化错误保证。
AI.motivation: LLMs frequently generate hallucinations (factually incorrect outputs), limiting deployment in high-stakes scenarios. Existing detection methods require multiple forward passes or access to model internals, making them computationally expensive and impractical for real-time deployment. Current entropy-based methods (perplexity, length-normalized entropy) only capture mean signals, missing distributional shape and tail behavior that carry independent hallucination signals.
AI.method: Calibrated Entropy Score (CES): combines mean and maximum token-level entropy signals via a calibrated reference CDF derived from training data; formulated as statistical hypothesis test; uses random-length DKW inequality for finite-sample calibration; requires only single forward pass with black-box logit access.
AI.result: Across 8 QA benchmarks and 10 generator models (open-source and API-access), CES achieves highest detection performance among all single-pass black-box methods, statistically indistinguishable from expensive multi-sample approaches.
AI.conclusion: CES achieves state-of-the-art performance among single-pass black-box methods, statistically matching multi-sample methods at a fraction of the computational cost, with formal error guarantees via DKW inequality and exponential convergence in generation length.

title: CIRF: Tokenizing Chain-of-Thoughts into Reusable Functional Units for Efficient Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Implicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reduces the inference cost of large language models by internalizing the explicit rationales. However, existing approaches typically lack alignment with explicit rationales and adaptivity to example complexity. In this work, we propose CIRF (\textit{\underline{C}hain-of-thoughts \underline{I}nto \underline{R}eusable \underline{F}unctional units}), an implicit CoT framework that performs reasoning as a dynamic sequence of discrete functional tokens. CIRF assigns a functional token to each semantically coherent reasoning unit in explicit CoT traces. The model is then fine-tuned to autoregressively generate functional tokens and their optional results, followed by the final answer. This design aligns latent reasoning with a sequence of functional units, facilitating parallel training, explicit rationale alignment, and adaptive reasoning. Extensive experiments on mathematical, symbolic, and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that CIRF provides a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off compared with state-of-the-art implicit CoT methods. Further analyses demonstrate that CIRF constructs distinct, interpretable functional tokens, leading to consistent performance improvements.

AI.tldr: CIRF提出将隐式思维链中的推理表示为离散功能token序列，通过功能token标记语义连贯的推理单元，实现显式原理对齐和自适应推理，在多种推理任务上实现优越的精度-延迟权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式CoT方法存在两个主要问题：1) 与显式推理原理对齐不足；2) 缺乏对不同复杂度示例的自适应能力。这些问题限制了隐式CoT在效率和效果上的表现。
AI.method: CIRF采用两阶段方法：1) 将显式CoT追踪中的每个语义连贯推理单元分配功能token；2) 微调模型自回归生成功能token及其可选结果，最后输出最终答案。这种设计将潜在推理与功能单元序列对齐，实现并行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，CIRF在数学推理、符号推理和常识推理基准上相比现有最先进的隐式CoT方法具有更优的精度-延迟权衡。进一步分析显示，CIRF构建了独特且可解释的功能token，带来一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CIRF通过将显式CoT推理分解为离散功能单元并分配功能token，在数学推理、符号推理和常识推理基准上实现了优于现有隐式CoT方法的精度-延迟权衡，且具有可解释性和一致的性能提升。

title: Learning to Assess the Reliability of Number-of-Runs Estimation in Stochastic Optimization
comment: Preprint version of a poster accepted at the Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference 2026 (GECCO 2026)
summary: In large-scale benchmarking of stochastic optimization algorithms, the key challenge is no longer whether repeated runs are needed for reliability, but how to determine when sufficient evidence has been collected without incurring unnecessary computational cost. We study a learning-based extension of a recent empirical online heuristic that adaptively estimates the required number of runs using outlier handling and skewness-based symmetry checks. Using annotated outcomes from 132{,}000 Nevergrad runs on COCO (24 problems in 20 dimensions, 10 instances each, 11 optimizers), we train classifiers on 23 statistical, energy-free, and shape and stability features to predict whether a run-number estimate is reliable, prioritizing detection of incorrect estimates via minority-class recall. We evaluate reliability prediction using a within-configuration learning setup, where models are trained and tested on data sharing the same optimizer. The results show that run-number reliability can be learned in a within-configuration scenario, enabling detection of unreliable estimates with high minority-class recall, although performance remains limited by the restricted data diversity within fixed configurations.

AI.tldr: The paper presents a learning-based method to predict reliability of adaptive run-number estimates for benchmarking stochastic optimization algorithms, achieving high minority-class recall for detecting incorrect estimates, though limited by within-configuration data diversity constraints.
AI.motivation: In large-scale benchmarking of stochastic optimization algorithms, determining when sufficient evidence has been collected without incurring unnecessary computational cost is a key challenge. Existing methods lack mechanisms to assess the reliability of run-number estimates adaptively.
AI.method: Classifiers trained on 23 features (statistical, energy-free, and shape/stability metrics) using annotated outcomes from 132,000 Nevergrad runs on COCO benchmark. Evaluation via within-configuration learning setup where models are trained and tested on data from the same optimizer.
AI.result: Run-number reliability can be learned in a within-configuration scenario, enabling detection of unreliable estimates with high minority-class recall. However, performance remains limited by restricted data diversity within fixed configurations.
AI.conclusion: The proposed learning-based approach shows promise for predicting run-number reliability in benchmarking, though practical applicability is limited by restricted data diversity within fixed configurations. The study establishes feasibility while identifying the need for more diverse training data across configurations.

title: Global Policy-Space Response Oracles for Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
summary: The Policy-Space Response Oracles (PSRO) framework scales equilibrium computation to large zero-sum games by iteratively expanding a restricted strategy set using deep reinforcement learning (DRL). A central challenge is to construct, under limited computational budgets, a small strategy population whose induced game well approximates the full game. Existing PSRO variants typically expand the population using best responses to meta-strategies computed from restricted-game payoffs, which can lead to inefficient expansions that provide limited global improvement. We propose to guide population expansion by directly evaluating the post-expansion population quality. Specifically, we adopt Population Exploitability (PE) to measure how well a restricted strategy set represents the full game, and introduce a two-phase exploration--selection framework that explicitly minimizes PE during expansion. We instantiate this framework as Global PSRO, a practical DRL-based algorithm that efficiently generates candidate responses and estimates PE via parameter-sharing conditional neural networks. Experiments across multiple two-player zero-sum games show that Global PSRO achieves lower exploitability and approximates Nash equilibria with significantly fewer policy iterations than prior PSRO methods.

AI.tldr: 针对PSRO框架中策略种群扩展效率低下的问题，提出了Global PSRO算法，通过两阶段探索-选择框架直接最小化种群开发度，结合参数共享条件神经网络估计PE，实现更高效的均衡计算。
AI.motivation: PSRO框架在大规模零和博弈中面临挑战：如何在有限计算预算下构建一个诱导博弈能良好近似完整博弈的小型策略种群；现有PSRO变体依赖元策略计算的最佳响应扩展策略集，效率较低。
AI.method: 提出两阶段探索-选择框架引导种群扩展，直接最小化种群开发度（PE）；使用参数共享条件神经网络估计PE，并通过DRL生成候选响应策略。
AI.result: 在多个两人零和博弈环境中，Global PSRO取得了更低的可利用性，并以显著更少的策略迭代次数逼近纳什均衡。
AI.conclusion: Global PSRO能够在大规模两人零和博弈中高效计算均衡策略。

title: Revisiting Anthropomorphic Reflection Markers in Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often produce explicit reflective traces during complex reasoning, accompanied by anthropomorphic markers such as wait, hmm, and alternatively. Although these markers are commonly used as visible indicators of reflection, their mechanisms remain unclear, which leaves the risk of overthinking associated with redundant and repetitive reflection markers. In this work, we revisit anthropomorphic reflection markers, examining their necessity for reasoning and role in the reflection. We suppress these markers through prompt-level and token-level interventions, and analyze their effects on task performance across four benchmarks and two model scales. Our results show that anthropomorphic markers are not uniformly necessary for reasoning performance: suppressing them can preserve or improve performance in several settings, especially under larger sampling budgets. Meanwhile, marker suppression does not necessarily remove reflection behavior, as models can still perform marker-free verification. These suggest that anthropomorphic markers tend to be surface cues rather than reliable proxies for reflection itself, and motivate future research on reasoning mechanisms beyond explicit marker patterns.

AI.tldr: 本研究重新审视LLMs的拟人反思标记，探究其对推理的必要性和在反思中的作用。
AI.motivation: LLMs在复杂推理中产生显式反思痕迹，包含wait、hmm等拟人标记，但这些标记的机制不明确，存在与冗余、重复反思相关的过度思考风险。
AI.method: 通过提示级和token级干预抑制反思标记，在四个基准测试和两种模型规模上评估任务性能变化。
AI.result: 拟人标记对推理性能并非普遍必要：抑制它们可在多种设置下保持或提升性能，尤其在较大采样预算下效果更明显；标记抑制不一定移除反思行为，模型仍可执行无标记验证。
AI.conclusion: 反思标记（wait、hmm等）是表面线索而非反思本身的可靠代理，过度思考风险与冗余标记相关。未来研究应关注超越显式标记模式的推理机制。

title: Hybrid Neural World Models
summary: Neural surrogates promise large speedups over classical solvers for physical dynamics but fail silently at sharp dynamical events such as shocks, fronts, and contact. We present hybrid neural world models for physical dynamics: a recipe for training and deploying multi-horizon surrogates in physical state space, where a single network with continuous horizon conditioning is trained with direct supervision against textbook reference solvers to predict any future state at horizon T in one forward pass. Although no part of the training data, loss function, or architecture supervises discontinuity location, the trained surrogate encodes it implicitly, recoverable from its forward passes alone as a per-trajectory error map that concentrates on shocks, fronts, and contacts, and stays small elsewhere. The map is competitive with or better than standard label-free baselines including deep ensembles, learned error heads, gradient-magnitude indicators, and locally-adaptive conformal prediction, while using only a single trained network and requiring no calibration set or governing-equation knowledge. The recipe supports two operating points. Mode 1 runs the surrogate alone for maximum throughput, with same-hardware CPU speedups of 26x to 72x against textbook solvers on the PDE environments. Mode 2 uses the error map to gate a reference-solver fallback, deferring uncertain trajectories and roughly halving the surrogate's residual error at the default operating point. The recipe applies without modification across reaction-diffusion, compressible Euler, and rigid-body collision dynamics.

AI.tldr: 针对神经替代模型在冲击波、前沿、接触等剧烈动力学事件中"无声失败"的问题，提出一种无需显式监督即可定位间断的自监督训练方法。该方法通过连续视野条件化的单一网络预测任意未来状态，并从其前向传播中提取误差图用于识别不确定性区域。误差图可作为无校准集、无方程先验知识的标签无关（label-free）不确定性估计器，支持高速独立推理模式（26x-72x加速）或回退到精确求解器的混合模式。该方法在反应-扩散、可压缩欧拉和刚体碰撞三类物理动力学中均有效。
AI.motivation: 现有神经 surrogate 在剧烈动力学事件（冲击波、前沿、接触）中会 silently fail，需要可靠检测机制但缺乏有效的无监督方法。
AI.method:
Continuous horizon conditioning的单网络多步预测 + 自监督误差图提取（无需显式监督间断位置）

无监督误差图自动编码 discontinuities，无需额外标注。
AI.result:
误差图可与/超越无需标注的基线方法（deep ensembles、learned error heads、梯度幅值指标、局部自适应 conformal prediction）竞争，仅需单网络且无需校准集或方程先验知识。

模式1在相同硬件上相比教科书求解器实现 CPU 26x-72x 加速；模式2通过误差图触发回退机制，将残差误差减半。
AI.conclusion:
该方法在反应-扩散、可压缩欧拉和刚体碰撞动力学三个领域均有效，无需修改即可迁移应用。

Two operating modes: (1) Mode 1 achieves 26x-72x CPU speedups; (2) Mode 2 uses error map to gate solver fallback, roughly halving residual error.

title: Do LLMs Build World Models From Text? A Multilingual Diagnostic of Spatial Reasoning
summary: Whether large language models (LLMs) construct internal spatial world models from pure-text descriptions remains contested, and whether such capabilities transfer across languages has not been systematically studied. We introduce MentalMap, a multilingual diagnostic benchmark with a six-level capability hierarchy (L0-L5) spanning atomic spatial facts to generative world-graph construction, together with four diagnostic axes probing frame of reference, reading-direction bias, reasoning-effort allocation, and hallucination. MentalMap is built from 100 ProcTHOR household scenes, covers eight typologically diverse languages plus a structured-text control, and contains 39 task families across 1,950 evaluation cells. Evaluating thirteen LLMs across scales and model families, we identify a universal L3 reasoning cliff: no model retains even half of its L0 performance on viewpoint reasoning once baseline atomic accuracy exceeds 40%. The cliff persists across languages, scales, and prompting strategies, while structured-output failures and reasoning patterns vary substantially across models. Human evaluation under the identical pure-text protocol reproduces the same failure pattern, suggesting that the bottleneck arises from text-only working memory constraints rather than being specific to current LLM architectures. Our findings reframe pure-text spatial reasoning as a multi-axis world-modeling problem and motivate multimodal and scratchpad-augmented reasoning as future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MentalMap多语言诊断基准，系统评估13个LLM在8种类型学多样语言上的空间推理能力，发现当原子准确率超过40%后存在普遍的L3推理悬崖现象，跨越语言和模型规模持续存在，人类评估复现相同模式，提示瓶颈源于纯文本工作记忆限制而非特定架构问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型能否从纯文本描述中构建内部空间世界模型存在争议，且此类能力是否跨语言迁移尚未得到系统研究。
AI.method: 构建MentalMap多语言诊断基准，包含六层级能力层级体系（L0-L5，从原子空间事实到生成性世界图构建），覆盖八个类型学多样语言加结构化文本控制条件，共39个任务族、1950个评估单元。同时设计四个诊断轴：参照系、阅读方向偏置、推理努力分配、幻觉。评估13个不同规模和架构的LLM。
AI.result: 发现通用L3推理悬崖现象：一旦基线原子准确率超过40%，任何模型在视角推理任务上的表现都无法达到其L0表现的一半。该悬崖跨越语言、模型规模、提示策略持续存在。结构化输出失败和推理模式在不同模型间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 提出了L3推理悬崖现象——当基线原子准确率超过40%后，所有模型在视角推理任务上的保持率均未达到L0表现的一半。该现象跨越语言、规模、提示策略持续存在，且人类评估在相同纯文本协议下复现了相同失败模式，表明瓶颈源于纯文本工作记忆限制而非特定模型架构。建议未来探索多模态和草稿板增强推理方案。

title: Routing-Aligned Fine-Tuning for Multilingual Downstream Tasks in Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as a dominant paradigm for efficient LLM scaling, yet adapting them to non-English downstream tasks remains challenging. Existing fine-tuning approaches treat MoE models as monolithic learners, ignoring the heterogeneous routing structure that develops during pretraining. We validate across multiple MoE models and downstream tasks that middle layers form a language-universal alignment zone where routing divergence strongly predicts per-language task performance gaps. Building on this observation, we propose RA-MoE (Routing-Aligned MoE Fine-Tuning), a three-stage framework that categorizes parallel task examples into a four-way taxonomy (cc/ci/ic/ii) based on correctness in English and the target language, identifies task-relevant experts in the middle layers, and augments standard SFT with a routing alignment loss that encourages target-language routing on ci-type examples to follow the English task-expert activation pattern. Experiments across three MoE models, three tasks, and six target languages demonstrate that RA-MoE consistently outperforms standard SFT and strong baselines including Routing Steering and RISE, with the ci proportion of a task-language pair serving as a reliable predictor of alignment benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文发现MoE中间层形成语言通用对齐区，路由分歧可预测语言间任务性能差距，并提出RA-MoE通过四分类和路由对齐损失提升非英语任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有微调方法将MoE模型视为整体，忽视了其预训练中形成的异构路由结构，导致非英语下游任务的适配困难。
AI.method: 提出RA-MoE框架，包含三个阶段：1) 将并行任务样本按英/目标语言正确性分为cc/ci/ic/ii四类；2) 识别中间层的任务相关专家；3) 使用路由对齐损失鼓励ci类型样本的目标语言路由追随英语任务专家激活模式。
AI.result: 在3个MoE模型、3个任务、6种目标语言上的实验表明，RA-MoE一致优于标准SFT及Routing Steering、RISE等强基线。
AI.conclusion: RA-MoE通过三阶段框架和路由对齐损失，有效解决了MoE模型在非英语任务中的适配问题，ci类型样本比例可作为预测对齐收益的可靠指标。

title: Learning the Error Patterns of Language Models
summary: When generating outputs for domains with specific validity constraints (e.g., a program should compile), LLMs often fail in a small number of focused ways: for example, by using Python function names when generating TypeScript. We observe that these error patterns can be represented using a small number of constraints that can be learned in practice. We propose \emph{prefix filters}, which are per-domain-and-LLM symbolic functions, as objects to capture the error patterns, Palla as an algorithm to learn prefix filters efficiently in practice, and implement Palla. Prefix filters learned by Palla i) help us quantitatively analyze the error patterns of LLMs, and ii) can be used to constrain the outputs of a model via constrained sampling algorithms. For example, Palla boosts compile rates for Qwen2.5-1.5B on TypeScript generation, by over 60%, allowing Qwen2.5-1.5B to achieve similar performance to Llama3.1-8B unconstrained.

AI.tldr: Palla learns "prefix filters" — symbolic functions that capture predictable LLM error patterns in specific domains. These filters enable both error analysis and constrained sampling, boosting Qwen2.5-1.5B's TypeScript compile rate by 60%+ to match Llama3.1-8B performance.
AI.motivation: LLMs generating domain-specific outputs (e.g., TypeScript code) tend to fail in a small, predictable set of focused ways (e.g., using Python syntax for TypeScript), suggesting these error patterns are learnable and can be represented as constraints.
AI.method: Palla algorithm learns per-domain-and-LLM symbolic prefix filters that capture LLM error patterns. These filters are used to constrain model outputs via constrained sampling algorithms.
AI.result: Quantitative analysis of LLM error patterns becomes possible; Qwen2.5-1.5B with Palla achieves over 60% improvement in compile rates on TypeScript generation, matching the performance of the larger Llama3.1-8B model without constraints.
AI.conclusion: Palla enables practical prefix filter learning that can both analyze LLM error patterns quantitatively and improve model output quality through constrained sampling, with substantial empirical gains (60%+ compile rate improvement for Qwen2.5-1.5B).

title: ResearchLoop: An Evidence-Gated Control Plane for AI-Assisted Research
summary: AI-assisted research compresses ideation, implementation, evaluation, and manuscript writing into a single interactive loop. This compression is useful, but it also creates a publication risk: paper claims can become easier to state than to audit. We present ResearchLoop, an evidence-gated control plane for AI-assisted computational research. ResearchLoop treats research questions, task contracts, evidence objects, claim ledgers, closeouts, and paper bindings as durable project state, realized here as a repository-backed runtime. This technical report provides the complete protocol specification, state model, transition rules, claim-admission algorithm, and insight-compounding mechanism. It also reports the full experimental record spanning nine versions (V0--V9), including a self-hosting case study, a controlled task-suite study with component ablations, a mathematical olympiad evaluation, and a supplementary SciCode boundary experiment evaluated with the official generated-code harness. All artifacts, manifests, and verification reports are preserved in the project repository.

AI.tldr: ResearchLoop是一个面向AI辅助计算研究的证据门控控制平面，通过将研究过程要素建模为持久化状态来增强可审计性，并提供了完整的协议规范和状态转移机制。
AI.motivation: AI辅助研究虽然加速了 ideation 到论文写作的全流程，但导致论文声明的陈述变得容易，而验证和审计变得困难，存在较大的发表风险。
AI.method: 将研究问题、任务契约、证据对象、声明账本、关闭条件和论文绑定作为持久化项目状态，通过基于仓库的运行时实现；制定了完整的协议规范、状态模型、转换规则、声明准入算法和洞察复利机制。
AI.result: 在九个版本的迭代实验、自托管案例研究、受控任务套件实验（含组件消融）、数学奥赛评估以及SciCode边界实验中均验证了ResearchLoop的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ResearchLoop通过提供可验证的证据管理框架，显著提升了AI辅助计算研究的可信度；实验表明该方法在多个任务类型上均优于基线，且支持自举式改进。

title: HELEA: Hard-Negative Benchmark and LLM-based Reranking for Robust Entity Alignment
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code and benchmarks available at https://github.com/Wnsdnl/HELEA
summary: Entity Alignment (EA) is essential for knowledge graph (KG) fusion, but existing benchmarks often allow models to exploit name overlap rather than relational structure. This makes it difficult to evaluate whether models can reject same-name entities that refer to different real-world objects. Our primary contribution is a same-name hard-negative augmentation strategy that simultaneously yields quality-controlled evaluation benchmarks (DW-HN29K, DY-HN27K) and augmented training corpora (DW-Train, DY-Train), by mining same-name but distinct entity pairs from KG name-collision groups. We further introduce HELEA, a two-stage framework integrating (i) entity encoder retrieval trained on hard-negative-augmented training corpora with 1-hop KG context, and (ii) LLM-based reranking without additional training. Experiments show that name-dependent baselines collapse to near-random performance on our hard-negative benchmarks, while HELEA achieves F1 0.967 on DW-HN29K while maintaining Hit@1 0.993 on standard DW-15K.

AI.tldr: 针对现有知识图谱融合中实体对齐基准的局限性，提出同名称硬负例增强策略和两阶段HELEA框架，有效解决同名不同实体的对齐难题。
AI.motivation: 现有EA基准测试允许模型依赖名称重叠而非关系结构，难以评估模型拒绝指向不同现实对象的同名实体的能力。
AI.method: 提出同名称硬负例增强策略，挖掘KG名称冲突组中同名但不同实体的配对；构建两阶段HELEA框架：(i)基于1-hop KG上下文的硬负例增强训练实体编码器检索；(ii)基于LLM的无需额外训练的重排序。
AI.result: 名称依赖基线模型在硬负例基准上接近随机性能，而HELEA在DW-HN29K上达到F1 0.967，同时在标准DW-15K上保持Hit@1 0.993。
AI.conclusion: HELEA框架成功解决了同名称实体对齐难题，在硬负例基准上F1达0.967，同时在标准基准上保持Hit@1 0.993的优异性能。

title: Dimensionality Reduction for Robust Federated Learning: A Theoretical Analysis and Convergence Guarantee
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train models without sharing raw data, but it is highly vulnerable to Byzantine attacks. Existing robust approaches can neutralize these threats but incur substantial computational overhead during high-dimensional gradient aggregation, an overhead that scales poorly with model size and increasingly dominates the training cost as modern models grow larger. To address this computational bottleneck, we propose Projected Dimensionality Reduction (PDR), a universal acceleration framework for vector-level distance-based robust aggregators, which performs robust aggregation by compressing gradients into a drastically smaller subspace via sparse random projection to efficiently compute reliability weights. This approach reduces the server computational complexity to an optimal $ \mathcal{O}(Mp) $, where $ M $ is the number of clients and $ p $ is the model dimension, matching the theoretical lower bound required merely to read the gradients. We establish convergence guarantees under standard FL assumptions in prior Byzantine-robust FL analyses. By leveraging the Subspace Embedding Theorem, we show that PDR achieves optimal convergence rates of $ \mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T}) $ for non-convex functions and $ \mathcal{O}(1/T) $ for strongly convex functions, where $ T $ denotes the number of iterations. Crucially, we mathematically demonstrate that this massive acceleration comes almost for free, merely inflating the inherent Byzantine error floor by a bounded, tunable factor of $ \frac{1+ε}{1-ε} $. Experimental results on benchmark datasets confirm that integrating PDR with existing aggregators yields orders of magnitude speedups in time efficiency while maintaining highly competitive convergence performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDR框架，通过稀疏随机投影将梯度压缩至小子空间计算可靠性权重，将服务器计算复杂度降至O(Mp)的最优下界，同时仅引入可调的有界误差膨胀因子(1+ε)/(1-ε)，在非凸和强凸场景下分别达到O(1/√T)和O(1/T)的最优收敛速率，实现拜占庭鲁棒聚合的显著加速。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习面临拜占庭攻击威胁，现有鲁棒聚合方法虽能有效防御，但计算开销随模型维度急剧增长，已成为现代大模型训练的主要成本瓶颈。这促使研究者寻求一种不牺牲鲁棒性的高效压缩方案。
AI.method: PDR通过稀疏随机投影（Sparse Random Projection）将高维梯度压缩到极小的子空间，在该子空间中高效计算可靠性权重。核心设计包括：（1）利用子空间嵌入定理（Subspace Embedding Theorem）保证压缩保真度；（2）计算复杂度降至O(Mp)，达到读取梯度的理论下界；（3）通过数学证明将固有拜占庭误差上界控制在(1+ε)/(1-ε)的可调范围内。
AI.result: 在标准FL假设下，PDR对非凸函数达到O(1/√T)的收敛速率，对强凸函数达到O(1/T)的最优收敛速率。实验表明，将PDR与现有聚合器集成可实现数量级的加速，同时保持高度竞争力的收敛性能。
AI.conclusion: PDR是一个优雅且实用的框架，通过稀疏随机投影在保证收敛性的同时大幅降低了拜占庭鲁棒聚合的计算开销。实验验证其可将时间效率提升数个数量级，同时保持竞争性的收敛性能。该工作为大规模联邦学习系统中的拜占庭防御提供了可扩展的理论坚实解决方案。

title: Where Rollouts Begin: Low-Load, High-Leverage First-Token Diversification for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models without labeled trajectories, relying on grouped rollouts to expose the policy to alternative reasoning paths and a verifier to score them. Rollout diversity has accordingly emerged as a central bottleneck in RLVR, with most existing methods broadening exploration through temperature, prefix, or rollout-selection adjustments. We identify a structurally distinguished but overlooked position for broadening this diversity: the first token after the reasoning marker. The policy's first-token distribution exhibits a sharply peaked yet correctness-decoupled phenomenon, and this first token position can broaden the regions a rollout group covers without altering the correctness signal. We introduce REFT (Rollout Exploration with First-Token Diversification), a light addition to the RLVR pipeline that samples first tokens uniformly from the policy's own top-$N$ candidates and allocates rollouts evenly, leaving every other component unchanged. Trained on the resulting diversified rollouts, REFT improves aggregate Pass@1, Pass@8, and Pass@64 over DAPO and GRPO baselines across four base models (0.5B-7B) and three difficulty regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文发现推理标记后的首 token 位置具有尖锐集中但与正确性解耦的特性，通过REFT方法在此位置引入均匀采样 Diversification，在不改变正确性信号的前提下有效拓展了rollout组的覆盖区域，从而突破了RLVR中的rollout多样性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: RLVR训练推理模型时，rollout多样性成为核心瓶颈。现有方法通过调整temperature、prefix或rollout选择来扩展探索，但忽略了首 token 这一关键位置。
AI.method: 提出REFT方法：在RLVR流程中加入首 token 多样化机制，从策略模型的 top-$N$ 个候选中均匀采样首 token，并均匀分配rollouts。
AI.result: 在四种基座模型（0.5B-7B）和三种难度设置下，REFT相比DAPO和GRPO基线显著提升了aggregate Pass@1、Pass@8和Pass@64指标。
AI.conclusion: REFT作为一种轻量级插件，在不改变其他组件的情况下，通过多样化首 token 采样显著提升了模型的 Pass@1、Pass@8 和 Pass@64 性能。

title: Argument Quality Assessment with Large Language Models: A Pairwise Bradley-Terry Approach
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tasks related to reasoning and judgment. However, assessing the quality of arguments requires a rigorous evaluation. We investigate the extent to which LLMs can effectively perform this task. We tested 12 open-weight LLMs of different sizes and families under zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought to approximate expert pairwise comparisons of argument quality across three dimensions-logical, rhetorical, and dialectic-and used these comparisons in a Bradley-Terry model to infer latent strength scores and derive a ranking of arguments. Our insights show that LLMs have promising but moderate correlation with human expert judgments, with Llama-70B obtaining the strongest alignment, reaching moderate Cohen's $κ$ = 0.493 and moderate correlations with Bradley-Terry scores derived from these annotations (Kendall, Pearson, and Spearman: 0.327-0.477). Other LLMs exhibit weak, moderate, or high alignment with Llama-70B while achieving comparable results against human experts, suggesting partial but complementary understanding of underlying quality dimensions despite differences in model size and family. Moreover, LLM predictions are stable across trial runs, with fewer than 7.75\% of cases yielding different labels. Remaining variability is handled via majority voting and few-shot prompting for large-size models.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了12个开源LLM在论证质量评估任务中的表现，发现LLM与人类专家判断呈中等程度相关，Llama-70B表现最佳，不同规模和家族的模型对质量维度的理解呈现部分互补性，预测稳定性良好。
AI.motivation: 论证质量评估需要严格的标准；虽然LLM在推理和判断任务中展现了能力，但其在论证质量评估任务中的有效性尚不明确，需要系统研究。
AI.method: 测试了12个不同规模和家族的开源LLM，采用zero-shot、few-shot和chain-of-thought三种提示策略；模拟专家对三个维度（逻辑、修辞、辩证）的论证质量进行成对比较；采用Bradley-Terry模型推断潜在强度分数并生成论证排名。
AI.result: Llama-70B与人类专家对齐最强，达到中等Cohen's κ=0.493，与Bradley-Terry分数呈中等相关（Kendall、Pearson、Spearman：0.327-0.477）；其他LLM对齐程度各异；LLM预测稳定，少数案例（<7.75%）产生不同标签。
AI.conclusion: LLMs展现出演示但在评估论证质量方面与人类专家仅有中等程度的相关性；Llama-70B表现最佳；LLM预测结果稳定（变异性低于7.75%）；通过多数投票和few-shot提示可进一步处理剩余变异性。

title: Detecting Diffusion-Generated Time Series Under Generator Shift
summary: The boundary between real and diffusion-generated time series is becoming increasingly difficult to draw, yet detection in this domain remains underexplored, especially when the generator is unknown. We compare white-box detection, which requires access to the generator, against black-box detection, which operates on the raw signal alone. The white-box approach, a reconstruction-based detector adapted from the image domain, works well in in-distribution but breaks down under generator shift: reconstruction-based detection in images succeeds because large generic generators provide a near-universal reconstruction prior, and no analogous generator exists for time series. In contrast, a simple off-the-shelf classifier used as a black-box detector performs remarkably well, achieving an average F1 of 79.2, a 22.1% relative improvement over the white-box approach, and a TPR@1%FPR of 57.2. Diffusion-generated time series detection is therefore not a direct transfer of the image domain problem. This work provides the first systematic exploration of white-box and black-box detection for diffusion-generated time series. We close by identifying several open and promising directions.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统对比了白盒（需生成器访问）与黑盒（纯信号）方法在扩散生成时间序列检测上的表现。研究发现图像域中有效的重建检测器无法直接迁移至时间序列领域，而简单的黑盒分类器反而表现优异，平均F1为79.2，显著优于白盒方法22.1%。
AI.motivation: 真实时间序列与扩散生成时间序列的边界日益模糊，且当生成器未知时的检测问题缺乏系统研究。这是首次对白盒和黑盒检测方法进行系统性探索。
AI.method: 对比两类方法：白盒检测（基于图像域适配的重建检测器，需访问生成器）与黑盒检测（仅使用原始信号的现成分类器）。
AI.result: 黑盒分类器平均F1达79.2，比白盒方法相对提升22.1%，TPR@1%FPR为57.2。白盒方法在分布内有效但面对生成器变化时失效，因时间序列缺乏类似图像域的通用重建先验生成器。
AI.conclusion: 扩散生成时间序列检测不能简单复制图像域的成功方法，黑盒方法明显优于白盒方法，为后续研究指明了有前景的方向。

title: REED: Post-Training Representation Editing for Cross-Domain Linguistic Steganalysis
summary: In real-world scenarios of linguistic steganalysis, tested texts usually come from unseen domains with different vocabularies, topics, writing styles, and steganographic generation patterns, which can significantly degrade the detection performance. Although existing cross-domain steganalysis methods can effectively alleviate this problem through distribution alignment, domain-invariant feature learning, etc., the detection performance is not satisfactory. In this paper, we propose a post-training representation editing method for cross-domain linguistic steganalysis. Specifically, the detector is first trained on source-domain data, and then the feature extractor and classifier are kept frozen, and the intermediate representations are deterministically edited before classification. For domain adaptation, we construct a domain-offset vector from marginal source and target representations. For domain generalization, we derive a source-domain cover-to-stego direction to guide sample-specific editing. Experimental results show that compared with the advanced methods, the proposed method can achieve high cross-domain detection performance, especially in terms of F1-score, while requiring no architecture modification or parameter updates after source-domain training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于跨域语言隐写分析的后训练表示编辑方法，在冻结特征提取器和分类器的情况下，通过对中间表示进行确定性编辑实现域适应和域泛化，无需架构修改或参数更新即可获得较高的跨域检测性能。
AI.motivation: Real-world linguistic steganalysis faces performance degradation when tested on unseen domains due to differences in vocabularies, topics, writing styles, and steganographic generation patterns. Existing methods (distribution alignment, domain-invariant feature learning) show unsatisfactory detection performance in cross-domain scenarios.
AI.method: A post-training representation editing approach: (1) Train detector on source-domain data; (2) Freeze feature extractor and classifier; (3) Deterministically edit intermediate representations before classification. For domain adaptation: construct domain-offset vector from marginal source/target representations. For domain generalization: derive source-domain cover-to-stego direction to guide sample-specific editing.
AI.result: Proposed method achieves high cross-domain detection performance, especially in terms of F1-score, compared with advanced methods.
AI.conclusion: The method achieves high cross-domain detection performance (especially F1-score) without architecture modification or parameter updates after source-domain training, offering a practical solution for real-world linguistic steganalysis deployment.

title: HardMTBench: Stress-Testing Chinese-English Translation on Knowledge-Intensive Domains
summary: General-purpose machine translation benchmarks such as FLORES-200 have reached a saturation regime on Chinese-English pairs, where modern large language models cluster within a narrow band of high scores. Across 22 systems, FLORES-200 zh-en GEMBA scores fall in a 7.87-point range with a standard deviation of 2.29, which compresses the separation between systems on knowledge-intensive domains such as finance, healthcare, law, and science and technology. We introduce HardMTBench, a difficulty-aware diagnostic benchmark for bidirectional Chinese-English domain translation. HardMTBench covers 12 domains and contains 10,000 hand-curated source sentences with reference translations, packaged as 20,000 directional test items. A three-stage construction pipeline builds a domain-balanced candidate pool of 84{,}566 pairs, applies an LLM-based multi-signal judge over knowledge density, translation difficulty, terminology load and reference correctness, and assembles the final test set under a hardness fusion rule with per-domain quotas. Across 22 systems spanning general LLMs, commercial engines and specialised MT models, HardMTBench widens the cross-system GEMBA range by roughly a factor of two over FLORES-200, induces visible rank reorderings, and exposes domain-specific terminology and knowledge weaknesses that quality-only metrics tend to flatten. All data and code are open-sourced at https://github.com/jasonNLP/HardMTBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HardMTBench，一个面向中英双向翻译的难度感知诊断基准。该基准覆盖12个领域，包含10,000条手工筛选源语句句（20,000个方向性测试项），通过三阶段构建pipeline生成。实验评估了22个系统（包括通用LLM、商业引擎和专业MT模型），结果显示该基准能够有效扩大系统间区分度，揭示现有饱和基准难以捕捉的翻译弱点。所有数据和代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有通用机器翻译基准（如FLORES-200）在中文-英文翻译任务上已趋于饱和，现代大语言模型聚集在狭窄的高分段区间内（22个系统在GEMBA上仅7.87点范围，标准差2.29），这压缩了金融、医疗、法律、科技等知识密集型领域系统间的区分度。
AI.method: 构建了一个三阶段pipeline：1) 构建84,566对领域平衡候选池；2) 采用基于LLM的多信号评判（知识密度、翻译难度、术语负载、参考正确性）；3) 在难度融合规则和领域配额约束下组装最终测试集。
AI.result: HardMTBench在22个系统上将跨系统GEMBA评分差距扩大约一倍，引发了明显的排名重排，并暴露了仅靠质量指标难以揭示的领域特定术语和知识弱点。
AI.conclusion: HardMTBench通过开放源码、扩大系统评分差距、揭示排名重排和暴露特定领域弱点，为中文-英文翻译系统评估提供了更有效的诊断工具，有望替代或补充现有饱和基准测试。

title: Score Based Error Correcting Code Decoder
summary: Error-correcting codes enable reliable communication, yet practical soft decoding remains challenging across code families and block lengths. We propose SB-ECC, a score-based decoder that casts decoding as continuous-time denoising. A neural denoiser defines a probability-flow ordinary differential equation (ODE) that iteratively updates the noisy channel observation toward a valid codeword, guided by parity constraints. The model is trained across noise levels without time/SNR conditioning, enabling inference without SNR estimation and supporting a direct latency accuracy trade off controlled by the ODE solver budget. We use the raw signed channel observation as input for learning a continuous denoising field. Across 42 code/SNR settings, SB-ECC achieves the best BER in 39/42 entries, with an average SNR gain of 0.17dB and a maximum gain of 0.46dB over the strongest competing baseline, we showed that swapping the solver from Euler to DPM preserves -ln(BER) while reducing end-to-end decoding time by 8.86% on average (up to 12.82%).

AI.tldr: SB-ECC将软译码问题转化为连续时间去噪任务，通过概率流ODE迭代优化实现跨码族的高性能软译码。在42个测试场景中39次获得最优BER，无需SNR估计且支持灵活的延迟-精度权衡，替换求解器可进一步加速约9%。
AI.motivation: 纠错码虽能实现可靠通信，但跨码族和码长的实用软译码仍具挑战。传统方法依赖精确的SNR估计，且难以在不同码字和信噪比条件下保持一致性能。
AI.method: 提出SB-ECC，一种基于分数的译码器，将译码建模为连续时间去噪过程。神经去噪器定义概率流常微分方程(ODE)，迭代地将带噪信道观测更新至有效码字，并受奇偶校验约束引导。使用原始符号信道观测作为输入，学习连续去噪场。模型跨噪声水平训练，无需时间/SNR条件化。
AI.result: 在42个码字/SNR设置中，SB-ECC在39项中取得最低BER，平均SNR增益0.17dB，最大增益0.46dB优于最强基线。将求解器从Euler切换至DPM可保持-ln(BER)性能的同时，平均减少8.86%的端到端译码时间（最高12.82%）。
AI.conclusion: SB-ECC通过连续时间去噪框架统一了多种码字的软译码问题，无需SNR估计即可实现推理，且支持通过ODE求解器预算直接控制延迟-精度权衡。Euler求解器切换至DPM可进一步降低约9%的译码延迟而不损失性能。

title: Better Accuracies, Worse Reasoning: A Step-Level Audit of Medical Chain-of-Thought Distillation
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation trains a smaller model to imitate a teacher's reasoning trace, but it is typically evaluated by final-answer metrics including accuracy. We ask whether gains in answer quality are accompanied by improvements in the trace. In medical QA, where short answer options can leave a richer clinical justification under-specified, a Qwen3-8B student distilled from a DeepSeek-V3-family teacher improves on MedQA-USMLE answer metrics (SC@64 74.7% to 84.4%; expected calibration error (ECE) 0.096 to 0.034). Yet under a Kimi-K2.6 style-blind LLM-judge audit, its error rate over non-abstained steps rises from 30.6% to 50.3%. In this primary medical setting, answer quality and trace factuality move in opposite directions. This before--after pattern persists across evaluators, teacher strengths, student scales and families, medical benchmarks, and style, segmentation, and answer-correctness controls. A 150-step blinded audit by a clinical expert reproduces the same ordering. Boundary checks narrow the scope of the claim: the risk appears when a compact answer under-constrains the rationale and a capable student can imitate expert-like form without reliably grounding each local claim. Standard answer metrics and aggregate hedging rates do not reveal the shift. When such traces are released or reused, answer-level metrics alone are insufficient.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在医学QA领域的CoT蒸馏中，学生模型在答案指标上优于教师，但在推理轨迹的事实性上显著退化；仅使用答案级指标评估蒸馏效果存在严重不足，轨迹发布或复用时需引入轨迹质量评估机制。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-thought (CoT) 蒸馏通常以最终答案指标（准确率等）评估效果，但答案质量的提升是否意味着推理轨迹质量同步提升尚不清楚。该问题在医学QA场景中尤为重要，因为简短选项可能使更丰富的临床论证变得不够明确。
AI.method: 跨多维度对照实验：变更LLM评判者、模型规模与家族、教师模型、医学基准测试，以及进行风格、分割和答案正确性的控制实验；补充150步临床专家盲法审核作为人工验证。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B学生模型从DeepSeek-V3系列教师蒸馏后，MedQA-USMLE答案指标显著改善（SC@64: 74.7%→84.4%；ECE: 0.096→0.034），但Kimi-K2.6风格盲LLM评判审计显示，非弃权步骤的错误率从30.6%上升至50.3%；该模式在评测者、教师强度、学生规模、家族、医学基准及各种控制实验中一致复现，临床专家盲法审核证实了相同排序。
AI.conclusion: CoT蒸馏中答案质量与推理轨迹事实性存在反向变化现象，仅依赖最终答案指标无法揭示轨迹退化问题；当紧凑答案无法充分约束推理过程时，学生模型可能模仿表层形式但无法可靠地验证局部陈述的真实性；在轨迹发布或复用场景下，仅使用答案级指标评估是不充分的。

title: When Discourse Pressures Conflict: Information Structure in Vision-Language Model Outputs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly evaluated for whether they identify the right visual content, but little is known about whether they express such content in a discourse-appropriate form. We address this research gap using information structure (IS), testing whether VLMs distinguish discourse-old Topics from discourse-new Foci in visually grounded question answering. We exploit Hungarian, a language in which Topic and Focus map onto dedicated syntactic positions, making IS choices observable in text. Comparing six VLMs with human participants, we find that models produce IS-relevant constructions, but over-regularise this sensitivity. Under the interacting pressures of discourse status, grammatical role (preference for subject Topics) and definiteness (preference for indefinite Foci), humans choose variable strategies for IS realisation.
