The runtime owns the loop, context, and control flow, and the model has little say over any of them. Letting model-written code shape the runtime itself would make agents more expressive, but it would also sharpen safety problems. A model can be diverted by a prompt injection, call the wrong tool, or fail partway and leave an inconsistent state, and each such failure reaches further when the code shapes the runtime than when it expresses a single action. We present LACUNA, a programming model for agents that closes this split while preserving safety. Each agent action is a typed call $\texttt{agent[T](task)}$ that the LLM fills with code when execution reaches it, and the code is type-checked against the surrounding program before it runs. Because each action is accepted or rejected as a whole, a rejected one leaves the environment untouched, and its compiler diagnostics drive a retry. The same check also bounds which tools and data an action may use and how they flow. Our primitive expresses ReAct loops, sub-agents, skills, parallel decomposition, and multi-model planning as ordinary control flow. We evaluate LACUNA on a collection of test cases, BrowseComp-Plus, and $τ^2$-bench. On BrowseComp-Plus, $8.6\%$ of generations are rejected before execution, with 0.7 retries per query on average, and the agent reaches $27.1\%$ accuracy. On $τ^2$-bench, LACUNA solves $76.0\%$ of $392$ tasks across four domains with a capable model, on par with the baseline agent.

AI.tldr: LACUNA is a programming model for LLM agents that allows model-written code to shape the runtime while preserving safety through type-checking. Agent actions are typed calls that are validated before execution, with rejected actions triggering retries via compiler diagnostics.
AI.motivation: Current LLM agents have a split between the runtime (owning loop, context, control flow) and model-written code (limited expressiveness). While allowing model code to shape the runtime would increase expressiveness, it would also sharpen safety problems: prompt injection, wrong tool calls, and inconsistent state on failure.
AI.method: LACUNA introduces typed agent[T](task) calls where LLM-written code is type-checked against the surrounding program before execution. Rejected actions leave the environment untouched, and compiler diagnostics drive retry. The same type check bounds tool/data usage and flow. Expresses ReAct loops, sub-agents, skills, parallel decomposition, and multi-model planning as ordinary control flow.
AI.result: On BrowseComp-Plus: 8.6% generations rejected pre-execution, 0.7 retries/query, 27.1% accuracy. On τ²-bench: 76.0% of 392 tasks solved across four domains, on par with baseline agent.
AI.conclusion: LACUNA preserves safety while closing the runtime-code split, achieving on-par performance with baseline agents (76.0% on τ²-bench) through type-checked code execution and retry mechanisms.

title: Self-Improving Language Models with Bidirectional Evolutionary Search
summary: Search has been proposed as an effective method for self-improving language models and agentic systems, both for post-training sample generation and for inference. However, widely used methods such as best-of-N sampling and tree search face two fundamental limitations: they are guided by sparse verification signals, and they construct candidates primarily through autoregressive expansion, restricting exploration to regions with substantial model probability mass. To address these, we propose Bidirectional Evolutionary Search (BES), a search framework that couples forward candidate evolution with backward goal decomposition. In the forward search, BES augments standard expansion with evolution operators that recombine partial trajectories to generate candidates that are difficult to obtain from a single model rollout. In the backward search, BES recursively decomposes the original task into checkable subgoals, producing dense intermediate feedback that guides forward search. We provide theoretical motivation showing that candidates generated by expansion-only search are confined to a narrow entropy shell while evolutionary operators can escape it, and that backward search can exponentially reduce the number of required samples to find a correct answer. Experiments show that on challenging post-training tasks where mainstream post-training algorithms fail to improve, BES enables consistent gains, and on three open problem solving benchmarks at inference time, BES outperforms existing open-source frameworks in both average and best-case performance. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/BES.

AI.tldr: BES是一种双向进化搜索框架，通过前向候选演化和后向目标分解解决现有搜索方法的局限性。理论上证明了纯扩展搜索的候选局限于窄熵壳，而进化算子可以突破此限制；后向搜索可指数级减少找到正确答案所需的样本数。实验表明BES在现有主流后训练算法失败的挑战性任务上实现了一致的提升，并在三个开放问题求解基准测试中超越现有开源框架。
AI.motivation: Current search methods (best-of-N sampling and tree search) face two fundamental limitations: (1) they rely on sparse verification signals, and (2) they construct candidates primarily through autoregressive expansion, restricting exploration to regions with substantial model probability mass.
AI.method: Bidirectional Evolutionary Search (BES) couples forward candidate evolution with backward goal decomposition. Forward: augments standard expansion with evolution operators that recombine partial trajectories to generate candidates difficult to obtain from single model rollouts. Backward: recursively decomposes the original task into checkable subgoals, producing dense intermediate feedback to guide forward search.
AI.result: Theoretical analysis shows expansion-only search confines candidates to a narrow entropy shell while evolutionary operators can escape it, and backward search can exponentially reduce required samples to find correct answers. Empirically, BES enables consistent gains on challenging post-training tasks where mainstream algorithms fail, and outperforms existing open-source frameworks on three benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: BES enables consistent improvements on challenging post-training tasks where mainstream algorithms fail, and outperforms existing open-source frameworks on three open problem solving benchmarks at both average and best-case performance.

title: Expressive Power of Floating-Point Neural Networks with Arbitrary Reduction Orders and Inexact Activation Implementations
summary: Most existing expressivity theories for neural networks assume exact real arithmetic, whereas practical neural networks are executed under finite-precision floating-point arithmetic with implementation-dependent execution semantics. Recent works have begun studying the expressive power of floating-point neural networks, but existing results are limited to highly restricted activation functions and idealized assumptions such as fixed left-to-right reduction orders and correctly rounded activation implementations. In this work, we study the expressive power of floating-point neural networks under generalized floating-point execution semantics, including arbitrary reduction orders and inexact activation implementations with bounded ulp errors. We investigate when floating-point neural networks can represent arbitrary functions between floating-point domains exactly. To this end, we introduce a general distinguishability framework and show that the ability to distinguish every pair of distinct inputs in the first layer is necessary for universal representability. This characterization yields broad classes of activation implementations that are not universal representators, extending previous isolated counterexamples such as the correctly rounded cosine activation. We further prove that a suitable form of distinguishability is also sufficient for universal representability under mild conditions on the activation implementation. Using this framework, we establish universal representability results for a broad class of practical activation functions, including implementations of $\mathrm{Sigmoid}$, $\tanh$, $\mathrm{ReLU}$, $\mathrm{ELU}$, $\mathrm{SeLU}$, $\mathrm{GeLU}$, $\mathrm{Swish}$, $\mathrm{Mish}$, and $\sin$, under significantly more realistic floating-point execution models than previously known.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了浮点神经网络在广义浮点执行语义（包括任意归约顺序和具有有界ulp误差的非精确激活实现）下的表达能力。通过引入通用可区分性框架，证明了第一层区分能力是通用可表示性的必要且（在温和条件下）充分条件，并据此为Sigmoid、tanh、ReLU、ELU、SeLU、GeLU、Swish、Mish、sin等实用激活函数建立了通用可表示性结果。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络表达能力理论大多假设精确实数算术，但实际网络在有限精度浮点算术下执行，具有实现依赖的执行语义。现有研究受限于高度受限的激活函数和理想化假设（如固定从左到右的归约顺序、正确舍入的激活实现）。
AI.method: 引入了一个通用可区分性框架，证明了第一层区分每对不同输入是通用可表示性的必要条件，并在温和条件下证明可区分性也是充分条件。
AI.result: （1）建立了通用可表示性的必要条件：需能区分每对不同输入；（2）识别出广泛类别的激活实现（如正确舍入的cosine激活）不是通用表示器；（3）在温和条件下，可区分性也是充分条件；（4）为多种实用激活函数建立了通用可表示性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究在更现实的浮点执行模型下，为包括Sigmoid、tanh、ReLU、ELU、SeLU、GeLU、Swish、Mish和sin在内的多种实用激活函数建立了通用可表示性结果，显著推广了此前仅限于理想化假设的结论。

title: Bandwidth-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Edge-Cloud Many-to-Many Speech Translation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential for speech-to-text translation (S2TT). However, existing deployment paradigms face critical challenges: pure on-device models suffer from resource constraints, while centralized cloud systems incur severe privacy risks and bandwidth bottlenecks by transmitting raw voice data. Furthermore, most models exhibit English-centric biases, restricting many-to-many translation scaling. In this paper, we propose Edge-cloud Speech Recognition and Translation (ESRT), a privacy-preserving and bandwidth-efficient collaborative edge-cloud MLLM framework. Specifically, we design an edge-cloud split inference architecture that retains a lightweight speech encoder and adapter on the device, transmitting only highly compressed intermediate features to the cloud. This fundamentally prevents voiceprint leakage and reduces bandwidth requirements by up to 10$\times$. To overcome English-centric bottlenecks, we introduce a multi-task weighted curriculum learning strategy with data balancing to ensure robust cross-lingual consistency. Extensive experiments on the FLEURS dataset demonstrate that our models, ESRT-4B and ESRT-12B, achieve state-of-the-art many-to-many S2TT performance across 45 languages ($45 \times 44$ directions). Code and models are released to facilitate reproducible, privacy-aware MLLM S2TT research. The code and models are released at https://github.com/yxduir/esrt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ESRT框架，通过边缘-云端协作的MLLM实现隐私保护和带宽高效的语音翻译，设备端保留轻量级编码器传输压缩特征，在45种语言上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有部署模式面临关键挑战：纯端侧模型受限于资源约束，而集中式云系统通过传输原始语音数据带来严重的隐私风险和带宽瓶颈；此外，大多数模型存在英语中心偏见，限制多对多翻译扩展。
AI.method: 设计了一种边缘-云端分离推理架构，在设备端保留轻量级语音编码器和适配器，仅传输高度压缩的中间特征到云端；引入多任务加权课程学习策略结合数据平衡，确保跨语言一致性。
AI.result: 模型ESRT-4B和ESRT-12B在FLEURS数据集上实现了跨45种语言（45×44方向）的最先进的语音到文本翻译性能；带宽需求降低高达10倍，同时从根本上防止声纹泄露。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了隐私保护和带宽高效的语音到文本翻译，支持45种语言（45×44方向）的多对多翻译，达到了最先进的性能。

title: VLMs May Not Globally Enhance Human Alignment over LLMs During Natural Reading
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly useful computational models of human language processing, but it remains unclear whether vision-language learning makes text representations more human-like during natural reading. Here, we address this question by comparing tightly matched LLM and vision-language model (VLM) pairs under a strictly text-only setting, allowing us to isolate the effect of multimodal training history from online visual input or cross-modal fusion. We evaluate model alignment with a human natural-reading dataset that includes whole-cortex fMRI responses and synchronized eye-tracking saccades. Our findings demonstrate that multimodal pretraining may not confer a uniform, global advantage in human alignment during natural reading, indicating that language-internal representations remain the key factor for modeling human text processing. However, the VLM advantage could emerge more selectively when sentences contain stronger visual semantic content, with converging evidence from both fMRI and eye-movement alignments. Together, our findings provide a controlled in silico framework for testing how visual learning history shapes model-human alignment of language processing, suggesting that multimodal pretraining contributes selectively rather than globally to human-like language representations during natural reading.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了配对的LLM和VLM模型在纯文本设置下的表现，发现多模态预训练并不会在所有情况下提升模型与人类的对齐程度，但在处理具有强视觉语义内容的句子时，VLM能展现优势，表明多模态训练对类人语言表征的贡献是条件性和选择性的。
AI.motivation: 探索视觉-语言学习是否使文本表示在自然阅读中更接近人类语言处理方式，以及多模态预训练是否普遍提升模型与人类的对齐程度。
AI.method: 在纯文本设置下比较严格匹配的LLM和VLM配对模型，使用包含全脑fMRI响应和同步眼动追踪的的人类自然阅读数据集进行评估，从而隔离多模态训练历史的影响。
AI.result: 多模态预训练可能在人类自然阅读对齐中不提供统一的全局优势，语言内部表征仍是建模人类文本处理的关键因素；然而，当句子包含更强的视觉语义内容时，VLM的优势会更有选择性地显现，fMRI和眼动对齐两个维度的证据相互印证。
AI.conclusion: 多模态预训练对类人语言表征的贡献是选择性的而非全局性的，视觉学习历史对模型-人类语言处理对齐的影响可以通过受控的硅基框架进行测试。

title: Understanding Generalization and Forgetting in In-Context Continual Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) derives its power from enabling Large Language Models to adapt to new tasks via prompt-based reasoning alone, entirely bypassing the need for parameter updates. Existing theories primarily study ICL in single-task settings, while real-world prompts often contain sequences of heterogeneous tasks, leaving a gap in understanding whether Large Language Models implicitly perform continual learning during inference. To bridge this gap, we propose the first theoretical framework for in-context continual learning, modeling how a pretrained Transformer processes multiple sequential tasks within a single prompt through shared attention mechanisms. Focusing on linear and masked linear self-attention, we derive error expressions for model predictions under sequential task prompts and analyze their generalization and forgetting behavior. Our results reveal that standard attention mechanisms inevitably induce intertask interference by uniformly or causally aggregating historical contexts, leading to systematic bias. We further provide a bias-variance-interference decomposition of prediction error, characterizing when historical in-context information yields positive transfer or provable negative transfer. This analysis exposes fundamental limits of attention-based continual inference and offers theoretical explanations for order sensitivity and performance degradation in long prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于上下文持续学习的理论框架，揭示了Transformer在处理序列异构任务时的注意力机制固有缺陷：注意力聚合机制导致任务间干扰和系统性偏差，并从理论上解释了长提示下的性能退化现象和顺序敏感性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有ICL理论主要研究单任务场景，但现实提示往往包含异构任务序列，导致理论与实践之间存在显著差距——缺乏对大语言模型在推理过程中是否隐式执行持续学习的理解。
AI.method: 聚焦线性注意力和掩码线性自注意力机制，推导序列任务提示下模型预测的误差表达式，分析泛化与遗忘行为，并提出预测误差的"偏置-方差-干扰"分解框架。
AI.result: 标准注意力机制通过均匀或因果聚合历史上下文不可避免地引发任务间干扰，导致系统性偏差；历史上下文信息在特定条件下可产生正迁移，但也可能导致可证明的负迁移。
AI.conclusion: 注意力机制在跨任务推理中存在根本性限制；揭示了长提示场景下性能退化的理论根源；为理解和预测LLM在多任务提示场景下的行为提供了理论工具。

title: Stage-wise Distortion-Perception Traversal in Zero-shot Inverse Problems with Diffusion Models
summary: The distortion-perception (D-P) tradeoff is a fundamental phenomenon of Bayesian inverse problems, which characterizes the inherent tension between distortion performance and perceptual quality. Enabling flexible traversal of the D-P tradeoff at inference time is crucial for practical applications. Despite the recent success of diffusion models in zero-shot inverse problem solving, efficient and principled strategies for D-P traversal in diffusion-based inverse algorithms remain inadequately characterized. In this paper, we propose a stage-wise framework for realizing D-P traversal using a single diffusion model in zero-shot inverse problems. Our proposed method, termed MAP-RPS, starts with an MAP estimation stage that approximates the MMSE solution and provides a low-distortion initialization, followed by a re-noised posterior sampling stage that progressively improves perceptual quality. We provide theoretical analyses for both stages, establishing the validity and effectiveness of the proposed design. Furthermore, we extend MAP-RPS to the latent space, yielding LMAP-RPS, which enjoys broader applicability by leveraging large-scale pre-trained latent diffusion backbones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAP-RPS and LMAP-RPS enable more effective D-P traversal on various tasks, while also exhibiting strong performance as efficient solvers for real-world inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAP-RPS框架，通过MAP估计和重新加噪后验采样两阶段实现单扩散模型零样本逆问题的D-P权衡灵活遍历，扩展为LMAP-RPS以利用预训练潜在扩散模型。
AI.motivation: D-P（失真-感知）权衡是贝叶斯逆问题的基本现象，但扩散模型逆算法中D-P遍历的高效和原则性策略仍然不足。现有方法缺乏有效途径在推理时灵活调整失真与感知质量之间的平衡。
AI.method: 提出MAP-RPS阶段式框架。第一阶段：MAP估计，近似MMSE解并提供低失真初始化；第二阶段：重新加噪后验采样，逐步提升感知质量。进一步扩展到潜在空间得到LMAP-RPS，利用大规模预训练潜在扩散模型提升适用性。
AI.result: 实验表明MAP-RPS和LMAP-RPS在多种任务中实现有效D-P遍历，在真实逆问题求解中展现优异性能。
AI.conclusion: MAP-RPS和LMAP-RPS能够在各种任务中实现更有效的D-P遍历，同时作为高效求解器在真实世界的逆问题中表现出色。

title: AutoScientists: Self-Organizing Agent Teams for Long-Running Scientific Experimentation
summary: Scientific research proceeds through iterative cycles of hypothesis generation, experiment design, execution, and revision. AI agents can automate parts of this process, but existing approaches typically follow a single research trajectory or coordinate through a central planner with fixed objectives. As a result, they struggle to sustain parallel exploration, adapt as experimental evidence changes, or preserve knowledge of failed directions over long-running experiments. We introduce AutoScientists, a decentralized team of AI agents for long-running computational scientific experimentation. Agents interpret a shared experimental state, self-organize into teams around promising hypotheses, critique proposals before using experimental compute, and share successes and failures to reduce redundant exploration. Under matched experimental budgets, AutoScientists improves over prior AI agents across biomedical machine learning, language-model training optimization, and protein fitness prediction. On BioML-Bench, spanning biomedical imaging, protein engineering, single-cell omics, and drug discovery, AutoScientists achieves a mean leaderboard percentile of 74.4% across 24 tasks, improving over the strongest AI agent by +8.33%. On GPT training optimization, AutoScientists reaches a target validation bits-per-byte 1.9x faster than Autoresearch and continues discovering improvements from a starting champion where the single-agent approach finds none (7 vs. 0 accepted improvements). On ProteinGym fitness prediction, AutoScientists discovers a method for ACE2-Spike binding that improves over the current state-of-the-art model by +12.5% in Spearman correlation. Applied without modification across all 217 ProteinGym assays, the same method improves over the prior state of the art by +6.5% (Spearman correlation).

AI.tldr: AutoScientists是一种去中心化AI智能体团队，通过自组织团队、批判性提案审查和知识共享机制，在生物医学机器学习、语言模型训练优化和蛋白Fitness预测三个不同领域的实验中均显著超越现有AI智能体，展示了在长周期计算科学实验中并行探索、自适应调整和避免冗余探索的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体在自动化科学研究中存在局限：仅遵循单一研究轨迹或依赖固定目标的中央规划器，难以维持并行探索、随实验证据变化自适应调整、或在长期实验中对失败方向保持记忆。
AI.method: 引入去中心化AI智能体团队AutoScientists，具备以下关键机制：1) 共享实验状态解释；2) 基于有前景假说自组织成团队；3) 实验前互相批判提案；4) 共享成功与失败经验以减少冗余探索。在匹配的实验预算下进行评估。
AI.result: 1) BioML-Bench上24个任务平均Leaderboard百分位达74.4%，超越最强AI智能体+8.33%；2) GPT训练优化中达到目标验证bits-per-byte速度比Autoresearch快1.9倍，从初始champion继续发现7个改进（单智能体仅0个）；3) ProteinGym上ACE2-Spike binding的Spearman相关 性提升+12.5%，且同一方法在全部217个assay中比先前SOTA平均提升+6.5%。
AI.conclusion: AutoScientists 通过去中心化架构和自主团队协作，在 BioML-Bench、GPT 训练优化和 ProteinGym 蛋白Fitness预测三个领域均显著超越最强AI智能体基线，展示了该框架在长周期计算科学实验中的有效性和泛化能力。

title: BIRDNet: Mining and Encoding Boolean Implication Knowledge Graphs as Interpretable Deep Neural Networks
summary: Tabular data in knowledge-rich domains often carries a latent prior in the form of Boolean implication relationships (BIRs) between pairs of features. We mine such relationships with a sparse-exception binomial test. The mined implications form a typed directed graph, equivalent to a propositional rule base of 2-literal clauses. We encode this graph as the connectivity of a layered neural network, called BIRDNet, in which each hidden unit corresponds to one mined rule and binds only to its two features. We show two consequences of this design: First, the architecture is sparse by construction: at most $2/d$ of the weights in each BIR layer are active, where $d$ is the input dimension. Second, the model is interpretable: every trained unit keeps a stable symbolic identity, so rules can be read off the network without surrogate models. Unlike most neurosymbolic models, BIRDNet does not consume an external rule base; its structural prior is mined from the data. We evaluate BIRDNet on six transcriptomic and proteomic benchmarks. Our results show that BIRDNet stays within 0.02 AUROC of the strongest dense baseline, at a small accuracy cost, while using up to $96\times$ fewer active parameters than an architecture-matched dense MLP. First-layer rules recover known biological signatures across multiple cancer subtypes and tissue types, including canonical amplicons, lineage-defining co-expression modules, and immune-infiltration markers. Data and code are available at: https://github.com/MAHI-Group/BIRDNet.

AI.tldr: BIRDNet是一种神经符号混合模型，通过稀疏例外二项式检验从数据中挖掘布尔蕴含关系，并将其编码为层次神经网络结构。该方法实现了架构层面的稀疏性（每层至多2/d权重活跃）和完全可解释性（每个训练单元保持稳定符号身份）。在6个转录组和蛋白质组基准数据集上，该方法与最强密集基线模型差距在0.02 AUROC以内，使用参数减少高达96倍，并能恢复癌症亚型和组织类型中的已知生物特征。
AI.motivation: Knowledge-rich domains contain latent Boolean implication relationships between features that are not exploited by standard neural architectures.
AI.method: Sparse-exception binomial test mines Boolean implication relationships; mined BIRs encode connectivity of BIRDNet where each hidden unit corresponds to one rule binding only to its two features.
AI.result: BIRDNet achieves near-dense performance (within 0.02 AUROC) with 96× fewer active parameters, recovers biologically meaningful rules (amplicons, co-expression modules, immune markers) across cancer subtypes and tissue types.
AI.conclusion: BIRDNet achieves near-parity with dense baselines (within 0.02 AUROC) while using up to 96× fewer active parameters, and successfully recovers known biological signatures including canonical amplicons, co-expression modules, and immune markers.

title: An LLM-Based Assistance System for Intuitive and Flexible Capability-Based Planning
summary: In modern industry, dynamic environments and the complexity of modular and reconfigurable resources require automated planning of process sequences. Capability-based planning approaches address this by automatically generating plans from semantic knowledge models that describe resource functions in a machine-interpretable form. Their practical use, however, remains limited: solver feedback, especially in the case of unsatisfiability, is difficult to interpret, and the knowledge models require adaptation as operational conditions change or requests become infeasible. This paper presents a hybrid assistance system that augments an existing capability-based Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) planning approach with an Large Language Model (LLM)-based layer for natural-language interaction, explanation, and adaptation. Formal planning correctness remains with the symbolic planner, while the LLM layer handles natural-language access and flexible knowledge model adaptation under explicit Human-in-the-Loop (HitL) approval. The system decomposes into four components: Capability Grounding, Symbolic Planning, Result Interpretation, and Planning Adaptation, realized as a routed agentic workflow in which a central router delegates to five specialized agents. The system is evaluated on a modular production system across four scenario types. Of 23 test cases, 9 of 10 knowledge queries and all 4 satisfiable planning cases were handled correctly, 3 of 4 unsatisfiable cases produced concrete repair proposals, and all 5 adaptive planning scenarios resolved into satisfiable plans through iterative, user-approved knowledge model modifications. The findings confirm that combining formal planning with LLM-based assistance substantially improves accessibility and adaptability in industrial automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合辅助系统，将基于能力的SMT规划与LLM结合，通过路由式智能体工作流增强工业自动化规划的自然语言交互、解释和自适应能力，在模块化生产系统上验证了系统有效性。
AI.motivation: 现代工业环境中，动态环境和模块化/可重构资源的复杂性需要自动化工艺序列规划。基于能力的规划方法通过从语义知识模型自动生成计划来解决这一问题，但实际应用受限：求解器反馈难以解释（尤其是不满足情况），且知识模型需要随操作条件变化或请求不可行时进行适配。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合辅助系统，增强现有基于能力的SMT规划方法。系统包含四个核心组件：能力锚定（Capability Grounding）、符号规划（Symbolic Planning）、结果解释（Result Interpretation）和规划适配（Planning Adaptation），实现为路由式智能体工作流（routed agentic workflow），由一个中央路由器委托给五个专业智能体。形式化规划正确性由符号规划器保证，LLM层处理自然语言访问和灵活知识模型适配，需经显式的人类参与批准。
AI.result: 该混合系统在模块化生产系统上进行了四类场景评估。23个测试用例中：知识查询9/10正确处理，所有4个可满足规划案例正确，3/4不可满足案例产生具体修复建议，5个自适应规划场景均通过用户批准的知识模型修改转化为可满足计划。
AI.conclusion: 混合系统通过将形式化规划与LLM辅助结合，显著提升了工业自动化系统的可访问性和适应性。实验验证了系统的有效性：23个测试用例中，知识查询准确率90%（9/10），可满足规划案例全部正确（4/4），不可满足案例中75%（3/4）产生了具体修复建议，所有5个自适应规划场景均通过迭代式知识模型修改成功转化为可满足计划。

title: Extrapolative Weight Averaging Reveals Correctness-Efficiency Frontiers in Code RL
summary: Linear interpolation between fine-tuned checkpoints has been shown to trace the Pareto front between competing objectives, but whether extrapolative weight averaging can extend such frontiers to new checkpoints useful at inference time, without additional RL training, remains unclear. We study this question in RL for competitive programming, where hidden unit tests under time and memory limits enforce both functional correctness and computational efficiency. Starting from a shared initialization, we train checkpoints under nested unit-test coverage: low-coverage rewards require passing smaller-input tests, while high-coverage rewards require passing progressively larger tests up to the full suite. This sweep reveals the emergence of a correctness-efficiency frontier: on hard problems, higher-coverage reward reduces optimization failures but increases correctness failures, leaving solve rate nearly unchanged. Interpolation between low- and high-coverage checkpoints recovers this frontier, while extrapolation extends it beyond the trained endpoints. Both the frontier and its extrapolative continuation appear across three inference settings, pure reasoning, tool use, and agentic coding, and across two model scales, 32B and 7B. At the problem level, moving along the frontier changes which problems are solved, making extrapolated checkpoints complementary policies in inference-time scaling. Ensembles with extrapolative weight averaging broaden coverage and improve pass@250 on LCB/hard by 3.3% over the best single checkpoint at matched sample budget. These results show that nested unit-test coverage in code RL induces a frontier that extrapolative weight averaging can navigate, extend, and exploit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究强化学习代码生成中嵌套单元测试覆盖率如何诱导正确性-效率权衡前沿，并证明外推权重平均可突破训练端点生成新的有效检查点，在多推理模式和模型规模下保持稳定，显著提升集成性能。
AI.motivation: 在代码强化学习中，细微调检查点之间的线性插值可追踪Pareto前沿，但尚不清楚外推权重平均能否突破训练边界，生成推理时有效的新检查点。
AI.method: 嵌套单元测试覆盖率训练：将训练过程按测试输入规模分层，低覆盖率需通过小输入测试，高覆盖率需通过大输入测试直至完整测试套件。通过插值与外推不同覆盖率的检查点来探索正确性-效率前沿，并设计三类推理模式（纯推理、工具使用、代理编程）和两种模型规模（32B、7B）的验证实验。
AI.result: 1. 发现正确性-效率前沿：难题上高覆盖率奖励减少优化失败但增加正确性失败，解决率几乎不变。2. 插值可复现该前沿，外推可超越训练端点。3. 该前沿及其外推扩展在三套推理模式和两种模型规模上均稳定出现。4. 沿前沿移动会改变可解决问题集合，外推检查点形成互补策略。5. 集成外推权重平均的检查点，在LCB/hard上pass@250相对最佳单检查点提升3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 外推权重平均可有效扩展训练边界，在不同推理模式和模型规模下均成立；结合集成策略后，pass@250提升3.3%，表明该方法在推理时扩展计算中具有实用价值。

title: DREAM-R: Multimodal Speculative Reasoning with RL-Based Refined Drafting, Precise Verification, and Fully Parallel Execution
summary: Speculative reasoning has recently been proposed as a means to accelerate reasoning-intensive generation in large multimodal models, but its effectiveness is often constrained by misalignment between speculative drafts and target-verified reasoning. In this work, we introduce DREAM-R, a framework that substantially improves the performance of speculative reasoning. At its core, DREAM-R employs Speculative Alignment Policy Optimization (SAPO), a reinforcement-learning objective that trains draft models to generate reasoning steps that are both faithful to target trajectories and concise. We further propose a Threshold-based Verification Mechanism (TBVM) that uses a ratio-based criterion to provide stable and interpretable acceptance of speculative steps only when positive evidence clearly dominates, thereby preventing error propagation. Building on these components, we develop a Fully Parallel Speculative Reasoning (FPSR) framework that parallelizes draft generation, target-side reasoning, and verification across multi-step reasoning, enabling early stopping and clean fallback. Experiments on reasoning-heavy benchmarks demonstrate up to speedup while preserving target-model accuracy, yielding substantial efficiency gains without compromising reasoning quality.

AI.tldr: DREAM-R通过强化学习优化策略、对齐验证机制和并行化推理三大创新，显著提升了大模型推理效率，同时保持了推理质量。
AI.motivation: Speculative reasoning, though proposed as a means to accelerate reasoning-intensive generation in large multimodal models, suffers from limited effectiveness due to misalignment between speculative drafts and target-verified reasoning.
AI.method: The framework employs three key components: (1) SAPO - a reinforcement learning objective that trains draft models to generate reasoning steps faithful to target trajectories while maintaining conciseness; (2) TBVM - a ratio-based verification mechanism that accepts speculative steps only when positive evidence clearly dominates, preventing error propagation; (3) FPSR - a fully parallel framework that simultaneously processes draft generation, target-side reasoning, and verification across multi-step reasoning chains.
AI.result: Experiments on reasoning-heavy benchmarks demonstrate significant speedup while preserving target-model accuracy.
AI.conclusion: DREAM-R achieves substantial efficiency gains without compromising reasoning quality, as demonstrated on reasoning-heavy benchmarks.

title: LLM Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning is an Inference Workload
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, including appendix and references
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) fine-tuning is attractive for large language models because it replaces backpropagation with forward objective evaluations. Existing implementations nevertheless execute ZO algorithms inside conventional training loops, even though their dominant work is repeated scoring under nearby parameter states. This creates a workload-runtime mismatch: the algorithm asks for structured inference-style scoring, while the system exposes a sequence of fragmented training-loop steps. We show that LLM ZO fine-tuning is an inference-dominated workload and execute its repeated scoring phase through a serving runtime. On OPT-13B SST-2, the resulting vLLM execution path completes the 20k-step LoZO run in 0.51 estimated training hours versus 4.15 hours for the official LoZO baseline under the matched LoRA-only setting, an 8.13x speedup, while reaching 0.922 final evaluation accuracy and 0.931 final full-validation accuracy. In core-step scaling experiments across OPT-1.3B to OPT-13B, the same runtime reorganization gives 2.34x--7.72x speedups. A MeZO-style high-rank factorized experiment shows that the same runtime paradigm can track a MeZO-like loss trajectory while running up to 2.55x faster. More broadly, representing ZO updates as dynamic adapter states suggests a practical path toward inference-time training, where lightweight adaptation can be scheduled as an inference-like workload rather than as a separate training job.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM零阶微调中的重复评分阶段从训练循环迁移至推理服务运行时(vLLM)，在保持精度的同时实现最高8.13x加速，并将ZO更新概念化为动态适配器状态，为推理时训练开辟新路径。
AI.motivation: 现有ZO微调实现依赖常规训练循环，导致工作负载-运行时不匹配：算法需要结构化推理风格评分，但系统暴露的是碎片化训练循环步骤。
AI.method: 将LLM ZO微调的重复评分阶段通过服务运行时(vLLM)执行，将ZO更新重新表示为动态适配器状态。
AI.result: OPT-13B SST-2任务中，20k步LoZO运行达8.13x加速(0.51 vs 4.15小时)，精度0.922/0.931；OPT-1.3B至13B核心步骤扩展实验获2.34x-7.72x加速；MeZO风格因子化实验以2.55x速度追踪损失轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 将ZO更新表示为动态适配器状态，为推理时训练提供了实用路径，轻量级适应可作为推理类工作负载而非独立训练任务调度。

title: VeriTrip: A Verifiable Benchmark for Travel Planning Agents over Unstructured Web Corpora
summary: Existing benchmarks have laid the foundation for travel planning agents by establishing API-centric paradigms. However, as the capabilities of Autonomous Agents continue to advance, their evaluation must evolve beyond simple tool execution toward handling the inherent complexities of the open web. Current benchmarks bypass core cognitive hurdles: they fail to account for information noise, ignore multi-source factual contradictions, and overlook the necessity of grounding visual perception into logical planning. We introduce VeriTrip, a verifiable benchmark designed to meet the increasing demands for agent robustness and reliability. VeriTrip shifts the evaluation focus to evidence-grounded reasoning over unstructured multimodal web corpora. It establishes a Multimodal Retrieval Base (MRB) derived from real-world sources, forcing agents to autonomously orchestrate queries across heterogeneous data. A synchronized Verifiable Knowledge Base (VKB) enables a cell-wise verification protocol that precisely quantifies factual reliability, distinguishing systematic reasoning failures from parametric hallucinations. Our evaluations across leading MLLMs reveal a critical \textit{retrieval-reasoning trade-off}: the cognitive load of autonomous retrieval significantly erodes instruction retention. VeriTrip provides the rigorous foundation necessary for the next generation of planning agents capable of operating in unconstrained, multimodal environments.

AI.tldr: VeriTrip是一个面向多模态规划智能体的可验证评估基准，通过构建多模态检索基(MRB)和可验证知识基(VKB)，迫使智能体在非结构化多模态网页语料上进行证据驱动的推理，从而精确评估其在开放Web环境中的可靠性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试存在三大核心缺陷：无法应对信息噪声、忽略多源事实矛盾、缺乏将视觉感知融入逻辑规划的能力。现有评估范式绕过关键认知挑战，无法满足自主智能体日益增长的鲁棒性和可靠性需求。
AI.method: 建立多模态检索基(MRB)从真实世界来源构建数据，强制智能体自主编排跨异构数据源的查询；同步构建可验证知识基(VKB)并实现单元格级验证协议，精确量化事实可靠性，区分系统性推理失败与参数幻觉。
AI.result: 对主流多模态大语言模型的评估揭示了关键的"检索-推理权衡"现象——自主检索的认知负荷会显著损害指令保持能力，表明当前模型在复杂多模态环境中仍存在显著局限。
AI.conclusion: VeriTrip为下一代规划智能体提供严格评估基础，使其能够在非结构化多模态环境中可靠运行；评估揭示了多模态大语言模型存在"检索-推理权衡"现象，即自主检索的认知负荷会显著损害指令保持能力。

title: Principled Algorithms for Optimizing Generalized Metrics in Multi-Label Learning
summary: Many real-world classification tasks require predicting multiple labels per instance, necessitating the optimization of complex evaluation metrics such as the $F$-measure and Jaccard index. While the Empirical Utility Maximization (EUM) framework is natural for these population-level metrics, existing theoretical results are largely limited to asymptotic Bayes-consistency. In this paper, we develop principled learning algorithms for optimizing a broad class of generalized metrics within the EUM framework, grounded in the stronger notion of $H$-consistency. Our key contribution is the design of novel surrogate loss functions for multi-label learning that admit provable $H$-consistency bounds, enabling optimization with non-asymptotic guarantees tailored to the hypothesis class and finite samples. Crucially, we prove these combinatorially formulated surrogates decompose exactly, operating in strictly $O(l)$ time without approximations. Building on this foundation, we introduce MMO (Multi-Label Metric Optimization), a new family of algorithms for optimizing generalized linear-fractional metrics. We validate our approach through extensive experiments, demonstrating robust scalability and superior performance over state-of-the-art continuous baselines on large-scale datasets (MS-COCO, Reuters-21578) in high-sparsity, deep learning regimes. Our results offer both theoretical rigor and practical effectiveness for general multi-label metric optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多标签学习中的广义指标优化问题，提出基于H-consistency理论框架的MMO算法，设计了O(l)复杂度的组合代理损失函数，在保证理论严格性的同时实现了大规模数据集上的优异实验性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EUM框架的理论结果局限于渐近Bayes一致性，无法提供有限样本和特定假设类的非渐近保证
AI.method: 设计组合形式的代理损失函数（O(l)时间复杂度），在H-consistency框架下建立非渐近保证
AI.result: MMO在大规模数据集（MS-COCO、Reuters-21578）的高稀疏深度学习场景下优于现有连续基线方法
AI.conclusion: 提出的MMO算法族在大规模多标签学习任务中实现了理论有保证的性能，为广义指标优化提供了严谨且实用的解决方案

title: TRACER: Turn-level Regret Matching with Inner Reinforcement Credit for Cooperative Multi-LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models increasingly rely on either reinforcement learning or multi-agent prompting to improve reasoning, yet these two paradigms remain difficult to combine. Directly applying single-agent reinforcement learning to multi-turn multi-agent systems faces following dilemmas: i) Sparse rewards, role-level free-riding and excessive training overhead. ii) Agents only imitate to collaborate. iii) Fixed collaboration protocol falls into oscillating local optimum. We introduce TRACER, a turn-level reinforcement framework for cooperative multi-LLM reasoning. TRACER separates collaborative decision making into a controller-regret layer, where controllers learn whether the agents should speak or skip the current round through regret matching, and a generation-credit layer, which optimizes proposer and reviewer utterances with role-specific GSPO rewards. This design i) assigns credit at the level of both action modes and generated utterances, thus avoiding free-riding and sparse rewards. We only expand the choices made by the controllers, thus greatly reducing computational cost of training. Moreover, ii) agents acquire collaborative capability as they learn when to utter and what to speak. Finally, iii) by designing binary actions ingeniously, we extend classical game theory established for finite action spaces to deep learning, thus achieving mathematically rigorous convergence. We train all local RL-style methods on the GSM8K training split and evaluate on held-out GSM8K, MATH500, and GPQA-Diamond to measure in-domain accuracy, cross-benchmark generalization, inference cost, and correction-preservation behavior. The resulting framework provides a compact and reproducible testbed for studying learned collaboration policies beyond fixed debate, voting, or aggregation protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/Shark-Forest/TRACER.

AI.tldr: TRACER proposes a turn-level reinforcement learning framework for cooperative multi-LLM reasoning that combines controller-regret learning with generation-credit optimization. It addresses sparse rewards, free-riding, and training overhead through a two-layer architecture where controllers decide whether agents should speak or skip, and role-specific rewards optimize generated content. The framework converges rigorously via game-theoretic binary actions and generalizes across benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Existing RL and multi-agent prompting paradigms are difficult to combine. Single-agent RL applied to multi-turn multi-agent systems faces three key challenges: sparse rewards with role-level free-riding and excessive training overhead; agents only imitating collaboration rather than actively learning it; and fixed collaboration protocols leading to oscillating local optima.
AI.method: TRACER introduces a two-layer architecture: (1) Controller-Regret Layer - agents learn whether to speak or skip via regret matching; (2) Generation-Credit Layer - optimizes utterances with role-specific GSPO rewards using credit assignment at both action modes and generated utterances. Only controller-chosen actions are expanded during training, reducing computational overhead.
AI.result: Evaluated on GSM8K (in-domain), MATH500, and GPQA-Diamond (cross-benchmark), the framework demonstrates improved accuracy, generalization, reduced inference cost, and correction-preservation behavior while providing a reproducible testbed beyond fixed debate, voting, or aggregation protocols.
AI.conclusion: TRACER achieves mathematically rigorous convergence by extending classical game theory to deep learning through binary actions. The framework provides a compact testbed for studying learned collaboration policies, demonstrating improved in-domain accuracy and cross-benchmark generalization while reducing inference cost and preserving correction-preservation behavior.

title: Multi-Mixer Models: Flexible Sequence Modeling with Shared Representations
summary: Softmax attention is the cornerstone of modern large language models, but its memory scales linearly and compute quadratically with sequence length. Linear recurrent models, such as linear attention and state space models, have become widely studied as alternatives to attention due to their linear compute and constant memory. While these sub-quadratic token mixing methods, or mixers, achieve promising efficiency gains and competitive results on a wide range of benchmarks, current linear recurrent models still lag behind on tasks that require long-context retrieval or in-context learning. A growing body of work studies hybrid architectures that attempt to mitigate these trade-offs by statically interleaving or merging attention and recurrent blocks. In this work, we explore a new axis of developing hybrid models: across the token sequence. We propose Oryx, a hybrid model that can, throughout a sequence, flexibly switch between different mixers, for example quadratic attention for rich context utilization and linear recurrences for efficient generation. Oryx ties at least 90% of its parameters across mixers, enabling attention and recurrent modes to operate over shared internal representations. We validate our design with Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet variants, up to 1.4B models. Under fixed token budgets and a mixed-training strategy, Oryx achieves comparable or better performance than its single-mixer baselines. At the 1.4B scale, all instances of Oryx outperform their respective baselines by at least 0.7 percentage points on averaged language modeling tasks. On retrieval tasks, Oryx achieves performance comparable to the Transformer baseline even when processing only a tiny fraction (<10%) of the tokens in attention mode. These results suggest that attention and linear recurrent models can share internal representations, and motivate sequence-axis hybridization as a promising direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Oryx，一种可在序列中动态切换注意力与线性循环模式的混合模型架构，通过参数共享实现灵活的高效计算，在1.4B规模下验证了序列轴混合策略的有效性。
AI.motivation: softmax注意力在LLM中存在内存O(n)和计算O(n²)的扩展问题；线性循环模型（线性注意力、状态空间模型）虽具线性效率优势，但在长上下文检索和上下文学习任务上仍落后于注意力机制；现有混合架构多为静态交织或融合，缺乏动态灵活性。
AI.method: Oryx采用序列轴动态混合策略：在处理序列时灵活切换不同混合器（如用于上下文利用的二次注意力、用于高效生成的线性循环）。该设计将至少90%的参数跨混合器绑定，使注意力模式和循环模式共享内部表示。在Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet变体上进行验证，模型规模达1.4B，采用固定token预算的混合训练策略。
AI.result: 1.4B规模下，所有Oryx实例在语言建模任务上均超越对应基线模型至少0.7个百分点；检索任务中，仅用<10%的token进行注意力模式处理即可达到与Transformer基线相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: Oryx通过90%以上参数共享实现注意力与线性循环模式的灵活切换，为长上下文场景下的高效计算提供了新范式。序列轴混合化是一个值得关注的研究方向。

title: The Importance of Being Statistically Earnest: A Critical Re-evaluation of GSM-Symbolic
comment: 38 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to ACL ARR / EMNLP 2026
summary: The GSM-Symbolic benchmark (Mirzadeh et al., 2025) reported consistent performance drops across 25 Large Language Models (LLMs) when tested on template-generated variants of GSM8K problems, concluding that the models lack genuine reasoning capabilities. We argue that this conclusion rests on shaky statistical ground. Re-evaluating 20 open-weight models using Generalised Linear Mixed Models with per-question random effects, we find that only half exhibit statistically significant performance changes under the original prompt format. Moreover, we identify a previously unacknowledged factor: the main GSM-Symbolic dataset contains a systematically shifted distribution of larger integers in problem texts relative to GSM-Base (K-S statistic = 0.12, p < 0.001), contradicting the original authors' claims. Controlling for this large number effect accounts for significance in roughly half the remaining cases. Among models with statistically significant performance deltas, we identify distinct, model-specific failure profiles - including fragility of variable binding, arithmetic limitations, and dual-task interference - underscoring that blanket claims about LLM reasoning are both statistically premature and mechanistically misleading.

AI.tldr: 本文对GSM-Symbolic基准测试的结论提出质疑，指出其统计方法存在缺陷：大整数分布偏移未被控制，仅约50%的模型表现出显著性能变化，且失败模式具有模型特异性，因此不宜对LLM推理能力做出笼统结论。
AI.motivation: GSM-Symbolic论文得出LLM缺乏真正推理能力的结论，但该结论的统计基础存在重大问题，需要重新验证。
AI.method: 使用广义线性混合模型（GLMM）配合每个问题随机效应重新评估20个开放权重模型；同时对GSM-Symbolic和GSM-Base数据集进行分布差异检验（K-S检验）。
AI.result: 仅半数模型在原始提示格式下表现出了统计学上显著的性能变化；GSM-Symbolic数据集存在系统性的大整数分布偏移（K-S=0.12, p<0.001）；控制大数效应后，约半数原本显著的案例失去显著性；显著性能变化的模型展现出各不相同的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM推理能力的笼统结论在统计上为时过早，在机制上也具有误导性。未来的基准测试评估应更严格控制数据分布差异，并采用适当的多层次统计模型。

title: Learn from Weaknesses: Automated Domain Specialization for Small Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently made substantial progress, but deploying a separate large expert for each software domain remains expensive. Small open computer-use agents are more practical specialization targets, but they remain substantially weaker and exhibit uneven domain-specific failures. A straightforward remedy is to synthesize large-scale training data for the target domain, yet we find that this naive approach yields only marginal improvements. Building on this observation, we introduce LearnWeak, an annotation-free specialization framework for small computer-use agents that uses a stronger reference agent to identify the student's weaknesses in the target domain, synthesize targeted tasks, and construct supervision automatically. LearnWeak further introduces an error-aware specialization objective that disentangles planning and execution errors, enabling more behaviorally precise updates than broad uniform supervision. On OSWorld, LearnWeak achieves average gains of 11.6 and 11.1 percentage points over EvoCUA-8B and OpenCUA-7B, respectively, across eight domains. We also validate that our student-aware dataset generation and training approaches outperform existing autonomous trajectory generation and training baselines. Our work highlights the importance of student awareness in both data synthesis and agent training, pointing toward a more principled and efficient path for specializing small computer-use agents in diverse domains.

AI.tldr: LearnWeak是一个无需人工标注的小型CUA专业化框架，通过强参考代理识别学生弱点、合成针对性任务并构建自动化监督信号，结合误差感知目标将规划错误与执行错误解耦训练，在OSWorld上实现超过11个百分点的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 小型开放域计算机使用代理(Computer-use agents, CUAs)更为实用，但性能明显弱于大型专用模型，且存在领域不均衡的失败问题。现有解决方案(为每个软件领域部署独立的大型专家模型)成本高昂，而简单的合成大规模训练数据仅带来边际改进。
AI.method: LearnWeak框架包含两个核心创新：(1) 使用强参考代理识别学生弱点并合成针对性训练任务，自动构建监督信号；(2) 引入误差感知专业化目标，将规划错误与执行错误解耦，实现更精细的行为更新。
AI.result: 在OSWorld基准上，LearnWeak相比EvoCUA-8B和OpenCUA-7B分别提升11.6和11.1个百分点，涵盖八个领域的平均收益验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LearnWeak框架通过学生意识方法实现了小型CUA的高效专业化，在OSWorld上相比基线模型提升超过11个百分点，验证了学生感知的数据生成和训练方法的有效性。

title: Beyond Binary Moral Judgment: Modeling Ethical Pluralism in AI
summary: Critical decision-making in socially consequential spaces is increasingly involving AI systems at varying capacities. Yet, despite the ubiquity of autonomous systems, most approaches to handling autonomous moral decision-making resort to scalar or binary judgments. These methods are insufficient for acceptable moral reasoning, as they provide little explanation, leaving out imperative contextual and theoretical information that must be included to support accountability. For this, we propose a framework to model moral reasoning as a distribution over normative ethical theories or ethical pluralism. We introduce a normative ethics simplex that integrates these theories. A benchmark of 450 cases across 15 fine-grained subtheories was also prepared for the purposes of stacked ensemble learning. These cases describe ethical dilemmas in natural language and have associated extracted contextual features. The implementation of the simplex was achieved via a two-stream normative-semantic architecture. This is followed by the fusion of normative information and a sequential, stacking ensemble to learn the best fit of the three broad theories: consequentialism, virtue ethics, and deontology, and the 15 subcategories. Our experiments demonstrate that the integration of contextual and normative priors with the semantic embeddings significantly improves the performance of the classification, displaying an accuracy of 88.89%. We conducted ablation studies to show that structured ethical representations contribute beyond analogical reasoning, and the chosen stacking architecture gives the best results due to the gradual learning of granularity. Ethical pluralism is also analyzed through entropy, confidence, and visualization. Thus, modeling ethical pluralism as a probabilistic normative distribution supports human-like moral reasoning, ethical disagreement analysis, and future alignment in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将道德推理建模为跨规范伦理理论的概率分布，通过规范伦理学单纯形整合结果主义、德性伦理和道义论三大流派及其15个子类别。双流规范-语义架构结合堆叠集成学习在450个案例基准上达到88.89%准确率，证明了结构化伦理表示和伦理多元主义建模对实现类人道德推理和AI伦理对齐的重要价值。
AI.motivation: 现有AI道德决策系统采用标量或二元判断，缺乏解释性和关键语境/理论信息，无法支持问责制。
AI.method: 提出规范伦理学单纯形框架整合三大伦理理论（结果主义、德性伦理、道义论）及其15个子类别；采用双流规范-语义架构；通过序列堆叠集成学习实现最优拟合。
AI.result: 准确率达88.89%；消融实验证明结构化伦理表示优于类比推理；堆叠架构因渐进式粒度学习效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 建模伦理多元主义为概率规范分布，支持类人道德推理、伦理分歧分析和AI系统未来对齐。

title: Thinking as Compression: Your Reasoning Model is Secretly a Context Compressor
summary: Context compression aims to shorten long context inputs with minimal information loss for LLM inference acceleration. While existing methods have shown promise, they typically rely on complex compression modules or compression-specific training, leaving the intrinsic capabilities of LLMs underexplored. In contrast, this work reveals that a thinking model itself can naturally compress long contexts by organizing task-relevant information. We thus derive Thinking as Compression (TaC), a new compression paradigm that treats thinking itself as compressed context. Without relying on specific dedicated compressor, TaC directly prompts the thinking model to generate thinking traces as the shortened context, already outperforming most representative compression methods. Further, given that raw thinking output may struggle with budget control and shortcut behaviors, we introduce Thinking as Compression Constrained (TaC-C), leveraging a simple reward-driven optimization framework to elicit intrinsic thinking as compact and controllable compressed context. Experiments across four long-context QA benchmarks demonstrate that TaC-C consistently outperforms existing baselines. At 4x and 8x compression ratios, it surpasses the strongest competitor by 17.4% and 23.4% in average F1, and by 15.7% and 21.7% in average Exact Match Score (EM), respectively.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes Thinking as Compression (TaC), leveraging thinking models' intrinsic ability to organize task-relevant information for context compression. Without dedicated compressors, the method generates thinking traces as shortened context. The enhanced TaC-C uses reward-driven optimization to improve compactness and controllability, outperforming existing baselines by up to 23.4% in F1 and 21.7% in EM at 8x compression ratios on long-context QA benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Existing context compression methods rely on complex compression modules or compression-specific training, underutilizing the intrinsic capabilities of LLMs for compression.
AI.method: TaC uses thinking model-generated traces as compressed context without dedicated compressors; TaC-C further introduces reward-driven optimization to enhance compactness and controllability of thinking-based compression.
AI.result: At 4x and 8x compression ratios, TaC-C achieves 17.4% and 23.4% higher average F1, and 15.7% and 21.7% higher average EM than strongest baselines respectively.
AI.conclusion: TaC-C represents a promising new compression paradigm that leverages the intrinsic capabilities of thinking models, offering a training-free alternative to dedicated compressors while achieving superior performance across compression ratios.

title: PEFT-Arena: Understanding Parameter-Efficient Finetuning from a Stability-Plasticity Perspective
comment: Technical report v1 (28 pages, 9 figures, project page: https://spherelab.ai/PEFT-Arena/)
summary: Parameter-efficient finetuning (PEFT) has become the standard approach for adapting large language models, yet evaluations largely emphasize downstream accuracy while overlooking the retention of pretrained capabilities. We argue that PEFT should be assessed through the stability-plasticity dilemma: the trade-off between target-task adaptation and resistance to forgetting. We introduce PEFT-Arena, a benchmark that jointly measures downstream performance and general capability retention. Across methods, we find distinct stability-plasticity profiles; under comparable parameter budgets, orthogonal finetuning achieves the most favorable Pareto frontier. To explain these differences, we analyze PEFT updates from two geometric perspectives. In weight space, spectral analysis reveals how parameterizations interact with the pretrained singular-value structure. In activation space, retention metrics show whether finetuning preserves or distorts general-capability representations, with forgetting linked to non-isometric representation distortion. Finally, an analysis shows that final SFT checkpoints often overshoot a better target-retention operating point. Inspired by this, we present case studies of a post-hoc improvement with path-wise rewinding.

AI.tldr: PEFT方法在保持预训练能力和适应下游任务之间存在权衡。PEFT-Arena基准测试通过联合测量下游性能和通用能力保留来评估这一平衡。几何分析表明权重空间参数化与预训练奇异值结构的交互作用，以及激活空间中非等距表示扭曲与遗忘的关联。最终SFT检查点常超出最优保留操作点，路径回退可作为后验改进。
AI.motivation: PEFT评估仅关注下游任务准确率，忽视了预训练能力的保留。作者认为PEFT应通过"稳定性-可塑性困境"来评估，即目标任务适应与抗遗忘之间的权衡。
AI.method: Spectral analysis of weight space (pretrained singular-value structure interactions) and activation space analysis (representation distortion metrics linking forgetting to non-isometric distortion).
AI.result: 不同PEFT方法展现出独特的稳定性-可塑性特征；在可比参数预算下，正交微调（orthogonal finetuning）达到最有利的Pareto前沿；遗忘与非等距表示扭曲相关。
AI.conclusion: Final SFT checkpoints often overshoot optimal target-retention operating point; path-wise rewinding provides a post-hoc improvement strategy.

title: OpenURMA: A Clean-Room Open Implementation of the Unified Bus Protocol
summary:
Modern datacenter RDMA is bottlenecked at the network interface, not the wire. A NIC running RoCE or InfiniBand holds per-connection state for every (application, remote-endpoint) pair - hundreds of megabytes at 1024-application fanout - and pays a four-traversal PCIe round trip on a 64-byte operation, inflating latency an order of magnitude beyond the wire. Both follow from the Queue Pair over PCIe abstraction RDMA inherits from InfiniBand.
  Huawei's Unified Bus (UB), a public 2025 specification, changes the abstraction: it decouples per-application endpoint state from per-host transport state so connection context grows additively, exposes ordering as opt-in, and reaches remote memory through native CPU load/store to an on-chip-bus controller. UB ships in Huawei's closed Ascend 950 silicon.
  OpenURMA is the first clean-room open implementation of UB's transport and transaction layers, realised at three tiers - synthesisable RTL on Alveo U50, a cycle-level two-node SystemC simulator, and a gem5 full-system scaffold - each with a matched OpenRoCE (RoCEv2 RC) baseline. The contribution is the implementation, harness, and controlled comparison closed silicon does not admit. On the canonical 64-byte remote fetch - LOAD on UB-spec Sec.8.3, READ on RoCEv2 RC - UB's load/store path delivers ~500 ns end-to-end, 4.37x below the matched baseline (2186 ns), sustains 2.80x higher throughput, and fits in ~14% of a U50's LUTs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OpenURMA——华为统一总线(UB)传输和事务层的首个清洁室开源实现，在RTL、SystemC仿真器和gem5三个层次上实现，并配合OpenRoCE基线进行对照评估。实验表明UB架构在64字节操作上可实现4.37倍延迟降低和2.80倍吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 传统数据中心RDMA受限于网络接口而非线缆速度。问题源于两个方面：①NIC为每个(应用,远端 endpoint)对维护连接状态，在1024应用扇出时需占用数百MB内存；②64字节操作需经历四次PCIe遍历，极大增加延迟。根本原因在于RDMA从InfiniBand继承的Queue Pair over PCIe抽象。
AI.method: 采用三层次实现策略：(1) Alveo U50上可综合的RTL实现；(2) 双节点循环级SystemC仿真器；(3) gem5全系统脚手架。每个层次均配有匹配的OpenRoCE(RoCEv2 RC)基线进行对照实验。性能测试聚焦于64字节远端取操作(UB的LOAD对比RoCEv2的READ)。
AI.result: 在64字节远端取操作中，UB的load/store路径实现约500ns端到端延迟，较匹配基线(2186ns)快4.37倍；可维持2.80倍更高的吞吐量；RTL实现仅占用U50约14%的LUT资源。
AI.conclusion: OpenURMA提供了UB的首次开源实现，通过RTL、SystemC仿真器和gem5全系统脚手架三个层次的实现，配合匹配的OpenRoCE基线，完成了可控对比实验。实验表明UB在64字节远端取操作上达到约500ns的端到端延迟，较RoCEv2 RC提升4.37倍，吞吐量提升2.80倍，且仅占用U50约14%的LUT资源，证明了UB架构的可行性和性能优势。

title: LiveBrowseComp: Are Search Agents Searching, or Just Verifying What They Already Know?
summary: Are LLM-based search agents genuinely searching, or using the web to verify what they already know? We study this question on BrowseComp with three diagnostics. Our analysis reveals Intrinsic Knowledge Dependence (IKD): even with tool access, agents often rely on intrinsic knowledge -- information encoded in the model before retrieval -- rather than on external evidence. Agents answer up to 44.5% of BrowseComp questions without tools, generate more than half of their search queries from internally produced hypotheses rather than retrieved leads, and perform worse than closed-book baselines when answer-supporting evidence is removed. These results suggest that static search benchmarks can reward memory-backed verification rather than evidence-driven discovery, conflating what agents already know with what they can find. We then introduce LiveBrowseComp, a deep-search benchmark designed to evaluate agents beyond intrinsic coverage. It contains 335 human-authored questions whose answers depend on facts published within the 90 days preceding benchmark construction, drawn from six updated sources and filtered to exclude globally salient events. On LiveBrowseComp, all evaluated agents fall below 2% closed-book accuracy, search-augmented scores drop by 25-40 points relative to BrowseComp, and prior model rankings no longer reliably predict performance. LiveBrowseComp is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Forival/LiveBrowseComp.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示LLM搜索智能体存在"内在知识依赖"问题——主要依赖预训练记忆而非外部检索。在BrowseComp上，智能体即使能访问工具，仍有44.5%问题可无需工具回答，超半数查询来自内部假设而非外部线索。引入LiveBrowseComp基准（含335道需近期知识的题），所有智能体闭卷准确率不足2%，搜索增强得分下降25-40分，表明静态基准高估了智能体的搜索能力。
AI.motivation: Existing search benchmarks may conflate memorized knowledge with genuine search capability, rewarding memory-backed verification over evidence-driven discovery. Static benchmarks cannot properly evaluate whether LLM agents genuinely search or merely verify pre-trained knowledge.
AI.method: Three diagnostic experiments on BrowseComp: (1) closed-book performance measurement (agents answer 44.5% without tools), (2) query origin analysis (over half from internal hypotheses), (3) evidence removal comparison. LiveBrowseComp contains 335 human-authored questions requiring facts from 90 days prior, drawn from 6 updated sources, filtered of salient events.
AI.result: Defined Intrinsic Knowledge Dependence (IKD) phenomenon where agents rely on pre-trained knowledge over external evidence, evidenced by high closed-book performance (44.5%), hypothesis-driven queries, and degraded performance when evidence is removed.
AI.conclusion: LiveBrowseComp reveals all evaluated agents score below 2% in closed-book accuracy and experience 25-40 point drops in search-augmented scores compared to BrowseComp, while prior model rankings fail to predict performance. The dataset is publicly available.

title: Multi-Adapter Representation Interventions via Energy Calibration
summary: Representation intervention has emerged as a promising paradigm for aligning large language models toward desired behaviors without modifying model weights. Existing methods typically apply a fixed intervention uniformly across all inputs. However, we find that the appropriate intervention direction and strength vary substantially across samples, and such indiscriminate intervention leads to degradation of general capabilities on benign inputs. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Adapter Representation Interventions via Energy Calibration (MARI). Specifically, we introduce a competitive multi-adapter mechanism in which specialized experts capture non-linear correction patterns and adaptively determine the appropriate intervention direction and strength for different samples. Furthermore, we design an energy-based gating module that leverages internal propagation dynamics to distinguish inputs that are applicable for intervention. Extensive experiments across diverse model families and parameter scales demonstrate that MARI achieves state-of-the-art alignment performance. Our method significantly improves performance on TruthfulQA, BBQ, and safety benchmarks, while maintaining and even improving general capabilities on tasks such as MMLU and ARC. Our code is available at https://github.com/V1centNevwake/MARI.

AI.tldr: MARI是一种新型表示干预方法，通过竞争性多适配器和能量门控模块实现样本自适应的干预方向与强度调控，在提升模型安全性和真实性的同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有表示干预方法对所有输入统一应用固定干预，但不同样本的最优干预方向和强度差异显著，导致对良性输入的通用能力下降。
AI.method: 1）竞争性多适配器机制：多个专家自适应捕捉非线性校正模式，动态决定干预方向和强度；2）能量基门控模块：利用内部传播动态区分可干预样本。
AI.result: MARI在TruthfulQA、BBQ等安全和真实性基准上显著提升性能，同时在MMLU、ARC上保持甚至提升通用能力，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MARI通过竞争性多适配器机制和能量门控模块，在TruthfulQA、BBQ等安全基准上实现SOTA对齐性能，同时在MMLU、ARC等任务上保持或提升通用能力。

title: AlphaTransit: Learning to Design City-scale Transit Routes
summary: Designing a transit network requires many sequential route extension decisions, but their quality is often visible only after the full network is assembled. This delayed-feedback challenge lies at the heart of the Transit Route Network Design Problem (TRNDP), where route interactions can be deceptive: an extension that appears useful locally can create transfer bottlenecks, produce redundant overlap, or reduce overall throughput. To guide route construction under delayed simulator feedback, we introduce AlphaTransit, a search-based planning framework for cityscale bus network design. AlphaTransit couples Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with a neural policy-value network: the policy proposes route extensions, the value estimates downstream design quality, and search uses these predictions to refine each decision. This provides decision-time lookahead during route construction without running simulator rollouts inside the search tree. We evaluate AlphaTransit on a new Bloomington TRNDP benchmark with realistic road topology and censusderived demand, under mixed and full transit demand settings. In the Bloomington network, AlphaTransit attains the highest service rate in both demand settings, reaching 54.6% and 82.1%, respectively. Relative to reinforcement learning without search, these correspond to 9.9% and 11.4% service rate gains; relative to MCTS without learned guidance, they correspond to 2.5% and 11.2% gains. These results suggest that coupling learned guidance with MCTS is more effective than using either approach alone for transit network design. Our code and data are publicly available in https://github.com/poudel-bibek/AlphaTransit.

AI.tldr: AlphaTransit是一个用于城市规模公交网络设计的基于搜索的规划框架，通过将MCTS与神经策略-价值网络相结合，解决了公交网络设计中的延迟反馈挑战。实验表明，这种耦合策略相比单独使用任一方法（纯RL或无学习引导的MCTS）能取得更好的服务率效果。
AI.motivation: Transit Route Network Design Problem (TRNDP) 的核心挑战在于延迟反馈问题：路线交互具有欺骗性，局部看似有用的扩展可能造成换乘瓶颈、产生冗余重叠或降低整体吞吐量，而路线质量只有在完整网络组装后才能评估。
AI.method: 提出AlphaTransit框架，将MCTS与神经策略-价值网络耦合：策略网络用于提议路线扩展，价值网络估计下游设计质量，搜索过程利用这些预测来优化决策。该方法在路线构建过程中提供决策时前瞻能力，无需在搜索树内运行模拟器展开。
AI.result: 在Bloomington TRNDP基准测试（真实道路拓扑和人口普查需求）中，AlphaTransit在混合和满需求设置下均达到最高服务率54.6%和82.1%。相比纯RL方法分别提升9.9%和11.4%；相比无学习引导的MCTS分别提升2.5%和11.2%。
AI.conclusion: AlphaTransit通过将学习引导与MCTS相结合，在 Bloomington 公交网络基准测试中实现了最高服务率（54.6% 和 82.1%），分别比纯RL和无学习引导的MCTS方法提升了9.9%/11.4% 和 2.5%/11.2%。研究证明这种耦合策略比单独使用任一方法更有效，并提供了开源代码。

title: Utility-Aware Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Product Image Generation
summary: Product images strongly influence consumer decision-making in online marketplaces. Empowered by multimodal contrastive learning, generative AI can output images that closely align with text prompts. Yet existing generative AI models do not directly optimize marketplace performance. This is a critical gap, since semantic alignment alone does not guarantee that an image will sell. To address this limitation, we propose a \textit{utility-aware multimodal contrastive learning} framework that incorporates consumer demand into a novel Utility-Aware InfoNCE loss. Optimizing this utility-aware objective guides generation toward images that are both semantically coherent and demand-enhancing. This effect arises directly from a shift in the learned image-text representation space toward demand-driven visual cues, which we also validate through the theoretical bound of the proposed objective. In downstream applications on Amazon and Airbnb, product images generated and edited by our method outperform state-of-the-art models in increasing demand and preserving fidelity, while maintaining text-image consistency. Notably, our utility-aware framework preserves inverse U-shaped demand patterns for attributes such as aesthetics and uniqueness, improving demand-based performance while preserving fidelity and semantic consistency. Human-subject experiments further validate its commercial effectiveness. As generative AI technology continues to evolve, our utility-aware component can be flexibly embedded into emerging generative models to improve direct commercial use.

AI.tldr: 提出一种 utility-aware multimodal contrastive learning 框架，通过 Utility-Aware InfoNCE 损失将消费者需求纳入生成优化，使生成的图像既语义一致又需求导向。在 Amazon 和 Airbnb 的实验中表现优于现有最优模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI模型仅关注语义对齐，无法直接优化市场表现（销售效果），存在关键缺口。语义对齐并不能保证图像能够提升销售业绩。
AI.method: 提出 utility-aware multimodal contrastive learning 框架，包含 Utility-Aware InfoNCE 损失函数，将消费者需求纳入优化目标，通过改变学习到的图像-文本表示空间来捕捉需求驱动的视觉线索，并提供了该目标的理论 bound 验证。
AI.result: 在 Amazon 和 Airbnb 的下游应用中，使用该方法生成和编辑的产品图像在提升需求和保持保真度方面优于最先进的模型，同时保持了文本-图像一致性。该框架保留了美学和独特性等属性的反U形需求模式，在提升需求的同时保持保真度和语义一致性。人类受试者实验进一步验证了其商业有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有良好的商业应用价值，其 utility-aware 组件可灵活嵌入到新兴生成模型中，用于提升直接商业效用。

title: CORE: Contrastive Reflection Enables Rapid Improvements in Reasoning
summary: Language models can use verifiable rewards to improve at a wide variety of reasoning tasks. However, both parametric (e.g. RLVR) and non-parametric (e.g. prompt optimization) approaches to doing so typically require hundreds of training samples and thousands of model rollouts, making them expensive in the best case and intractable in the worst. To address this challenge, we introduce Contrastive Reflection (CORE), a non-parametric learning algorithm that compares past reasoning traces to generate insights: short natural-language descriptions of reasoning strategies and constraints that capture differences between successful and unsuccessful problem attempts. Across four reasoning tasks, we demonstrate that CORE enables more rapid improvement than both parametric (GRPO) and non-parametric (GEPA, episodic RAG, and MemRL) methods, while using fewer rollouts. Under fixed rollout budgets with as few as five training samples, we then show that CORE also achieves comparable or greater performance gains than each baseline. Finally, we highlight how CORE is also substantially more context-efficient than non-parametric baselines, requiring fewer prompt tokens while storing learned knowledge as compact, interpretable natural-language insights. Our results therefore suggest that distilling contrasts between successful and unsuccessful reasoning traces into abstract and useful insights can provide a more efficient and interpretable route to model self-improvement than weight updates, prompt optimization, or direct reuse of stored reasoning traces.

AI.tldr: CORE是一种非参数学习方法，通过对比成功与失败的推理轨迹自动生成策略洞察，在使用更少样本和rollout的情况下，优于现有参数化和非参数化基线方法，且具有更好的可解释性和上下文效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（参数化的RLVR和非参数化的提示优化）需要数百个训练样本和数千次模型rollout，成本高昂甚至不可行。
AI.method: CORE算法：通过比较历史推理轨迹生成短自然语言描述，描述成功与失败尝试之间的差异作为推理策略和约束条件。属于非参数学习方法，无需更新模型权重。
AI.result: CORE在四个推理任务上均优于GRPO、GEPA、episodic RAG和MemRL基线方法，且使用更少的rollout实现了更快速的改进。即使在仅5个训练样本的固定rollout预算下，CORE也能达到相当或更高的性能提升。此外，CORE在上下文效率上显著优于非参数基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CORE通过将成功与失败推理轨迹的差异提炼为简洁、自然语言形式的洞察，提供了一种比权重更新、提示优化或直接重用存储轨迹更高效且可解释的模型自我改进路径。

title: CubePart: An Open-Vocabulary Part-Controllable 3D Generator
summary: Interactive 3D assets used in games and simulation are typically decomposed into specific semantic parts to support animation, physics, and scripted behaviors, yet most generative 3D models produce either monolithic meshes or arbitrary part decompositions that cannot be aligned with application-specific requirements. We present CubePart, a generative framework for open-vocabulary, part-controllable 3D mesh generation that exposes part structure as an explicit inference-time control signal. Given a global text prompt and a user-defined parts schema expressed as an open-ended list of part names, our method generates a set of meshes - one per schema element - that assemble into a coherent object while respecting the specified semantic structure. To enable this capability, we introduce a scalable data pipeline to construct a large open-vocabulary, part-labeled 3D dataset, along with a two-stage generative architecture that separates global shape synthesis from part-level decoding. We demonstrate that the resulting assets can be directly integrated into game engines and driven by animation and behavior scripts without manual post-processing. Project Page: https://cubepart.github.io/

AI.tldr: CubePart是一个开放词汇、部分可控的3D网格生成框架，用户通过文本提示和部分模式定义即可生成具有特定语义结构的部分化3D资产，适用于游戏和仿真应用。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式3D模型产生整体网格或任意部分分解，无法与应用特定需求（如动画、物理、脚本行为）对齐，无法满足游戏和仿真中交互式3D资产对语义部分分解的要求。
AI.method: 两阶段生成架构：全局形状合成 + 部分级解码；大规模开放词汇部分标注3D数据集构建流水线；用户通过文本提示和开放式的部分名称列表定义部分模式。
AI.result: 生成与指定语义结构一致的对象网格，可直接用于游戏引擎并由动画和行为脚本驱动，无需手动后处理。
AI.conclusion: 通过两阶段生成架构和开放词汇的部分标注数据集，实现了语义结构可控的3D网格生成，生成资产可直接集成到游戏引擎中，无需手动后处理。

title: CaMBRAIN: Real-time, Continuous EEG Inference with Causal State Space Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a critical, non-invasive method to monitor electrical brain activity. EEGs can span anywhere from a couple seconds to multiple hours, posing a major hurdle for existing deep learning methods due to two major factors: (1) existing EEG models are predominantly built upon the attention mechanism, incurring quadratic scaling as the sequence length increases, and (2) raw EEG signals must be processed in a sliding-window fashion due to fixed-length input requirements, preventing global understanding of the entire signal. To this extent, we propose CaMBRAIN - the first Causal, Mamba-based state space model (SSM) capable of real-time inference of EEG signals, arguing that bidirectional approaches are needlessly expensive given the causal, unidirectional nature of EEG. However, training such a model is non-trivial, as crucial EEG events can be extremely brief - within fractions of a second - yet separated by long intervals spanning minutes. Current EEG methods use self-supervised objectives that optimize for signal reconstruction, but these are not well suited for streaming SSMs; they fail to explicitly train the hidden state to retain the salient long-range context needed for streaming inference. We therefore introduce a multi-stage self-supervised training pipeline specifically tailored to encourage long-range memory retention and strong performance on EEG signals, while preserving the linear-time complexity of state space models. CaMBRAIN achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results across 3 different EEG datasets with >10x higher throughput than existing models, enabling the first model capable of long-range, continuous inference of variable-length EEG signals.

AI.tldr: CaMBRAIN是首个基于Mamba的因果状态空间模型，实现EEG信号的实时流式推理。通过多阶段自监督训练解决长程记忆保留问题，在保持线性时间复杂度的同时，于3个数据集上取得SOTA成果。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG深度学习方法面临两大瓶颈：(1)基于注意力机制的模型随序列长度增加呈二次方 scaling；(2)滑动窗口处理方式无法实现全局信号理解。此外，传统自监督目标优化信号重建，但无法显式训练隐藏状态保留长程上下文以支持流式推理。
AI.method: CaMBRAIN采用因果、Mamba架构的状态空间模型(SSM)，避免双向注意力的二次复杂度；同时提出多阶段自监督训练管道，专门设计用于促进长程记忆保留，同时保持SSM的线性时间复杂度。
AI.result: 在3个不同EEG数据集上达到SOTA性能，吞吐量比现有模型提升超过10倍。
AI.conclusion: CaMBRAIN enables the first model capable of long-range, continuous inference of variable-length EEG signals with linear-time complexity.

title: Self-Consistency via Marginal Sharpening
summary: Inference-time sampling can elicit strong reasoning abilities from language models without additional training. Existing power-sampling methods do so by sharpening the distribution over full generated outputs, favoring completions that are individually likely under the model. We argue that this is the wrong object to target for reasoning: a completion entangles a reasoning trace with a final answer, whereas what matters is whether an answer is supported by many plausible reasoning paths. We therefore shift the target from the full-output distribution to the sharpened answer marginal, making self-consistency an inference-time objective rather than a post-hoc voting criterion. Surprisingly, this marginal target admits an efficient approximation: we propose a simple, purely autoregressive parallel sampling algorithm that approximately samples from the sharpened answer marginal, eliciting stronger performance than standard power sampling on mathematics and coding benchmarks while being orders of magnitude faster.

AI.tldr: 本文将自洽性从后验投票准则转变为推理时目标，转向针对答案边缘分布进行采样，而非完整输出分布，从而在保持效率的同时提升了大语言模型在推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有幂采样方法在完整的生成输出上锐化分布，但这一目标存在问题：推理过程与最终答案纠缠在一起，真正重要的是答案是否被多个合理的推理路径支持，而非单个完成序列的可能性。
AI.method: 提出一种简单、纯自回归的并行采样算法，通过直接针对答案边缘分布而非完整输出分布进行采样，实现更高效的推理。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在数学和代码基准测试中表现优于标准幂采样，且速度提升数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在数学和代码基准测试上优于标准幂采样，且计算效率显著提升。

title: Calibrating Conservatism for Scalable Oversight
summary: Agentic AI systems capable of autonomous planning and extended environmental interaction pose a fundamental control problem: how can humans maintain meaningful oversight of systems that may exceed their own capabilities? Existing approaches to scalable oversight rely on complex assumptions, remain largely heuristic, or lack practical methods for sequential settings with statistical guarantees. We introduce Calibrated Collective Oversight (CCO), which aggregates diverse auxiliary scoring functions into a penalty measuring deviation from a conservative baseline. Inspired by Attainable Utility Preservation, CCO enables collective conservatism: actions face a penalty proportional to overseer concern, so high-utility actions are still selected when overseers find them unobjectionable and overridden only when concern accumulates. CCO calibrates this conservatism online using Conformal Decision Theory, ensuring that undesirable outcomes remain below a user-specified target threshold with finite-time bounds and no distributional assumptions. On a modified version of SWE-bench, weaker overseers successfully constrain an adversarially misaligned stronger agent; on MACHIAVELLI, CCO substantially reduces ethical violations while preserving reward. In both settings, empirical violation rates closely match the specified targets, as predicted by the theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"校准集体监督"(CCO)的新方法，旨在解决超级智能AI系统的控制问题。该方法通过聚合多个辅助评分函数来惩罚偏离保守基线的行为，并使用共形决策理论进行在线校准，提供有限时间保证。实验表明该方法能有效约束对抗性 misalignment 的强智能体，同时在两个基准测试中保持目标违规率与设定阈值一致。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI systems capable of autonomous planning pose a fundamental control problem: humans cannot meaningfully oversee systems that exceed their own capabilities. Existing scalable oversight approaches rely on complex assumptions, are largely heuristic, or lack practical methods with statistical guarantees for sequential settings.
AI.method: CCO aggregates diverse auxiliary scoring functions into a penalty measuring deviation from a conservative baseline. It uses Conformal Decision Theory for online calibration of conservatism, providing finite-time guarantees without distributional assumptions.
AI.result: On a modified SWE-bench: weaker overseers successfully constrain an adversarially misaligned stronger agent. On MACHIAVELLI: CCO substantially reduces ethical violations while preserving reward. Empirical violation rates closely match specified targets.
AI.conclusion: CCO offers a principled and practical solution to the scalable oversight problem, with empirical validation showing that violation rates closely match specified targets across different benchmarks.

title: LNN-PINN: A Unified Physics-Only Training Framework with Liquid Residual Blocks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have attracted considerable attention for their ability to integrate partial differential equation priors into deep learning frameworks; however, they often exhibit limited predictive accuracy when applied to complex problems. To address this issue, we propose LNN-PINN, a physics-informed neural network framework that incorporates a liquid residual gating architecture while preserving the original physics modeling and optimization pipeline to improve predictive accuracy. The method introduces a lightweight gating mechanism solely within the hidden-layer mapping, keeping the sampling strategy, loss composition, and hyperparameter settings unchanged to ensure that improvements arise purely from architectural refinement. Across four benchmark problems, LNN-PINN consistently reduced RMSE and MAE under identical training conditions, with absolute error plots further confirming its accuracy gains. Moreover, the framework demonstrates strong adaptability and stability across varying dimensions, boundary conditions, and operator characteristics. In summary, LNN-PINN offers a concise and effective architectural enhancement for improving the predictive accuracy of physics-informed neural networks in complex scientific and engineering problems.

AI.tldr: LNN-PINN通过在物理信息神经网络中引入液体残差门控架构，仅在隐藏层映射中增加轻量级门控机制，无需改变采样、损失或超参数设置，即可在复杂问题上显著提升预测精度，已在四个基准问题中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在整合偏微分方程先验知识方面表现出色，但在处理复杂问题时预测精度有限，因此需要提升其预测能力。
AI.method: LNN-PINN在隐藏层映射中引入轻量级门控机制，保持采样策略、损失组成和超参数设置不变，通过架构层面的改进而非方法论的改变来提升性能。
AI.result: LNN-PINN在相同训练条件下，于四个基准问题上持续降低RMSE和MAE，绝对误差图验证了其精度提升，框架在 不同维度、边界条件和算子特性下均表现出强适应性和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: LNN-PINN通过引入轻量级门控机制实现架构增强，在保持原有建模和优化流程不变的前提下，有效提升了物理信息神经网络的预测精度。该方法在四个基准问题上均表现出一致性改善，且具有良好的适应性、稳定性和简洁性，为复杂科学工程问题中的精度提升提供了一种有效的架构优化方案。

title: Using Zero-Shot LLM-Generated Survey Data for Geographically Explicit Population Synthesis
summary: There is a growing interest in utilizing synthetic populations for a diverse range of applications. At the same time, we are witnessing a tremendous growth in artificial intelligence in all walks of life. This paper evaluates whether zero-shot large language model (LLM)-generated health survey data can serve as inputs to a conventional iterative proportional fitting (IPF) workflow for geographically explicit population synthesis. Using the 2023 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), we generate synthetic survey records for the U.S. states of Colorado and Mississippi with GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro. We use the generated data in an IPF-based synthesis pipeline and evaluate the resulting census tract-level synthetic populations against external benchmarks. Results show both LLMs capture several major state-level contrasts, indicating zero-shot generation produces geographically differentiated survey data. However, performance is strongly variable-dependent. Downstream effects in population synthesis are mixed, as IPF sometimes amplifies or reduces errors in the generated data. Spatial validation shows that LLM-based populations reproduce census tract-level patterns reasonably well, especially for variables that were more aligned with the ground truth data. Overall, the LLM-generated survey data shows promise as supplementary input, but not yet as a replacement for real survey data.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了零样本LLM生成健康调查数据作为IPF人口合成输入的可行性。使用BRFSS数据为Colorado和Mississippi生成合成记录，结果表明LLM能捕捉地理差异，但性能因变量而异，IPF可能放大或修正误差，LLM数据可作为补充而非替代真实调查数据。
AI.motivation: 合成人口在多个应用领域需求增长，同时AI技术快速发展，探索将LLM生成数据应用于地理空间人口合成具有重要研究价值。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4.1和Gemini-2.5-Pro生成零样本合成调查记录，将生成数据输入基于IPF的合成流程，在人口普查区域层面评估合成结果。
AI.result: 两个LLM均能捕捉主要州级差异，零样本生成产生地理分化的调查数据；性能高度依赖变量；IPF对生成数据误差有放大或缩小效果；空间验证显示LLM生成的人口能合理再现人口普查区域级模式，尤其是与真实数据对齐度较高的变量。
